reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful, clean & quiet beach without stones by the Atlantic. Access via stairs in wood with sleeves. Great rocks. Lifeguard
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful cliffs, clean & quiet sandy beach by the Atlantic with lifeguards. Possibility to rent sun loungers or even include umbrella and sunbeds. Access via stairs in wood with many steps & sleeves. Some options for parking.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Praia Da Falesia is one of the most beautiful beaches along the coastline of the Algarve and Albufeira in particular. A wide expanse of golden and red sands ,nice rock formations in the background and the waves here are gentle,perfect for swimming, its a popular beach but due to its size ,its a big long beach it never seems crowded even in high season, its a beach to most definitely check out if you're planning a holiday to Albufeira.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Top Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very great beach , very clean and beautiful sandy beach 1 umbrella with 2 sunbeds 20 € . You can walk wonderfully on the beach to both sides , very extensive . And up on the cliffs you can also go hiking .

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Long stretch of perfect sandy beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great stretched out beach with red stone on one side and cool waters on the other. Very peaceful as it is huge so not crowded at all. We found paid parking quite easily and there were a few restaurants around that looked nice for a bite to eat.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach with clay cliffs
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A magnificent beach with its rocks , cliffs of white and red beige clay facing the sea a very beautiful blue! We have plenty of eyes!! Few people a wide beach A beautiful beach of 8km

reviewsWithKeywords.title: “Falésia Beach: a 6km paradise in the Algarve”🙏🏾😍
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The Falésia Beach is simply stunning! They are 6 km long, from Eyes of Water to Vilamoura, surrounded by reddish cliffs that create a unique setting. The blend of the colors of the golden sand, the crystal blue sea and the imposing cliffs make it one of the most beautiful beaches in Portugal.Perfect for both long walks and relaxing in the sun. A real postcard from the Algarve that deserves to be visited

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach!!!! A must visit if you are in the area. We got a Uber and spent the day here. There is free parking.There is a restaurant with toilets. Sun beds are clean with parasols and wind breaks. X2 beds and parasol was 20euro, cash only.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Breathtaking
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach, breathtaking and very clean. We stayed there until 9pm and strangely there was no wind. It was very pleasant. And obviously, the sunset!! This was the highlight

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Wide golden sand beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: You should arrive early or parking will be a nuisance (a few places and what you can on the descent). It is accessed by a staircase that bridges a reddish cliff that contrasts with the blue of the sea.Upstairs there is a snack bar with bathrooms. There are two sectors for renting sunbeds. It stands out for the quality of the sand.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Election
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It's always my election beach every year.Easy to park with shade, good infrastructure and excellent water.Possible free parking and no problems with theft.Excellent quality water

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great place to relax and enjoy the beauty of our country
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The visit to the beach was a very pleasant and relaxing experience. The place has an impressive natural beauty, with clean waters and well preserved sands, creating a perfect Mood for rest and contact with nature. The landscape is charming, especially at sunset, providing unique and memorable moments.

reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great place for a solo meditation, a super quiet and safe place and an amazing beach as only one can find in this region.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very suggestive
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very wide and suggestive beach. The "Enjoy on Ocean" sign is a nice treat. Free parking spaces nearby

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The Beach of the Falls in Eyes of Water is simply stunning! From the moment we arrived, we were surrendered to the natural beauty of this place. The orange-tone cliffs, contrasting with the intense blue of the sea and the goldenness of the sand, create a landscape worthy of postcard — it’s hard to find words to describe such beauty.The beach is extensive, perfect for long walks by the sea, always with the incredible landscape of the arribas to accompany. The sand is fine, the water is clean and inviting, and even on the busiest days there is always room to relax.Another highlight is the tranquility: despite being a very sought after beach, its dimension allows you to enjoy moments of calm and quiet, ideal for both families and couples or even for those who like to practice outdoor sports.The infrastructure is excellent, with well-maintained accesses and support areas that make the experience even more enjoyable.Without a doubt, one of the most beautiful beaches not only of the Algarve, but of all of Europe. I recommend 100% and will come back whenever I can — it is impossible not to fall in love with this paradise!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful with fine sand
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful and equipped beach. If you arrive late, the nearby car parks will inevitably be full and the outward descent still goes, but the ascent after a full day at sea will be tough. But it is worth it!!!! Stock up on water and food, before the last staircase, where there is a bar, then at the beach you will find nothing, even in the organized part with sunbeds and umbrellas ( 2 sunbeds and 1 umbrella 18 euros for the whole day )

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Sublime beach at the edge of the cliffs
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful huge beach on the edge of the cliffs. Easy access by car. Park at the free public car park (early morning arrival ) or along the streets (still possible in Europe without control ) then walk 5 to 10 minutes to access the beach by stairs . Some dangerous waves, watch out for windy days, there's a lot of power. Pleasant water at 25 degrees.

reviewsWithKeywords.text: It's Paradise, not only the view, but also the soft sands, pure waters, 6 Km long, warm waters. It was the Nº1 last year, dopped to 5th, but is still one o the best in the world. Recomended

The best beach I've ever visited, well worth going is beautiful there's no place like this!  The beach is quite large and with plenty of space, it is a well spent day with a beautiful landscape and at sunset it gets even better!

Praia de Falésia beach isn’t perfect but still worth a visit. A nice surrounding of red rock formations. I was disappointed to have carted snorkelling gear all the way to Portugal and there was no fish to see (same issue at Oura beach). Sea was very cold. Some very busy spots on the beach, if you want less jam-packed survey the area, to the right looked pretty good as we left unfortunately we went left and ended up like sardines. Nothing else really to do in the area but beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A beautiful and pleasant beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is good, quiet, clean and with an access to the sea without great danger. It has water sports activities. I don't know if it can be considered the best beach, like the title it has. For me, St. Eulalia's is better.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach. Sea can be rough.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A fantastic beach that stretches for many miles and is absolutely beautiful.The sea can be rough as it’s the Atlantic Ocean so be careful when little ones are playing.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful 🤩
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach not to be missed during a stay in Albufeira. One of the longest, it takes its name from the magnificent ochre cliffs that dominate it.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: One of the most beautiful beaches in the world
reviewsWithKeywords.text: For me, the prettiest. Considering I'm a Galician, that's a lot to say.The beach is huge and the water is very clean and with good temperature. But what distinguishes this beach from the others is its back, those wonderful slopes reminiscent of the Cappadocia or the Grand Canyon. Anyway, wonderful.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Falesia Beach – Beauty and Tranquillity Combined
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Falesia Beach is truly a hidden gem. The scenery is absolutely breathtaking, with dramatic cliffs and pristine coastline creating a perfect backdrop for a peaceful day by the sea. The atmosphere was incredibly calm and relaxing, with most visitors simply enjoying the tranquillity — it was the ideal place to unwind.My fiancé and I loved it so much, we visited twice during our trip. To reach the beach, you take a lift down followed by a long wooden walkway, which in itself is an experience. The walk offers stunning views of the natural landscape and towering cliffs — it felt like part of the adventure.If you’re looking for a peaceful, scenic beach with a unique journey down, Falesia Beach is a must-visit.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Breathtaking Special Place
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Amazing place. Breathtaking landscape and scenery. The whole area felt so safe compared to other beaches I've been on. It also seems to be less crowded than beaches in Albufeira. We paid €14 for 2 sunbeds with an umbrella which we could use all day, I thought was a fair price. Be aware that if you're driving to the beach there's little parking space so it might be better to take a shuttle bus. There is a small shop at the beach but only sells food so bring suncream, beach balls etc. with you. There's also a vendor walking the beach selling drinks, but again take your own to avoid paying a premium. Overall a lovely place

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach with all facilities you need.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a stunning beach with excellent facilities. It has a laid back feel, plenty of sunbeds and parasols, but also plenty of room to just throw down a towel and sunbathe! The sea was warm, great for swimming and lifeguards on beach. Small snack bar at top of steps with toilets. Stunning dramatic cliffs, beautiful scenic beach that feels relaxed even when busy.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very nice
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The landscape and beautiful and conducive has magnificent photos. The beach is very large and it is good to walk there. Not necessarily easy to park there

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Reddish cliffs.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: There were some super nice cliffs, the beach was clean and the water super crystal clear a ten out of ten. I would recommend it for people between 3 years and 100 years.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing place

reviewsWithKeywords.title: We just loved it.

reviewsWithKeywords.text: Praia da Falésia is a wonder and beauty of Nature, an authentic paradise.It is an extensive sandy area of more than 5Km of beach, from Praia de Olhos de Agua to Vilamoura, incredible and stunning cliffs with unique contrast colors.Considered one of the best beaches in the world, walking along the beach and the cliffs is a charm!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice beach with stunning cliffs

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Praia da Falésia a must to see

reviewsWithKeywords.text: I stayed in nearby Aldeia da Falésia last year and discovered the beach and café-bar. Brilliant location, gorgeous scenery, staff at the café are very friendly and make a fine coffee!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Not the Caribbean
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We have been coming to this beach for over  30  years . It is clean , it is wide and it has spectacular cliffs and scenery . As one that loves Caribbean beaches with white sands and warm waters , I can understand some comments . But Falesia is what it is . Not a Caribbean beach but a wild natural landscape with  a stunning backdrop . The Atlantic is cold !!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Overrated beach.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I don't know why people love this  beach.  It's nothing special at all. And definitely not the best beach in the world. Clearly some people haven't traveled to the Caribbean.Firstly this beach is hard to get to. You must drive on unpaved gravel roads. It's a narrow beach with no amenities like showers and change rooms.It has one overpriced restaurant. The waves are insane. Not for kids that's for sure.Praia de Tunel is way better.

reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach with ochre cliffs.The water is clean and clear, with very few waves. You can swim away with your feet

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Not for all
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very long beach in a beautiful setting.  Dont expect many amenities,  bars , shops etc.  No showers to wash off , no pedalos or jet skiing here. Making your own entertainment is a must. Some areas are not easily accessible for elderly or less abled.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Big cliff
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach has many good things. I'll tell you.1 - It is huge, so even if there are many people it is easy to find quiet areas. 2 - It has some chiringuito along its extension.3 - Paid umbrella area on each of the staircases.4 - It is very flat and long so if you like walking is your beach. You can run perfectly even with sneakers. It is beautiful, different and the water is very crystal clear.5 - It doesn't have much swell so padel surfing is made comfortable.Council: If you drive and load..... As was my case, go with the vehicle to the end of the tarmac road. There's a roundabout, you stand there and let them get off with all the barbells. Then you have parking nearby. Use Google Maps and see how close it is. I leave you some pictures to help you.  It is almost everything down from the car park to one of the main downhills. We went when there were already a lot of people and still there was a lot of room to park in the place I indicated. In Google Maps it looks like you can park on the road descent but it does not, there are pivots on both sides to avoid this.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Praia da Falesia, what a beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: One of the nicest beaches in the world.  The landscape with its “sandmountains” is spectacular.  The beach is wide and I have never seen it crowded, you can walk for miles….

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Must see!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach and big enough, come in the morning because it fills up fast.The cliffs make it a must-see beach in algarve

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Oasis of peace
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very long beach suitable for those who want to relax independently or want to stay away from the rest of the people given the vastness of space it has.Characterized by red cliffs and a soft golden sand that makes every step by the sea almost seem like a caress.It is absolutely not one of the most beautiful beaches in the world as the Portuguese claim but I loved it.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Pretty but crowded in summer
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice beach but very crowded in summer. You have to be patient to find a good place especially in August when the big tide coefficients.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best in the world.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nicest beach in the world? I think so. Beautiful turquoise waters remaining shallow for a considerable distance, overlooked by gorgeous red cliffs and usually bright blue skies. Definitely worth a visit!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Relaxant
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Falésia Beach, located in Eyes of Water, is one of the most impressive jewels of the Algarve, known for its extent of golden sands, crystal clear waters and imposing red cliffs that create a postcard setting. This beach offers a bathing experience that combines natural beauty with tranquility, making it an unforgettable destination for those who visit the region.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Spectacular and very nice
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Excellent beach, super clean, sand without stone, water a little cold but tolerable, although there are hours when you do not feel so much cold, there is no strong surf, children can enjoy quietly.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely simple friendly beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Best beach of our holiday so far. Wanted to try somewhere new but not a long drive away from Albufeira. There are a number of sunbeds and parasols for hire but not huge numbers. With most families bringing their own we did it have an issue. The sea is beautiful with the red cliff backdrop and you can walk out quite a way before having to swim. There are a lot of steps down to the beach so I’d recommend you buy drinks etc at the snack bar at the top when you arrive. They do takeaway and eat in pizza, baguettes, salads for lunch but prepare to queue! Definitely worth a visit 😊

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Overrated
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nothing special except the cliff but super crowded. Few umbrellas available and even if you just want to lay out a towel difficult to find a space

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great day at an amazing beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Omg what a beautiful beach! My husband and I truly enjoyed our visit today. Parking was a nightmare but we lucked out and got a great spot. A little tough walking back up if someone has disability or walking issues. The little bar is nice but because of the crowds you will wait at least 30 minutes for a hot order . To be expected due to high volume of tourists .

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A must see in the Algarve!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: One of the most beautiful beaches in the Algarve! The beach is large, the water is warm, there are not many waves, it is ideal for swimming. The ochre cliffs just behind you are exceptionally beautiful.Place to absolutely see in my opinion.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Falésia Sempre
reviewsWithKeywords.text: On Birthday.. We will be back soon..  It has apartments for rent, swimming pools for adults or children, shadows, with regular maintenance..

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful landscape, excellent for some walks.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beach elected the best in the world with a stunning cliff and a wonderful view.The variations of the color of the cliff and its height to the sand of the beach create a unique environment that makes us breathe deep and enjoy this little paradise.At the top of the cliff, it's fantastic to see the roots of the trees come out of the cliffWater is at a very good temperature, beautiful landscape, excellent for walking.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Super strand
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great beautiful beach, clean fine waves.Not too busy.Berliner bulbs are sold by people who live there. They walk around on the beach.You can rent sunbeds and umbrellas.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Spectacular Golden Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is beautiful, spectacularly golden, very clean and the sea really is crystal clear.  We sunbathed without another soul around (it's a really long beach, it goes on for miles) and the kids swam in the sea, bit chilly for me, but I did a paddle.  It's close to where we stayed, Aldeia do Golf, and although easy to get on to from the Marina end, there is a quicker route to get directly on to the beach - but the sign is easy to miss, unless you actually stop by the main traffic lights in to Vilamoura and have time to look!  It could be much better signposted.  Plenty of free parking too and we walked directly on to the boardwalk and beach from the car park.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Not for buggies!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: First there are some stairs to overcome, first down. With buggy absolutely not easy! Beach itself is very nice but busy! When closing stairs up also difficult and especially with buggy, although the bar upstairs is a big plus! (Ice cream is also possible)!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Incredibly nice beach. Clean and beautiful water. There is parking a bit away but otherwise no cars allowed.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Superb beach, the most beautiful in Algarve in my review
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach, the most beautiful in the Algarve Clean and hot water.Very few parking spaces (except on praia grande near armacao do pena, it is difficult to park near the beaches in the Algarve)Small snack with toilet at the top of the beach c is convenient

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful but not as wonderful as they say
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A beautiful beach but definitely not the most beautiful in the Algarve. I believe that the fame of the best beach made us frustrated when we visited... but it is beautiful, huge and clean.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Pretty
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Parking would be limited on a very busy day. A little trek to the actual beach itself. It’s a little narrow but very pretty beach. Deck chairs and  umbrellas can be hired. Avoid all together with an onshore storm wind. Otherwise I would definitely return.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very long and particular
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach stretches for km between the village of Vilamoura and the town of Albufeira, is deep, equipped, with several dining options. The main feature is to have behind a long chain of reddish rocks, eroded by the wind, which are called cliffs, which create a show of colors with the sunset light. Beach not very crowded, also suitable for families.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Gorgeous experience
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is incredible and such friendly people. It wasn't till the second day we noticed the umbrellas to the right for the restaurant and we much preferred there as it was a bit more peaceful.Couldn't ask for more from a beach - wonderful place

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach but increased Thefts!! Beware!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach, BUT.. someone broke our car window which was parked in the parking area next to the beach, took our belongings including bags which had wallets from the boot. So, we ended up calling the police and going back! Thefts have increased near the beach this year, so please dont keep anything valuable , your IDs etc., in the car. There is police patrolling the area, but these criminals know the gap between their patrols and have been increasingly targeting tourists this year near the beach! The police were quite helpful and they themselves told us about the increase in thefts near the beach area. We had gotten out of our car, went down to the beach. Came back up in 10 mins to get some cash for the Lidos and discovered the car was broken into! So it happened quite fast. :/ Those criminals must have kept an eye on us when we got there to have done that so fast. Unfortunately for us, the trip ended being a nightmare thereafter. Always advisable to get travel insurance and rental insurance if you are renting a car( which most tourists do).

reviewsWithKeywords.title: An inspiration!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: One of the most beautiful beaches in the Algarve, with its cliffs and transparent water, large extent of sand to stroll. Improving ⁇  access to the beach and support infrastructure for swimmers.

reviewsWithKeywords.text: I came here for the 1st time in May to thos stunning beach, breathtaking I'm back in Olhos now and going tomorrow 🇵🇹 🇵🇹 🇵🇹

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Immersed in red, white, turquoise, wonderful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: One of the most beautiful beaches ever seen for sand, water, rocks that form a backdrop with breathtaking colors and which seems to never end

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Long walk and very beautiful colors.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Starting from Ohlos de Agua the beach is several kilometers long. A little crowded near the access points but very easy to be very quiet by moving away a little. Allows you to make a 15km round trip while walking on the sand. Very beautiful colors thanks to the cliff which dominates the beach. Several accesses by stairs with parking.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Gorgeous
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Gorgeous beach with miles of golden sand. Access isn’t easy but various points that take you down to the sand and sea. Not a piece of rubbish in sight. Perfect for a morning stroll or evening wander.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: We are opposite the EPIC SANA ALGARVE hotel, the place we stayed!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A wonderful beach to stay at, although the sea is still very cold, but it is beautiful!! But the formation of cliffs around the sea makes the beach more enchanting. It's wonderful, I highly recommend it!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Relax, sun and sea. Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very wide and beautiful beach, about 5 km long with beautiful water. You can take long walks with a stop in one of the small bars

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Kilometers of sandy beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very beautiful, spacious kilometer-long beach with beautiful rock formations. You can walk for kilometers. The beach is accessible via a few wooden walkways.At sunset, the rocks glow in beautiful colors.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Sunrise
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We went there at half 5am cause we went to see the sun rise. But unfortunately it didn't rise from that location.But when it started to get bright it looked like a beautiful place

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Things to do on Praia da Falésia beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a fabulous beach with soft sand and interesting rock pools at low tide. Plenty of deck chairs and umbrellas for 20€ a day (2 bed and Brolly). There is also a Massage hut near the entrance to the beach  (50€ full body) and it’s one of the best I’ve ever had.The O Golfinho restaurant serves snacks and meals, and I’d definitely recommend the strawberry or mango daiquiri… well worth a visit.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Praia do Falesia
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Attractive place ! Praia do Falesia Olhos de Agua..Beautiful and has a finest golden Sandy Beaches. Featuring a nice and beauriful Ocean clean. Clear water & blue color. And a mountain high. Red brown of the color is a nice Opportunately. The place is greatful. Is on the eye of a tourist attraction. Super gorgeous. At the Portugal. Praua do Falesia beach. A lot of magnificent rocks and shell around.  A must..

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Algarve Pearl
reviewsWithKeywords.text: After seeing all the comments saying that this is the number 1 beach in Europe and one of the most beautiful in the world, I come here to give my positive vote because everything here is beautiful, beautiful cliffs, huge beach, white sand with no dirt, incredible . I loved it even though the water is still cold at this time of year lol

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best holiday's
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Falesia is one of the most beautiful beaches in the Algarve, I recommend it because it is huge, wonderful, there is plenty of space to park if you take a car, and for children to play it is ideal.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A good beach.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A very comfortable beach. I went at the end of April, it wasn't very hot yet and the sandbanks weren't crowded. It was a very pleasant period.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful and relaxing. Good access with wooden stairs and benches along the way but you need to have reasonable mobility and strength. There are reasonable priced loungers with umbrellas for rent at the bottom of the stairs if you don't want to carry yours down.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: too quiet
reviewsWithKeywords.text: there is nothing much at this resort unless you are a total sunworshiperfinding out bus times was a nightmare so often had to get taxis back to resort

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great Experience at the beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It was a beautiful summer day and the sun was shining bright. The sound of the waves crashing against the shore was soothing and relaxing. I could feel the sand between my toes as I walked along the beach, enjoying the warmth of the sun on my skin. The salty breeze blew through my hair as I sat down on the sand and watched the seagulls fly overhead. It was the perfect day to be at the beach, and I was grateful for the peaceful moments I was able to enjoy.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great Place to Visit
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Just amazing when seen for the first time, walk the beach or hike above it is definitely worth a trip the Praia da Falesia. Just the combination of ocean and very high hills is wonderful.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Magnificent
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Fantastic long beach, peaceful, with lots of magnificent rocks and shells around. Good facilities. Worth it: the drive down to the parking lot is rather steep and narrow.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Good
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It's very good, super beautiful. Thank you very much for buying the baby girl, zs. I've been hanging around here and you're right, but it still looks good.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach, I hope they don't ruin it...
reviewsWithKeywords.text: For me, it is one of the best beaches in the world, yes! I've known this beach for years, cliffs in a natural state, clean water, quality tourism, wonderful! I hope they don't ruin it with the current plans to install a desalination plant on this beach! :(

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: An amazing beach! Beautiful sand, sandstone cliffs, swim friendly seas, the walk down to Villamora is amazing if your able.. No words just look at the pictures.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice Place 5 Stars
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Praia da Falésia is a paradise beach located in Algarve, Portugal. With its fine white sand and mesmerizing maroon cliffs, this beach offers stunning natural scenery. The clear and calm sea water is perfect for swimming and water activities. Other activities such as sunbathing under the warm sunshine and strolling along the long coastline make for an unforgettable experience. Praia da Falésia is truly a gem for those seeking tranquility and natural beauty on their beach getaway.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It was a really nice place! Went there with a few friends for the first time and had an amazing time. The food was delicious, the company was excellent - what more could you ask for?

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Absolutely beautiful beach. We visited in July and it was never too busy, we loved walking along the waters edge, so peaceful and the cliffs behind the beach are amazing.We loved it so much that we are visiting again in September this year.The best beach we have ever visited.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach. Our hotel room overlooked Falesia Beach.There are many stairs to go down, but it is worth it.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Afternoon with bright sun.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We chose this beach and it was phenomenal. Good choice, very well spent afternoon, I recommend it as it was very good, relaxing and calm atmosphere for those who need to rest.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A wonder of nature!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A stop on this magnificent beach is essential during a stay in the Algarve. This place is magical, the sea is calm and the sand is fine! We love.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Just been voted the world's best beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This has just been voted the world's best beach and I can say it totally deserves this accolade. It so clean and lovely to walk along you can spend many an hour here - but remember the sun cream

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Truly a comical assessment
reviewsWithKeywords.text: But is this really the most beautiful beach in the world? RidiculousEvidently the Portuguese voted en masse for the only decent beach in the state....are you kidding me? The fact that it overlooks the Atlantic Ocean already makes it a mediocre beach in terms of the colors of the sea, then I really don't find anything attractive about it. Addressing those who gave these votes, I ask: have you ever been to Sardinia? Or the Balearic Islands? Or in Lampedusa? Or in Corsica? Or, even worse, on some island in Polynesia? This assessment is truly, truly ridiculous. I'm surprised that Tripadvisor took it at face value.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Unique beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A very attractive beach with the colours of the cliffs contrasting with the sands, blue skies and seas.Its an interesting contrast to the golden cliffs and sea stacks of other areas of the Algarve. It reminded me of some remote beaches I'd been to in Western Australia, but here it has resorts around so is much more easily accessed.On a sunny and windless winter's day it was warm enough for the kids to play in the sea, they enjoyed the waves (which may be too rough for younger kids).You can go strolling for some distance in either distance, and at the western end continue on to Olhos de Agua either by hopping rocks at low tide or on pathways above the beaches and rocks at high tide.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: exceptional colours
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Fantastic walk on a wide beach, which we followed from Praia Maria Luisa towards Vilamoura. There is a stretch where you have to be careful because you cross some rocks which are a bit slippery, but it is quite limited. There is the possibility of taking a long walk on the shore. The colors of the cliffs are spectacular and you almost don't realize how many kilometers you have travelled. Highly recommended for those who love these scenarios

reviewsWithKeywords.title: My favourite stretch of beach…
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Love the coloured cliffs along this beach. Wide open seas with pristine sandy beach for about 6 km. You can also walk on top of the cliffs and look at the ocean from up high. A beach not to be missed.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Tripadvisor never lies
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Since I was in the south of Portugal, I searched on Tripadvisor which were the winning beaches and I found this beauty. Since Tripadvisor doesn't lie, I told my family that this beach was among the best in the world and there we went. The reality exceeded our expectations. It is a corner where beauty emerges everywhere and your senses come alive.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Without further ado
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We were quite disappointed. Especially because we went at high tide. Parking is a bit complex and the water is quite cloudy. The color of the cliffs is curious but apart from that... nothing relevant

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A beautiful beach with golden sands and stunningly coloured cliffs. Whilst we didn’t make use of the Atlantic Ocean other than a paddle, we did enjoy a long walk on the wet sand in glorious sunshine.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The best beach I have been on ( I have been on a lot) and temp was 25-31 degrees Celsius every day. Water was swimable but waves were a bit much for older but great for surfing lessons and body surfing

reviewsWithKeywords.title: What a Fun aTrip
reviewsWithKeywords.text: When you read that this is one of Europe's best beaches, you will look forward to seeing it. But when you get there you will not believe how beautiful and amazing it is. The sand is like powder and the cliffs are like a painting.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful scenery
reviewsWithKeywords.text: the most beautiful cliffs in algarve. The water was perfect and the sand was very soft.It was not crowded.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A lovely sandy beach in its own right but truly excellent when combined with the adjoining beaches either side of it.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Let’s get the negatives out the way straight away. This beach is not easily accessible for those with mobility issues. Both the entry points at the Albufeira Surf Adventure and the Algarve Gardens Sports Resort involve steps, especially at the surf adventure where the wooden staircase down to the beach is an impressive piece of mechanical engineering. Also Praia da Falésia is not blessed with facilities, with the Strandbar Alfamar at the Garden Sports entrance being about it.If either of these points cause you trouble then perhaps you are better off initially using  Praia do Barranco das Belharucas  or  Praia do Poço Velho which flank this beach where the access is easier and the facilities greater. From both of these you can walk to Praia da Falésia which is worth doing as it is a vast expanse of sand with no rocks And the advantage of the scenery made by the very colourful rock formations of the cliffs that line the beach, shielding the beach goers from the few hotels on this section, which are built back from the cliffs away from view. If you do combine all three beaches then it forms a 5km plus stretch of sand stretching from Olhos de Água all the way to Vilamoura. This is a fantastic promenade, which the locals undertake in their numbers.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely public beach suitable for long walks
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely public beach suitable for long walks. Gets busy around 10am, but if you come before that you can mostly have the place to yourself. You can rent a beach chair and umbrella for the day if you like, but you can also bring your own. Limited food and beverage options - one small café. Surf school for those inclined, some local surfers. Getting to and from this beach involves plenty of stairs (100+), so it might not be suitable for people with mobility problems.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Natural beauty
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach, especially for the stunning colors of the cliff. Excellent accessibility and calm sea for children. The best of many beaches I've been to.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Breathtaking landscapes
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very long beach where you can get lost in long walks surrounded by cliffs with colors ranging from red to white similar to a canyon..possibility of renting sunbeds and umbrellas at reasonable costs..for the rest all free beach. Too bad I wasn't able to swim in when was the presence of a bacterium in the water reported?

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We stayed at the Epic Sana which has direct beach access to Praia da Falesia beach. A long wooden staircase down to the beach which makes the beach even more dramatic as you descend. A beautiful wide beach perfect for walking, swimming, sunbathing and people watching. You can rent sunbeds and umbrellas for 12 Euro for the day for 2 sunbeds. Or just throw your towel on the sand and chill out. A super clean beach with no trash or seaweed. Rolling waves to do some body surfing. The stunning cliffs make a perfect backdrop for your photos. A top 10 beach in our opinion!!!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very beautiful and spacious beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We were very happy when we discovered this beach in the Algarve. Because it is so big, the people are spread out very well and you can relax well. It is also easy to find a parking space and not too far away. The water is also much cleaner, doesn't smell at all, has little algae and is very clear. It also has very nice waves. Sometimes there was a layer of oil in the sea, but that wasn't too disturbing. It is beautiful with the red rocks and very easy to get to. You can also rent loungers and parasols. Highly recommended!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best beach on the Algarve coast!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Undoubtedly the best beach on the Algarve coast. Fantastic sandy beach with crystal clear water and a fantastic view. There is lots of life and people here, so please come early. A bit expensive for a sunbed (19 euros), but it's worth it if you plan to be there for a whole day. There is also a small cafeteria with food and drink at reasonable prices and good toilet facilities.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Spectacular!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Fantastic!Large and beautiful beach surrounded by red cliffs!Spectacular!Parking along the road is always full, it is better to enter secondary roads where you will certainly find a space, there is also a very convenient dirt road and very close to the beach.Fresh water and without algae.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing place - portuguese grand canyon
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Truly a place that takes your breath away with its pristine natural beauty.It's like being in the Grand Canyon by the sea.It's not that easy to find parking but it's not that impossible even in August.The beach is endless and also offers paid umbrellas.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach at the foot of the cliffs
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach at the foot of red earth cliffs. The beach is long but not very wide so to find space you have to walk a bit like parking. It is better to park in the designated parking lot (600m from the beach) rather than trying to get as close as possible in the small street that goes down.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning crag
reviewsWithKeywords.text: One of the most beautiful beaches in the Algarve.A beautiful view from above. Behind the beach is a red/orange cliff which makes everything more suggestive.The ocean creates nice waves, I think it's possible to surf.I visited this beach in August and it was really very/too crowded, even finding parking wasn't easy at all.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: From a movie ♥️🇵🇹
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Look, there are beautiful beaches in the Algarve, this is the second year I've traveled to this country, but this beach is spectacular, the mountains are like the Colorado Canyon, the beaches are huge with fine sand and lots of space.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Accessible, very large, no stones. Easy to park. You won't be on top of each other. Thanks to the cliff it is well protected and you will be able to take beautiful photos.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: For us, the most beautiful beach in the Algarve
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Accessible via a public staircase that goes down behind the Portobay Falesia and 3HB Falesia hotels, this beach lined with ocher cliffs will delight you. The water was cold at the end of July - 19 degrees max but its setting is so unique and magnificent that you will be delighted. Very wide strip of sand, easy for playing with children, a few bars/restaurants - Really great!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A wonderful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A wonderful beach, but SOOOOO many stairs to go down an up again. The sand was so soft, the sea was so warm and the restaurants looked so inviting.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful sandy beach with perfect snack bar a walk away
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful sandy beach keep walking for traditional bar cafe called Praia dos tomates.   Traditional food at half the price of the ones at the beginning of the beach. A good walk from the start of the beach, say 30 minutes or so but walking along the sea front with the waves splashing against your feet keeps you cool! You will see it up on the right up half a dozen steps with big parasols. Very friendly too

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great for relaxing, not much to do
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely beach for relaxing, however not any boats or activities to do. Cafe at beach is cash only, so have to walk a bit further away to other cafes / restaurants.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is very long with beautiful background and with nice waves perfect for surfing. You can swimming, catching the waves, surfing or just walk and enjoy the view. This place is amazing!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Alfamar Beach and patio suite shuttle bus.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We visited this beach from the Patio Suite. They called Alfamar beach. Great shuttle bus service from the the Patio suite. Just walk along the sandy path to the beach. Great little bar and toilets. You can hire sunbeds and beach shades for 10eu or 15 for the day. Amazing beach you can see for miles. No steps or step paths down to beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Wonderful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: An excellent long beach with varied access from different points. Very flat great for swimming and any beach games. All backed by stunning cliffs

reviewsWithKeywords.title: I'd go back anyway :)
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A beautiful, clean, quiet beach. Vast width so much space. I spent most of my time near the beach entrance from Aldeamento Alfamar Beach Resor. This entry point slopes downwards and has stairs that are not at all steep. Beautiful views from the cliff tops. You'll find people paragliding there too.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach with stunning cliffs
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Such a beautiful beach with stunning cliffs and lovely headland walks. Just take a wander along or settle down on the sand for a few hours of bliss.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely beach to sit on, walk along or swim at!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful long stretch of sandy beach lined with cliffs that are dramatic and so photogenic! There are some areas with beach umbrellas & sunbeds that you can hire, and some restaurants that offer drinks/ice creams as well as lunches and dinner. We tried O Golfinho where we had beer & wine (lovely!) and then another day we popped in to Mare at Pine Cliffs for a morning coffee. Both had beautiful views from every table, and just a lovely vibe. We walked from Olhos d’Agua via some steps behind the 3HB resort, this takes you down through some beautiful trees and the view to the sea is gorgeous.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beach perfection
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a most beautiful stretch of beach with an excellent slope for sea bathing. And in very fine April weather not at all crowded.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful stretch of beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely walk in the sun. Cliffs are stunning. We set out on Ohlas De Aqua beach, walked left over the rocks as tide was far enough out and took a nice leisurely 2 hour walk along until we reached Vilamoura Marina.  3 beach cafes/restaurants with WC/ beds and parasol available along the way. Bridge over into the Marina, turn left and follow the road around, nice shops and restaurants all around the harbour. Took the number 9 bus back to Ohlos De Agua for 2.40 euro each.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A beach not too be missed!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Gorgeous stretch of uninterrupted fine sandy beach with coloured cliffs most of the way. Cliffs had fissures that made them amazingly beautiful. Different colours can be found in certain sections. It is a 6 km stretch with cafes dotted along. Hardly any shade though if you plan to have a picnic.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Is an amazing place. Beautiful beaches. Nice restaurants, amazing service and people.Supermarkets and pharmacy around.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fantastic Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A very Beautiful beach, with panoramic views of the Ocean.  Very clean beach. The beach stretches for miles in both directions and is a beautiful walk

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Red rocks
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Amazing beach. The red rocks are great. Beautiful views, ocean breeze. The perfect place to running.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Dream beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: An amazing beach with soft white sands and very mild surf. They have a surf school to learn on the mild waves and it’s a perfect place to play with little children. Two restaurants on the beach so you don’t need to climb the stairs but once ( they don’t call it beach of cliffs for nothing). There is an elevator at the western end of the beach up to Pinecliffs resort but there are still a fair number of stairs involved.  Not wheelchair accessible

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Wonderful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: An amazing beach and like the others in Portugal were very clean.  Nearby was a bar which was serving food and drink all day along with sun beds available to hire for the day for €10 each.Suitable for all although it is the Atlantic so the waves can be strong at times, but still suitable for all.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beaches that go on and on...
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This certainly beats the Isle of Wight for the coloured sand cliffs! Not many places to eat or drink along the actual beach itself but that would only detract from the beauty of the place.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning beach ...
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a stunning looking beach … the sun catches the different coloured orange and yellow sands in the tall cliffs which reflect a warm hue. The actual beach sand is a fine grain golden yellow. The waves crash in to the beach with a genteel ferocity that creates a white surf for the swimmers and surfers alike. There a couple of restaurants dotted along 5km length of this part of the Algarve coast. The police patrol on buggies.It’s a stunning piece of coastline.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning beach-a must see!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Stunning beach!!You must go and see it for yourself.Soft glittering sand and so clean.Waves were high when we visited so be very careful with the undertow.Nice cafe on the beach serving drinks lollies etc.Sunshades and  sunbeds were reserved for us by our hotel and most appreciated.Can’t wait to visit again!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fantastic beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach with a lot of sunbeds to rent for an affordable price. Clean beach and a fantastic restaurang O Golfinho right on the beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Go for the freshwater springs to the west of the beach.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is quite amazing. Having come down onto the beach from the Pine Cliffs Hotel, the multi-coloured cliffs are very striking. There are a couple of restaurants and sunbeds for hire. The beach drops away and best time to visit is low tide when you can walk over towards Praia de Olhos de agua and experience the freshwater springs coming up out of the sands and rocks to form pools, streams and its also clean and drinkable, No one mentioned these to us at the hotel, but go at the bottom end of low tide. The beach sand is gritty and sharp, not rounded. There are surfing instructors as well. Great beach out of season.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: nice und to repeat!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lagos was the best place. Beautiful, sunny, easy to ride, nice people, not so expensive. The jjaponise food was great.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Sandy beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely clean sandy beach , reserved sunbeds and canopy via hotel. There’s a little cafe that serves snacks etc . Limited seating area . Toilets available but they are not very clean ( no lighting, paper towels )

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fantastic
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Unreal beach. So clean and plenty of clean rest room facilities, lifeguards. Perfect sandy beaches. Crystal clear waters. Walk for miles and beyond with some breathtaking scenary of the cliffs. Best beach ever. Enjoy

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Excellent beach. Crystal clear turquoise sea, golden sand . Cafe at the top of the stairs, donuts on the beach.A real gem.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach.We hired the sunbeds. It was €15 for two beds for the morning (until 1.30pm oddly). €30 for the whole day. Our two kids just chilled on towels next to us. We purchased tickets through the shop on site (was only one so easy enough). There are areas where people (mostly locals I assume) just put up umbrellas but it seems to have been prohibited to put them up in front of the paid sunloungers. I suppose this has something to do with visibility for the lifeguard/sun lounger guy.Sea itself was glorious. Only 25m or so from back of the beach to the water and exceptionally shallow decline. Beautiful spot to chill out. Hope this is useful info for someone.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very nice beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful sand and on a nice day, turquoise sea. The beach isn’t too rocky so is pleasant to walk in the sea. Plenty of tourist shops nearby to be buckets spades etc. When the tides in, it’s very hard to do a beach walk anywhere as the beach is surrounded by huge rocks. Definitely one of the nicer beaches in Europe.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach worth visiting
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful long beach, where you can take long walks. It is also very photogenic. The only disadvantage is the accessibility. You either have to take the stairs, or by a car, but there is not a lot of parking spots. But the beach is clean, not too crowded. You can rent a sun bed, costs 20€ - two sunbeds and an umbrella. I totally recommend this beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely clean beach and not at all crowded. Lovely clear water so that we were able to see the fish swimming around us. Reasonably priced cafe nearby.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: great beach to visit
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great beach..... Very long so room for everyone.... very clean.Water great fun as waves break onto the beach... water also great for children as not very deep even quite far out

reviewsWithKeywords.title: MUST SEE
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beach is a must see, absolutely stunning, however access is difficult. There are so many steps even when using the lifts and in the heat it is difficult. PROS: must see, stunning clean beachCONS: restaurants more expensive, access is difficult with all the steps especially climbing back up again, sunbeds expensive ++

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach, good restaurants
reviewsWithKeywords.text: According to the Portobay Falesia info there were 136 steps to the beach but I only counted 80! Not too bad going down but a drag coming up, there are howver lots of benches to have a rest!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: NO OPEN UMBRELLAS ON BEACH???
reviewsWithKeywords.text: There are permanent umbrellas on the beach with lawn chairs for rent. They are about 25 meters from the shoreline. These are on a public beach. Today, we went way passed the umbrellas toward the water. We set up camp about 5 meters from the water's edge so that we would not block the view of the rental umbrellas. We were told that we could not open our small beach umbrella in front of the rental area. That we would have to move to the outer side of the posted signs if we wanted to open our umbrella. Please correct me if I am wrong, aren't all beaches (sand to water) public to all people legally in this country? Can Portugal declare the sand to waterline, private? Is there a Portuguese law that states no open umbrellas on the beaches? Just for your information, I complied with the life guard's request to close my umbrella only because in the beach regulations, which are posted, states that beach goers should obey directives stated from a lifeguard. Thank you

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Just breath taking
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful landscape, gold sand and nice blue water, if you are lucky during summer the water will be warm so it will very easy to dive into the water. Only negative is that at peak times is too crowded, you can barely place your towels and leave space between your neighbours.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach, Have to pay for sun loungers
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach was beautiful, however we visited out of peak times so there was no water activities available other than surfing. There was not many beach loungers but the ones that were there were 10 Euros each, which I thought out of peak times was a bit much as so many of the beds stayed empty most likely for that reason.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It's a gorgeous beach, but not easily accessible to the disabled.Miles of gorgeous sand and fewer people than the neighbouring main Vilamoura beach.  Gorgeous restaurant, if a bit pricey on the beach.   We stayed on a nearby site, Aldeia do Golf, so we walked and when we left we ended up eating at a gorgeous little cafe (and I am annoyed I can't remember the name!) which was about five minutes walk from the beach.  We had charred sardines which were just perfect.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best Cliffs and Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful cliffs and beach. The sea can be strong at times. Many authentic portuguese families here. No litter. Lots of bins and sunbeds.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is amazing and caters for everybody.It's big, clean, nice sand, when tide goes out it's so massive that even with lots of people you wotn have anyone near so perfect for privacy. It's great for kids, safe to play with water and amazing rock pools with little pools to swim on too. It has got toilets and two beach restaurants spaced out from one another.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely clean beach. Very steep wooden steps to reach the sand, approximately 4 flights. Lovely bar at the top of the steps.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: nice bach with high dunes
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very nice sandy beach at day and night time. Great place for walking, running with bare foot, resting, etc.  Good access from all places around. No dislikes, liked everything.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fantastic cliff walks
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Absolutely fabulous walking from Vilamoura down to Praia do Barranco das Belharucas where there is a fabulous beach restaurant   Un spoilt cliff walks,  no health and safety just common sense. Views and formations are incredible. Make sure you have water and sun cream as there are long sections where there is nothing. Best coastal walk  i've had!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach, good for walking
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice beach, great for long walks or just chilling, lots of access points and a few places to catch a drink and a sunset!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Excellent sandy beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We have travelled from the UK far to find beaches like this and here a short flight to Portugal we have the most beautiful, clean beach we have seen in years.  It has been awarded Blue Flag recognition for its clean clear water, pollution free with soft golden sands.  People were enjoying surfing and locals were fishing off the beach for bass.  Access to beach from cliffs is via wooden stairs,  disabled access could be an issue.  Cafe at the car park area is reasonable and served good coffee with seating in a nice sun spot.  A short walk to lovalmrestaurants.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Just a short walk for us, beautiful terracotta sand.  Avoid the cliffs though, sea can be rough with under currents.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice and clean beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A long walk at the beach. The sand is very fine and clean. The rocks behind are also worthwhile to explore.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Mind Blowing
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Wow its  really amazing beach, I love this scenes and natures. This mind blowing feeling and breathtaking. Its different color of sands and sunset are never endless.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Awesome place
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This was just awesome visit, even with water being cold we really enjoyed the place. Ocean, different colors of sand and sunset can’t go wrong

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Simply beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful, clean sandy beach with red cliffs that seems to go on foreverThis beach has a range of restaurants at the Vilamoura end, although not many open  when we were there. Beach is so wide at low tide and the views are simply stunning.  There are walls along the cliffs, we never quite made it to the far end of the beach.   The area is quiet despite being popular with runners, walkers, sunbathers, fishermen and a few swimmers. The beach also has a natural area behind it which has abundant bird life.  There are also areas with sun loungers

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A beautiful beach that is breathtaking . Never packed. A couple of places to eat or get a coffee. It’s a steep descent on steps so be aware of that.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach with amazing view
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Amazing location and views! Easy to reach by the stairs from the hotels. Nice restaurant near by, very clean beach, Love the sea!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Gorgeous long Sandy beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The most amazing, long, Sandy beach. We walked from Vilamoura along the beach one day down towards the Pune Cliff resort in Olhua D’agua. Another day we walked across the golf course and back along the cliff tops with amazing views. Both trips lovely.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: My favorite
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I stayed in Olhos de Agua for 2 months and this was my favorite beach and I visited plenty. Best to enjoy in low season when there are no tourists. Great for swimming or take a walk.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Large beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: What a nice and big beach. We enjoy walking along the sea, stopping for dip in the ocean and sip of the coctails.Defo will come back

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We stayed at a hotel next to the beach, atop the cliff.The beach was clean, lifeguards on duty.Tide was strong, reducing the beach by more than 50% in the afternoon.The sand was yellow and nice, no sharp stones.Unfortuntely there are no services at the beach. No food or drinks anywhere. So BYOB.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Not very Special
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Far from being one of the Best beaches in Algarve!The "Falésias" are impressing, but the sea is normal, nothing special, very windy beach also.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A wonderful beach, sandy and sunny
reviewsWithKeywords.text: At the foot of cliffs, you will find a fantastic beach of sand along the ocean. Very few things, great respect of the natural environment, you also walk during kilometers on the beach and/or on the trails in the cliffs.Enjoy it

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Paradise Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Possibly the best beach I ever been. Beautiful landscape, soft sand and clean ocean. A lovely place to chillout with friends or family.. Recommended.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Spectacular!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Here’s another reason why I love the Algarve!  Praia da Falesia is a class on its own, with a long, fine and clean sandy beach, several kilometres long, and the breathtaking orange, ochre and chalk white cliffs that have been eroded over millennia.  Some portions of the cliffs have been naturally moulded into columns, giving one a feeling that this must be another planet. Words cannot fully describe the awesomeness of this place. All I felt that day was deepest gratitude for being witness to Mother Nature’s work of art, to the Creator of all this beauty.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: On another planet
reviewsWithKeywords.text: One of the greatest beaches to visit. Warm waters and stunning backdrop. Waves also alot more quiet then most places

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Spectacular setting
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A long and beautiful beach flanked by spectacular cliffs, it sure makes for a great walk...at the end (or the beginning, depending on your starting point) there's also a viewpoint, accessible by wooden steps, simply amazing!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Long long beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a very long and beautiful beach, flanked by spectacular cliffs...I walked the full length along the waterline, pure bliss!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful natural beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Gorgeous beach ideal for long walks in the sunshine. The sea can be a little chilly though. Managed to see dolphins from the beach on our last morning.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful cliff beaches
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful cliff beaches make for an excellent stroll or a laid back afternoon on the beach. You can walk over the cliffs with splendid views.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great walk
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely golden sandy beach with views to die for from the cliffs. The sea was toe curlingly cold though it was October.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Magnificent
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Wow !!Beautiful beach, clean and quiet.There are parking to access. You can also walk along the beach to go to Vilamoura.A must to visit.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We visited this beach as our local beach in Albuferia was closed for swimming due to excessive bacteria in the water. Very disappointing for a resort. Falesia was excellent with clean water and nice waves. No bars or restaurants on the beach but up the steps, there was a snack bar which was nice. Not very suitable if you can't walk up or down the wooden stairs.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Pretty Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very pretty beach. Beautiful cliffs but be prepared for quite steep incline to the sea.  Not great forn people with mobility issues.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is far from the best beach I’ve been to on my travels, but it is a gorgeous beach and well worth a little visit. It’s clean, great sea and at the end of the day the sunset was amazing from here.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A beautiful spot
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great beach with impressive cliff backdrop. The walk from Villamoura to Olhos d’Agua took a bit longer than expected but the changes in tempo, use and busyness were fun to observe.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Inaccessible beach for disability
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is at the bottom of a steep cliff, it’s accessed by a steep flight of steps or a sloping roadway. It’s not for those who don’t walk or are unable to walk far, ad I wouldn’t want to take a wheelchair down the slope. There isn’t a bus service and there’s very little to do there. Fine if you just want to lie on the sand and dip your toes in the water.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fabulous  clean well spaced.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We preferred this beach as nearer good beach restaurants .More protected than other beaches with less crashing waves but still strong current. Keep an eye on small children. Would recommend.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I kept reading recommendations to come here and they were not wrong. The beach is simply stunning. No filter required.I stayed at the Vale de Carros so came from that direction. There is a little food place at the top and is cash only, and a little souvenir shop just before it as well. Guys on the beach with little tuck shops such as mcdonalds burgers too.The pictures don't do it justice but the beach really is beautiful and a must visit if you are in the area.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: 5☆ except for the staircase down to it.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: If you are infirm on your legs you will find this beach a problem to reach.  One staircase has 137 steps all be it small ones, ok to get down but a sod to get back up.  Lovely pristine sand and the sea is clean.   Can be very busy at weekends... oh, and no beach bars so its bring your own I'm afraid.  Enjoy.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice Beach but busy in certain areas
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely long sandy beach.  It can get very busy and crowded in some places but as long as you are happy to stretch your legs and walk a bit you can find peaceful quiet stretches. At various points along the beach there are the usual beach lounger operations and also water sports

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The path to the beach surrounded by cliffs and nature is absolutely stunning! The water is really clean and in some spots you can find restaurantes, sunbeds and services

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Excellent hotel
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Stayed at this hotel in August travelled from England . We were so impressed by the measures the hotel put forward . The hotel was very clean , the room was very spacious and cleaned well . The staff were so friendly and helpful . The pool and grounds were amazing . Just now booking to come back beginning of September, can’t wait . Would thoroughly recommend this hotel . Felt safer here than in England .

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Sunbeds
reviewsWithKeywords.text: What's the story with the sunbeds here? Fabulous beach but we are told the sunbeds are all reserved for one week or two weeks so there were no sunbeds available today even though half the sunbeds were empty. Very disappointing for tourists who travelled for some sun during covid restrictions. Is this a covid measure or what? I would have thought the previous system where maybe some beds were reserved but not all of them and then it was first come, first served was a fairer approach? I also didn't see any cleaning of beds which was very active in the beach restaurants.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing beach for families and kids
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Ideal beach to go with kids. Sea  decreases its depth really slowly. Nice sand for playing with kids. May feel crowded when high tide and peak season... but way less than I certain Mediterranean beaches

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Just a great scenic beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Although there are areas with lots of people (like at the beginning of the beach) the beach is long and wide enough to get your ‘personal’ place.Impressive scenery of the sand rocks especially in the evening sun!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best beach in Algarve.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Wide sand space with ease of parking and stark contrast of desertic rocks and the sea, Falesia it's not top pick for cinematic photos but for quality time under the sun and excellent waters for bathing, if you want to rest without worrying about rising tide or being cluttered on small algarve beaches give Falesia a shot.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We go every year here and it never disappoint s.Very clean nice sand and nicer waves.Have but posts up as u down the road now so parking is a bit longer.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: One of the most beautiful beaches in the world
reviewsWithKeywords.text: You definitely have to see this beach at different times of the day.Most beautiful in winter.Great for impressive photos

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Wonderful walk in/ny the sea - peaceful and not crowded.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We came here just before lockdown and the place was peaceful, with wonderful sea to walk in and a small restraunte to enjoy a cool beer.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Tomates Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely parking site, very quiet, few steps down to the amazing white beach, lots of walking and cycling options, no services except rubbish bins, bar/restaurant open at season time.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: lazy days in the sun
reviewsWithKeywords.text: this was a very clean beach water was excellet also plenty of room on the beach,no hassle with people trying to sell everthing under the sun you could laze about for hours

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Always Outstanding
reviewsWithKeywords.text: 28 years coming to this area at this time of the year.  It’s wonderful!  Every the year the shackles of a dark dreary winter fall away as we enjoy the beautiful beach an cliff tops around Falésia.  Often stay at Jardins da Falesia, apartments that are ideally suited to enjoy this quiet area, but there are lots of others including Pine Sun, Victoria Spa hotel, even the Epic Sana Hotel if you’re rich. There are enough bars and restaurants to enjoy a relaxed snack, drink or meal, but at this time of the year everything is quiet and the owners are keen for your business.  If you’re a runner it must be one of the best places to train with beautiful tracks, cliffs, nature reserve and a cross country to train on.  We have been as many as 80 in a group here.  But running is not essential  to enjoy the place. It’s just so peaceful to come with your wife or family.  We love it.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very Beautiful Cliffs, Sand and Sea.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We had a really relaxing time there. I would recommend to anyone! Nice little shops near by and also, there was a restaurant/beer and lift to get back up to the cliffs.  You could use the lift both ways therefore it's really good...

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Algarve has a few sites of course but the beaches represent a big portion of what to see. This beach is worth going to. It's different from others. Easy access and parking. Small restaurant on the beach. At least go for a drink and a walk!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: gorgeous red sand cliffs
reviewsWithKeywords.text: gorgeous red sand cliffs lead to white sand and green-blue ocean. Be careful on the cliffs, there is no barrier between you & the bottom of the cliff. During the swim season, the have a snack bar, bathrooms and a lifeguard.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I visited this beach while out cycling, I probably wouldn't have found this place otherwise, so many thanks to retro cycle hire in Albufeira 👍

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beach and cliff walking at its best
reviewsWithKeywords.text: My wife and I recently stayed at Falesia Beach and walked it several times. A memorable walk was to Villamoura by Beach for a beer and the return via the cliffs. 3 1/2 hours including the beer 😎🍺

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Another great beach in Portugal, very clean and quiet due to the time of year.Warning beware of the tide and getting stranded, there were people swimming though.Dogs are allowed but again it may be the time of year.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: What a Beach and resort
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We have been coming here every year since 2005 both as a couple and now for the last few years as a family with our grandson words can’t describe how beautiful this beach is we spend many hours down on the beach it really is paradise and really is a very special place one thing you must do after spending time on the beach is to go and relax and have a drink at Mare which is on the beach it has fantastic views and a great way to finish off the day in paradise

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Spectacular beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Clean beach, with spectacular cliff backdrop. Stretches foe miles - great for a long walk by the sea.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Break away
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great Beach well worth a visit sound is lovely and clean beaches are well maintained lovely bluewater advise anybody to go down for a dip

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Winter Getaway
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A wonderful beach with kilometres of sand and surf. A Beach wanderers get away. At this time of the year it is very peaceful. The opportunity to shell is fantastic as are the cliffs surrounding the coastline. The area is known for it’s surfing., although the water is quite cool in February.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beauitiful Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: As with the beaches of the Algarve they have their own distinct characteristics. Great views and crashing waves

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Views for miles
reviewsWithKeywords.text: What a stunning beach! You can walk for miles. Picturesque, quiet and serene. A longish walk from the Old Town of Albufiera but so worth it!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Last time here 2006
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Remember it well , nice beach location. Plenty of bars,  restaurants,  beach safe clean for kids. It was Feb lovely and quiet not so in summer season.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Falesia beach is simply stunning. One of the best beaches in the Algarve. Miles of powdery white sand with the stunning red cliffs in the background. We were staying in Vilamoura and on a lovely sunny day decided to walk along the beach to Olhos de Agua. It took around 90 minutes and is a popular walk for both holidaymakers and locals.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Peaceful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely beach easily accessed from Porto Bay Falesia and very peaceful. Granted, I would expect off season to be quieter and it was a pleasure to enjoy the beach without crowds.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful views
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful views and great cliffs. The beach is lovely for a long stroll. Even in winter its worth a visit.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely walks
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely walks along beach collecting shells and paddling in the sea.Golden sands friendly strangers,weather gorgeous.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning & Peaceful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I went over Christmas so was obviously quiet but it's gorgeous, miles and miles of sandy beach and the sunrise is epic!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I don't think there are anything but beautiful beaches in Portugal. This one certainly does not disappoint!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Family vacation to Albuferia
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is just 10mins away from the hotel we stayed. It is an Excellent beach with beautiful gold sand and brilliant views.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Excellent
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Wonderfully clean and expansive beach with great views - cliffs interesting and multi coloured - awkward for access if not fully mobile as steep hill and steps

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Portobay Felecia hotel and beach resort
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Five star with 10/10 rating, we loved it and the beautiful sandy beach was a complete hit. A long stretch of white sandy beach is a luxury to enjoy and bars along the beach make this place a favorite for those seeking a lovely retreat in the sun, accompanied with a glass of Long Island tea or a beer.Not to be missed

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely views
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely views golden sands and warmish sun.Some braver than me were in the sea. Several surfers riding some nice waves

reviewsWithKeywords.title: My favourite beach in Algarve
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is all my family and friends favourite.  It is miles long of beautiful golden sand sheltered by cliffs. Never run out of space on this beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Gorgeous and expansive beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I'm not the biggest fan of beaches, but this one is just gorgeous. It's huge and sometimes feels endless. Beautiful red rock cliffs overlook it so you feel like you are far from the hustle and bustle of the nearby hotels. Worth an afternoon or even a night!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: OUTSTANDING
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We accessed this beach from our hotel and we were totally blown away by the beauty and cleanliness of it.  It stretches for miles in both directions to Vilamoura yacht harbour and the other way to almost the old town of Albufeira.  Great for strolling along on the sand or even on the cliffs above.  Made our few days here most enjoyable.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beach is bordered by beautiful cliffs. Easy to walk on this beach that appeared to stretch forever. Must walk down about 90 steps to access the beach from the main entry point. Few shells to find.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A lovely quiet and clean beach
