reviewsWithKeywords.text: My hotel was close by it’s a beautiful sandy beach that looked pretty undisturbed when I visited off-season. Enjoyed a quiet swim, topless sunbathing without a soul nearby fore myles.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fantastic beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice to see beaches like this. After visiting Algarve for the first time almost 35 years ago it is good to see that the beaches and the sea are the same. Good to seethat there are more servises available as before eg. Nice cafes and toilets. Unfortunately all were closed now in November. Absolutely great nature experience.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Sandy beach spotlessly clean with lovely little bars and cafes close by. Sea is beautifully clear, no seaweed

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Falésia Beach in November
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We spent another week at Pine Cliffs which has lift access to Falésia Beach. With its spectacular cliffs and around 4 miles of pretty quiet pristine beach this is a favourite beach walk either towards Villamoura or towards Olhos D’Agua, around the cliffs.This walk is very much tide dependent as you have to time it to catch low tide. Time it right and you get to spend around two hours in Olhos D’Agua a pretty little fishing village with decent bars and restaurants.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Probably one of the most beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Probably one of the most beautiful beach in Algarve... Why?Because this is a wild area large long and because of falesia... Don't miss it

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Clean. Relaxing, beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely beach, very clean and excellent sand for walking along, the cliffs have such beautiful colour, recommend as a great place to take a walk or just to sit down and relax.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Incredible
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Peaceful relaxing and serene! Everything you could ask for! The colours were stunning and you could walk forever along this beach or sit and ponder whilst the tides turns

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning stunning stunning
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is just breathtaking and so peaceful it is a never ending beach and everything about it is just perfect!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: SO BEAUTIFUL
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Stunning. One of the prettiest beaches I’ve ever seen. Don’t miss it. Not suntanning weather in November but still worth the visit.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beach days
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice beach for a stroll and then a dip in the warm sea water, and soak up rays of sun for a few then back into the sea. The

reviewsWithKeywords.title: excellent
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Just a short walk down 120 + steps from our hotel and back up. Fantastic sandy beach where you can walk for miles. Very picturesque looking out to sea and looking back at the wonderful colours of the cliffs.Near our hotel there were two beach restaurants, but both are closed for the winter by the end of October I believe. If you are traveling by car I could see that parking could be difficult in high season once you have negotiated the pot hole bumpy track. If you can park up in Ohlos de Agua and take the steps down that might be an option.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fantastic beach even in off season.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It was a little cold for my taste this time of year. However, it was very warm and had a great time walking on the beach. The Cliff and rock formations were breath taking.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Just wow.its stunning beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Excellent beach,just wows You with its beauty.And in late October wasn't crowded.You can still get some tan.will back in season some day.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great little beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We stumbled across this beach from Olhos D’Agua and it was really beautiful. Definitely worth a visit!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Olhas de Agua (tears of water)
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Called Olhas de Agua (tears of water) due to the freshwater springs that surface in the bay.  Lovely quiet sandy beach

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Small but lovely beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Fantastic for beach combing and relaxing, some lovely cafes on the front. Best to visit when the tide is out as it is not a wide beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: STUNNING !!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We were there at the end of the day. It was sunny and we just walk close to the water and observe the beautiful coloration and the sunset. It was peaceful and amazing...

reviewsWithKeywords.title: My favorite beach in Portugal
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It is indeed fantastic! Beatifull cliffs with many colors from red to white with yellow ochre prevailing, long sandy beach, clean water. Nice both for 1-2 hours stroll and for swimming.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice beach not too far from Olhos de Agua, which is where we stayed. Chase lounge chars are available to rent for 12 euros for 2. Parking availability can be tough. Nice place to spend a couple hours soaking in the sun.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: What a beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is simply stunning.  You cannot miss this. A walk along when the tide is out reveals its beauty.  Can imagine its just gorgeous at sunset and sunrise.  Will be visiting again to test this out.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning beach with fantastic backdrop
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Stunning beach with fantastic backdrop of the ocre and red cliffs behind it. Has a bit of an undertow so families with young children need to be careful and only go there when there is a lifeguard on duty. Couple of restaurants to hand close by to.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Clean water soft sand and steep sandy cliffs as a backdrop to this beautiful and relatively quiet beach. Water not that warm because of the Atlantic influence but warm enough for most swimmers. Fairly rough at times so care with strong tides and windy days but it is safe. Our grandson loved playing there and building his sand castles!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Fantastic beach 10 mns away from hotels and shops . Very clean , golden sand. Cafes and restaurants on the beach . Great location for romantic walks .

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful....relaxing
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It is generally just a beach.   A couple of beach bars but miles of sand.  Lots of space if you want a bit of privacy but sun bed areas as well.  No beach activities but lovely to walk along.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fantastic hotel
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Just returned from week at TUI Blue Falesia hotel, Olhos’ d’Agua.  Hotel was lovely, very clean, staff very friendly and helpful.  We had a sea view room which was very spacious and had everything you could wish for even free safe which is unusual.  Food was very good with lots of choices.  TUI rep Evie was very helpful and always smiling.  There’s not a lot to do except relax which is exactly what we wanted.  Entertainment every evening which was good.  Good bus service to Albufeira and Vilamoura  if you wanted to get out and about.  Will definitely be returning.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Huge beach with stunning cliffs
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Take a walk along this massive beach and marvel at the imposing red rocks, reminiscent of Western movies.  Very clean beach a short drive from Albufeira.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fantastic Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We walked here to this beach from Vilamoura. It is an absolutely stunning and extremely long beach which seems to go all the way to Albufeira. We loved it as it was not very busy at all. The sand was gorgeous and we walked what seemed miles up the beach. There are many places to call into and have drinks and each one has its own toilet facilities for the public to use. A really stunning location and a real must to visit so certainly give it ago. There are some areas that did loungers if you wanted them but to be honest the sand was terrific just to lie on.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great beach, sunbeds available, toilets close by, safe shallow sea, plenty to eat close by, our favourite beach

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Soft golden sand, stretching from Falesia all the way to Vilamora. Great views of the cliffs and clean beach

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Gorgeous beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Well worth a visit. The longest beach in Portugal. Lovely clean soft sand, sun beds available for hire.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fantastic beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Amazing beach with golden sands and big waves. Ideal for surfing and paddling! Would definitely return!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: ONE OF THE BEST BEACHES IN THE WORLD
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Quite beautiful - walk along the beach, and feel refreshed ! Some fantastic watering holes along the way as well - check them out !

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A great long beach, with the red/orange backdrop of the rocks, very clean and great to walk to burn off those calories! Many of sunbeds along the way, and some cafes.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The long beach is great for walking to Vilamora.Soft sandy in the surf of the water great exercise takes about 40 mins one way It's layed out under neath touring cliffs which you can also walk along .Sun beds are available at a cost normally by each of the hotels en route The tip of the cliffs make a must go to for sunset views I also go riding with "Paula" along the top of the cliffs - a great trecking experience with amazing views takes all level of experience a must do treck con tact +351968988478  see photos However most access to the beach is assessable only from tip of fluffs meaning alot if steps  going down - there are some areas along the way you can drive to which are more lower down

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Falesia Beach is yet another beautiful beach that is just a joy to visit.The views of the beach are awesome, you have the beautiful cliffs on one side and the Atlantic Ocean on the other,in between you have pristine clean sands and crystal clear waters, waves here are superb ,fun ,then after drying off you can hit some of the beach bars along this vast stretch of sands.Most definitely well worth checking out if your planning a holiday to Albufeira.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Mid morning lounge on beach. Excellent
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I love falesia beach. It is so vast, you can find your own piece of heaven. No matter how busy, there is always space. I prefer the luxury of a lounger. Regardless you can relax (& sleep) if it is your desire. Lots of great bars & eating houses throughout its length. I am a fan of the Thai Beach (lunch or evening meal), or Rocha Baixinha (lunch). You can chill most areas.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: One of the most beautiful beaches in Algarve
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is just amazing, red-brown-white cliffs are just beautiful and make an atmosphere of the place! Highly recommend place to go and enjoy such an amazing Portugal nature! 💚♥️

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is absolutely stunning. Vast and never too crowded. Lovely beach bars available. Sun beds to hire if required. Really great vibe. Love this beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The beach at Falesia by the Alfarma Hotel gardens
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Fantastic sandy beach. No rocks or stones to trip over. No seaweed or debris of any kind on the beach. You could thinkyou are in the Caribbean.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Gorgeous coastline and amazing beach. Quite a lot of steps to go down and get back up however it is worth a visit.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning Beach and Cliffs
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful clean beach with amazing cliffs running right down into the sand. Perfect for a walk on the beach and along the top, and weather is still excellent in late Septmeber.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: 100 steps down from hotel but worth it
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely beach with sun beds and umbrellas.  Toilets are nice and  clean and it has a  nice beach restaurant

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This must be the best beach in Portugal well patrolled by life guards clean sand goes on for miles stunning cliffs

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Worth the walk
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We stayed about 10 mins away and the stairs down to the beach are not for the faint hearted! Lovely blue flag beach.  very clean and the water was gorgeous. Well worth a visit!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Super Sand and Golden Cliffs
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I walked to Falesia Beach from Vilamoura, from where the sands stretch for miles. I'm not one for lazing on a beach but Falesia has a lot going for it. There are cafes dotted along it, linked by a boardwalk, and a vast car park (empty on the September afternoon I visited) but my favourite elements are the golden cliffs. Such a vivid orange when seen from the sea, they are even more impressive close up. Definitely worth seeing from the top, too. I didn't walk all the way to Olhos de Agua but I gather it's recommended.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautifully stunning!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Well, what can be said about this beach! Each time we came round the corner and were met with the view of this beach we simply ‘wowed’ ! Beautifully quiet, clean, huge! Cafe and toilet facilities at the top. Just stunning 😁☀️

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Outstanding
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Wonderful beach stretching from Falesia to Vilamoura Marina. Just a great beach to enjoy set below the sandstone cliffs. Well signposted regarding specific areas e.g. lifeguard area, parasol area etc. A bit of sea weed at times but overall well maintained by the natural Atlantic tides. Just beware of rock fall from the cliffs.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Gorgeous beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely beach better than Mexico's, can hire sundbeds for the day about 15€, restaurant and toilet facilities on the beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beach with stunning views, we walked one day to vilamoura and others enjoyed watching the sun set . Loads of space with sun beds if you want and a couple of beach restaurants

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Clean beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach but a climb to get down to it and up off it, could do with a couple of cafes as nowhere to get a drink or use the toilets. Was a cafe at the top of the cliff but far too high up to keep going to. Clean sands and beautiful views.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Hidden gem!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Missed this place last time I visited nearby Olhos d'agua but fortunately read a review mentioning this fabulous beach so went in search. At low tide probably easier to find as I believe you can walk round from Olhos d'Agua beach but at high tide, a little climb over the headland, following a well worn sandy path and using the useful man built steps and walkway will get you there. Then, around 3 miles of unspoilt golden sandy beach takes you right through to Villamoura marina. The cliffs are stunning, such colours, shapes and patterns to see. I was fortunate enough to visit a similar beach in Australia (rainbow beach) last year and Falesia Beach is a pretty good match for that! After walking for about an hour or so, a little cafe oasis appears to give you a welcome refreshment and toilets break and then carry on into Villamoura and enjoy a drink / lunch overlooking the marina. Taxi back costs around 12 - 15 euros. Seems a lot further on the inland road to return.......but sure it was only around 3 miles walking........

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Another beautiful beach ❤️ plenty of space. Stunning scenery, cliff faces, the colours. Great fun in the waves as they crash upon the shore......v cold though :-)

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Really nice beach surrounded by red rock which looks beautiful at sunset.  Just a bit surprised that the cliffs overlooking the beach have no protective/safety features - it's quite a drop to the beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is beautiful and when I visited it was very quiet. I took long walks and especially early in the morning I met hardly anyone. The sandstone cliffs make for a stunning backdrop.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely, clean, sandy beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A beautiful beach the cliffs are an amazing sight and the beach is so big that it didn't feel cramped at all during our visits here. Only downside was that we had pushchairs with us and there are a fair few steps to get up and down to get there and not much in the way of refreshments available so just make sure you're prepared with plenty of water/food and you'll be fine! But we managed the steps and it wouldn't stop us returning to this beauty spot.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fabulous beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is one of my favourite beaches anywhere in the world. My husband loves the sea swims and I love a long walk with the waves washing over my feet. I walked for 80 minutes - 40 minutes each way - on this beach last week and could have gone on. With the backdrop of the cliffs and the wonder Atlantic Ocean rolling in, what's not to love?!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: beautiful sands and sea
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach at Falesia is a beautiful and wonderful place to visit. The sands are accessed by wooden steps (a lot) and not accessable for people who struggle to walk or disabled people. The sands are wonderful and the sea is excellent a bit rough at times but easily accessed. Beds are available and there is a cafe at the top of the steps. Highly recommended

reviewsWithKeywords.title: amazing
reviewsWithKeywords.text: this is a must for an early morning walk it truly amazing the beech walls are fantasticand the natural springs are astounding

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great beach. Well worth a visit. Lots of space with a couple of restaurants right on the beach. Lovely clear water.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Clean and big
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great beach with plenty of space and it's kept very very clean. There are lots of options to eat and drink nearby and plenty of sun loungers to hire. If you're staying for a while buy an umbrella and DIY as the lounger rental can be expensive every day.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: One of the most beautiful beaches we have had the pleasure to visit. We had an amazing time in Olhos de Agua, a lovely place and stunning views

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: What a fantastic beach, we were early and managed to park the car near, you then have wooden steps down to the beach, maybe not so good for people with limited mobility as quite steep and in the heat as well, toilets are back up the steps again.2 sunbeds  were 19 euros - so quite expensive, in Rhodes we only paid 10 euros.lovely sandy beach and clear water once you get passed the strip of seaweed. Will definitely  visit again.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a beautiful beach. Nice clean and safe. Nice cafe there. Lovely cliff walk. The red cliff walls are amazing.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Clean beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely beach we had access to a private section of the beach can’t fault very clean and not hassled by local selling vendors

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunningly beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is absolutely gorgeous! Mile upon mile of solft golden sand and wonderfully clean! You'll get a good work out walking down the steps to get to it (and again going back up!) but it's well worth it!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beech
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Something for everyone. Busy areas with beds and shade, locals fishing and playing as well as quite areas for peaceful relaxation.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely Beach but hard to reach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The Falesia beach is accessed by two boardwalk’s , one is next to the Blue Falesia , you have to navigate around 200 steps , the other is in the Pine Cliffs resort where there is a lift and then the board walk to the beach , the beach is lovely and very busy most of the time , there is a beach cafe which is owned by the Pine Cliffs resort , there is also another cafe/ restaurant at the other end nearer to Olhos de aqua , there are also vendors on the beach selling soft drinks and fruit , my opinion is if your fit you don’t have a problem getting to and from the beach , but if you are a bit older stick to the town beach ,

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The best beach in Europe
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is, for me, the best beach in Europe! Warm and clean sea, with no rocks;Very clean. Good services and nice restaurants.To come again!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely long beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: When here fore a few hour and throughly enjoyed it. Would recommend that you take a windbreaker or umbrella as can be windy. Loved the waves but young children need to be supervised as strong current in shallow water.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Go smith
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely beach plenty sun beds clean a resturant on beach nice food but very rushed  lots of steps down to the beach so no good for push chairs or elderly about 150 steps down  one toilet  & gets busy as the day moves on worth a visit 👍

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach never over crowded
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach was clean and friendly I don't remember seeing any dogs. Sun loungers available 6 euros/half day.Very long stretch of beach so it was never over crowded we carried a pop up tent and just as well because there is no shade outside of the loungers which have umbrellas. There is a small bar there. ..ok This is not a negative for me but I must mention that you would struggle getting any immobile or seriously unbalanced person there as you have to go down a very steep staircase to get from road/path to beach. Great experience sea was warm enough and went swimming every day

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Just spent 11 nights in Olhos De agua, spent a good few days on this beach, used the steps down from the hotel 126 in total but easy steps. Sun beds pricy at 15€ for two beds, good rock pooling area too with deep pools to see same life. Also look out for the Olhos De agua springs in the sand near to the rocks

reviewsWithKeywords.title: beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: If you go early in the morning the beach is nearly deserted.Amazing rock formations,long stretch of clean sand and lovely blue sea.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach. Def worth a visit. Our children loved it here, even though the water was chilly even in August.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful, clean Beach!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We visited Falésia Beach this August while on holiday. We parked in one of the streets surrounding the beach - it gets busy so best arrive early. There are some steps to the beach - you’ll need a hand if you have a buggy or struggle with mobility. Once on the beach, although busy, you never feel as though people are crowding your space. the orange cliffs at the back provide a stunning backdrop!! The beach is v clean!! There is a bar at the top of the steps - looked great. It was busy so we stopped off for a lolly in one of the villages as we drove away from the beach mid afternoon. As you walk down to the beach, the views are stunning!!! Well worth a drive out

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely beach but way too busy
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Apparently this used to be quite quiet.  Not anymore. You can’t move within 300 yards either side of the steps in the summer.A real shame as it looks beautiful. The sea is clear.  Does drop off quite quickly but wasn’t any strong currentsAlso the sun beds are €18 for two.  Extortionate.  That is approaching €50 for a family of 5.  But people pay it so it won’t change!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Attractive beach - way too busy
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We went in August - peak season - so we knew it would be busy! We parked about half a mile away and headed for the end of the beach away from the crowds. Spectacular setting but very few facilities other than a few beach sellers. Significant waves and very cold water! Better beaches available for families.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely swimming beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: An expansive beach stretching a few km's. Most enjoyable when the wind isn't blowing a gale as it has no sheltering boulders as many of the other beaches have.  However, it offers massive  swimming areas free of rocks or seaweed. Only negative - should you have little ones or elderly folk, its quite a walk from the car park. Still worth it though.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It’s the first time we’ve visited this beach in the Algarve and it was just beautiful. A nice short walk from our hotel. A few steps to walk down to access the beach but once you’re there you will not regret it. It was a scorcher of a day. I wished we had walked along the beach to see what else they had on offer but the usual were available such as pedalos, boat rides etc. It was packed with locals as well as tourists from other parts of Portugal but there was still enough room to have your private section. I would recommend for all.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Absolutely breathtaking!! Must go 💗
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful sandy beach. The coolness of the water is perfect for summer heat. Stunning view and family friendly.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Cold
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach itself has a stunning backdrop of picturesque cliffs and it is large enough for you to have enough room to enjoy the surroundings without being in other people's faces. We visited in August and the sea was very very cold and we heard that this was normally the case. A major disappointment was the fact that having travelled to many places in the world this was the first place I have ever had my belongings taken whilst we were in the sea. Sadly I should probably look after them better.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Jo
reviewsWithKeywords.text: One of the most beautiful, clean & clear water beaches in the World. Absolutely amazing. You need to walk down a slight hill then large purpose built stairs down the cliff but it’s so worth it. There’s a cafe at the top but we took our own food & drink.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: as it was August the beach was busy but if you walk 10 - 15 minutes you can find a quiet spot.Advice - book a table for lunch, at the beach restaurant, in the morning as it can get very busy in the afternoons.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful, stunning beach.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Walked miles along this perfect sandy beach overlooked by red rock cliffs from Praia de Falesia to Vilamoura. There are several snack bar and toilet stops en route.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is well worth a visit, just to sit and watch the sea and relax. We spent a good few hours there, then went for a cool drink.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful orange cliff beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very long and also a wide beach, although it has a lot of people (also more locals), you are guaranteed to find a place.There are not too many parking places, but there were always some free parking places in the afternoon.The beach is fascinating because of its orange cliffs that stretch over 6km. The sand is very fine and is perfect for a small football game.There are some restaurants at the beach entrances - all in all certainly worth a visit!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Expansive beach with good facilities
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Took our hotels shuttle bus down to the main Falésia beach in Vilamoura. It’s a short walk from where they drop you past some car parks which had plenty of space if you wanted to drive too. A short walk across a bridge brings you to a boardwalk where there are some bars and a shop. You can either hire a sunbed and brolly or just put a towel on the sand. We had private facilities so used the sun beds. The sand was baking as it was a 31c day so very hot. Beach very clean and the sea was refreshingly cold, almost felt ice cold. The sand goes on for miles so plenty of space for all.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Summer holiday
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We had an absolutely brilliant time at this fantastic hotel. The room, food, entertainment and staff were outstanding.  The pool is very big amd the pool area had plenty of sunbeds. The entertainment during the day was great and very varied . The hotel's sjuttle bus was very useful.too.This was the best holiday we have had in recent years and we look forward to returning.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A nice sand beach that offers sun beds, beautiful scenery and a little kiosk. There is always a lot of people there, so you’re not guaranteed a sun bed. We brought our own parasols, and I recommend doing that if you’re a creature of the shade. A great beach for everyone.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Trip to beach with 4 year old.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Love this beach, it seemed nice and clean.  There are a few places on the way to the steps that are a sheer drop and a bit scary but only if you go near to the edge! Keep a hold of your kids on way to steps I’d recommend!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This was an amazing beach with stunning views. The sea is a gorgeous blue colour and the beach is clean. It can get busy at peak seasons but if you walk down the beach there are always clear spots. My advice would be to bring your own parasol if travelling in peak time. They get booked up quick and your own will give you the freedom to base yourself anywhere. Also it takes about 25 minutes but you can walk all the way down the beach to get to Villamora Marina which is also stunning.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely beach with white sand. Not too busy as it is very large. A few beach bars and restaurants dotted about. Plenty of sunbeds available

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely Sandy Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Miles of clean sandy beach. Rolling waves and surf boards for hire. Some water sports activities available but best for sun bathing

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beach with a view :)
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I think that this beach is on top 3 for Algarve, nice view, silent place, good sand and cold ocean!! :)

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Just amazing scenery. The bright cliffs and dazzling blue sea couldn’t be any better. Came here everyday on my 7 day trip.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach!!!!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Loved every second being here.Excellent view from the cliff. Very impressive. Great beach no rocks strictley sand.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: what a Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: we stayed at the Pine Cliffs Resort and this beautiful beach with red rock formation is right in front of this resort. It is 8 km long , with beautiful, soft sand, clear ocean water for swimming, several restaurants on the beach as well, also good for long walks..

reviewsWithKeywords.title: beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach with a long stretch of soft sand and clean water. It is a must visit if you’re in the area

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We walked this beach for four of the seven days we in Portugal. It’s a lot of steps down to the beach, but it is worth it. The beach is a credit to the local people. We saw only two pieces of litter on the beach whilst walking it ( and we picked it up). The cliffs are beautiful. Well worth the visit.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Absolutely gorgeous beach.  The cliffs are phenomenal. Parking in the area is a little tricky. The sand is soft and comfortable. Water was chilly but people still were enjoying a swim

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely Beach.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Falesia Beach was very clean and not too crowded when we visited in July. A bit of a trek down the steps though!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: My happy place
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is amazing.. so peaceful and lovely clean sand and sea. perfect for families and for a wee stroll and an ice cream :)

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach and fantastic view of the Cliffs
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Excellent sandy beach, lots of fun was had by building sand castles.  The water was cold but the kids still loved it.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Access Difficult From Riu Guarana
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Access is via a long wooden walkway and many steps which would be unsuitable for many. Take the branch to the right and you access directly onto a small cove/ beach with no facilities. Go to the left and you can access the main beach but over rocks and only at low tide

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Enormous
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Such a beautiful place. We did the hike on the cliffs for about 3,5kms, breath taking views, then went on to the beach. It’s so big you will have all the room you want. There are beds and umbrellas. Amazing place !

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful but needs easier access
reviewsWithKeywords.text: You have to walk down quite a few stairs to get to the beach at the Olhos de aguas end, other than that it’s beautiful, clean and has amenities like sunbeds/umbrellas and toilets, the Vilamoura end is a little easier accessed but doesn’t have the pretty cliff views.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Gorgeous beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Visited with all my family (group of 12) last June and this beach was stunning, gorgeous white sand and quite a few bar/restaurant options. Really pretty Portuguese beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is one of the best. It is really long so miles of soft sand to relax on. It wasnt too busy either so there was plenty of space. The beach is particularly safe for swimming as it remains shallow for quite a way and is mainly just sandy. There are also plenty of life guards on the beach. The beach is stunning, surrounded by orange sandstone cliffs and pine trees. There are also some rock pools at the end of the beach and you can walk around to another small cove.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best beach in Portugal
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Love this beach!!a gorgeous streach of beach with cliffs behind and a few nice bars to eat and drink at .If you are staying in olhos de agua the beach can be accessed by steps near the portobay hotel which leads you down to the first bar and restaurant which also has toilets and shower facilities. The whole beach is lovely soft sand great for long walks to get rid of that holiday weight you have put on!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: what a gem
reviewsWithKeywords.text: just back from a week at this lovely place set in beautiful grounds with a short walk to an amazing beach.supermarket in east reach bars and clubs also close by.food was first class and the dining area fantastic plenty to choose for all tastes.Loved this place I didn't want to come home so booked another week in August with my two teenage daughters.plenty of sun loungers around the pool or you can either pay I think 15 euros for a couple on the beach.me and the other half had a great week could not fault the rooms aircon and modern Samsung TV not that it was on that much plenty to do I recomend the boat trip to the caves a short ride to the lively resort of Villamora or even a taxi to there or Albufira if you like it a bit more lively.Staff friendly and helpful all round great place cant wait to go back.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beach walk
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Praia Falesia is a lovely beach. It was a bit of a walk down the narrow steps. Snack bar over looking the beach. Very busy with plenty of room for everyone. Few restaurants along the beach. Not much shelter. Can walk to Vilamoura across the beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Pretty beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is very clean and aesthetically pleasing, situated at the bottom of cliffs. However, be prepared to bring your own parasol! The sunbed prices are 9 euros for a half day, and 15 euros for a full one! Haven't encountered that before at any other resort, so that was a surprise. It's most likely because the hotels do not own the beaches.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Reached down many steps and backed by stunning multicoloured cliffs at low tide this is a great place to go beach walking and at high tide lay and listen to the crashing waves. I'm a wimp so only paddled and there was a small area with life guards should you wish to swim. Great photographic opportunities to be had.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Such a beach !
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We had heard about this beach..and yes it was all true!Multi coloured cliffs and dramatic coastline encounterd by 200 steps or less ( depending on access point) or/ and a lift part the way from the impressive Pine Cliffs Resort).If your idea of a beach is commercial and loaded with sunloungers then think again ( certainly in June).Portugal does have its share of more 'organic ' beaches where you make your own sun spot. This is definitely one and it's no surprise that Falesia Beach has been voted one of Europe's best.  A cafe and some sun beds at one point. A small eating area further on. That's it. The rest is just amazing cliffs and sand..oh yeah.. and sun and the Atlantic.  What's not to like?!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best beach in Portugal
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is indeed the place to visit in the summer . Clean water not too crowded .. simply the best.. super hiper recommended

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Mrs
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautifully clean sandy beach with easy access from our hotel  you can gain access to other coves via cliff paths

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Absolutely beautiful. We used this beach whilst staying at aldeia da falesia and found its surrounding and water perfect. Makes you want to emigrate.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very steep
reviewsWithKeywords.text: By far the best single feature of the Algarve is the beaches and Falesia is a prime example.Even in the height of June there is still so much space it's unbelievable!The beach has lifeguards in attedance in marked areas and you can rent a lounger / umbrella, but walk a few yards to either East or West and the beach becomes more and more deserted.There is plenty of parking but be warned,the access road is very steep and there is an equally steep staircase down the cliff to the beach itself. There's a small bar at the top of the stairs and I noticed that surf lessons are now avaialble.At busy times you will need to park at the top of the hill, the prime space go very early.A few minutes walk from the beach takes you to an area with quite a few restaurants and shops.Worth the effort

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Popular but still unspoilt
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Albufeira is sadly now overpopulated, not well kept, and run down in every way, as a town and seaside resort. Falésia beach remains unspoilt, well cared for and popular with the local hotel residents and locals alike. I hope when we return it is as lovely and clean and well cared for as it is right now. Hiring a sun lounger for the whole day is 7.50 euros, therefore 15 euros for two.  (It’s 9 euros for two for just half a day)

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach with dramatic red and cream cliffs. Very popular with locals. Lots of small roads lead down to beach as well as wooden steps from hotels.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Family beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Small beach next to restaurants shops and bars.well used by locals and visitor's.There is another beach nearby called Maria Luisa which is bigger and tends to be less crowded. There is a beach bar and restaurant.Sun lounger and canopy's cost between 15/20 euro's for 2 people.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Holiday
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We stayed in Olhos from the 13th to the 20th of June and visited this beautiful beach a few times.. this is a stunning beach and a handy walk from the hotel we stayed in.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely sandy safe beach, very clean with drinks etc. Nice place to spend the day with life guards on duty.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The place to be
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A beautiful beach, clean and well maintained, offers courses of surfing and diving, parking and a cafeteria at the hand of all those who want to enjoy refreshments, and typical Portuguese beers

reviewsWithKeywords.title: So safe
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very very safe and peace full.life guards amazing even when see is calm.they never off duty well done lads and ladies.so clean such a happy place

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Good place to stay
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I went here several times because we were sleeping at albarve gardens. It is big, you can walk long ways and it is big, so it is possible to get a quiet place (different to another beaches which are small and noise). There are an entry by alfamar hotel, so I suggest you to leave your car in that hotel and go to the beach through it.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very nice beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Apart from sea being freezing cold 😂 the beach was lovely. Long walk down the cliffs on the stairs but worthwhile & not crowded at all.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: One of the best beaches
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Amazing beach, long, comfortable sand, so much space and very pretty with the red cliffs and rocks along it. A good place to take a swim, sunbathe or walk along, and can eventually take you up to Vilamoura.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely quiet beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We visited twice with our 16 month old and each time, without walking far, we got lovely quiet spots on sun beds, without being surrounded by lots of people.It’s immaculately clean, well staffed by life guards, and with good facilities. It’s just a shame said child absolutely hated the sand and refused to touch it....!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beach holiday visit
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is our 5 visit to this part of the Algarve, beach is fantastic, safe and well looked after. Cliff views are amazing.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very impressive beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Miles of sand , amazing sandstone cliffs and loads of sun!  This is a beautiful beach and not to be missed. There are sunbeds available or you can simply lie on the sand. Even on a busy day it isn't crowded because it is so big. There are places to eat and changing rooms as well as toilets. Lifeguards are on duty for those who want to swim safely.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: One of the best beaches I've ever been lucky enough to walk along. Fine yellow sand, gently rolling in sea and fabulous re cliffs.Perfect holiday fodder.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Slightly different than most of the beaches in algarve, yet extremely amazing.This year was the first time visiting this beach with my girlfriend and  we both had a lovely day.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: What an absolutely beautiful beach, the cliffs are stunning the water is warm. Lovely and quiet. A must is to visit the beach restaurant O Golphino fantastic food friendly service beautiful outlook and a Tuk tuk back to resort fantastic

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Safe Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Spent a relaxing day on the sun loungers on this beach. Glorious clear water and lovely clean sand.Well worth a visit.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: One of the best beaches in Algarve
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We dropped by Falesia one morning and it wa quite stunningly beautiful beach. Long and sandy. Great place for kids as well. Good wave for bodyboarders or surfers. The rock formation looked fantastic. Definitely beach for family with kid if you are in Algarve

reviewsWithKeywords.title: beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: this beach is beautiful. you may find yourself mesmerized by the landscape and beauty of the area, dont forget the waves, just perfect for some water fun like surfing or boogie boards. great place to get snacks and drinks there as well

reviewsWithKeywords.title: It was a FAMILY visit.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great stroll along the beach.  Pity we climbed some steps with mi  mam's dodgy knees and got hopelessly lost. No bar. Cripes.  Great beach though, with sand and stuff...

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It's a great beach, beautiful sand and wonderful red cliffs, and sandstone cliffsWaves are useally high 1-2.5m But are nice place to see the sunset or a day at the beach Lifeguards are available most  places

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Stunning like all beaches in the Algarve.  A must see.  Cold in March so you can't swim but definitely sunbathing weather and the beaches are quieter at this time of year.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Visit during May 2019
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very clean and wonderful to walk along! Stunning white sands with nicely placed cafes along the way!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Bit of a track to get to but you will not be disappointed you can walk for miles on probably the cleanest beach in europe

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Long walk
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful long walk along the beach.You can walk miles before you need to get round some rocks to get to the next beach.Stopped about halfway for coffee.Two places to get food and drink.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Is the horizon in the sea showing land (Africa) or just a mirage?
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It is a 5km long sandy beach , with a special dark blue sea which is beautiful in the morning light. You can find diverse shells in the low tide and the currents are safe for swimming. The only caution is to stay away from the pine cliffs as they are in threat of erosion.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: travelling hopefully
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This title isn't meant to suggest that Vilamoura, our destination on a lovely May Sunday, isn't worth arriving at - only that the best part of our experience was the eight-kilometre walk there from Olhos de Agua. It's the Algarve, so the sand is clean and the sea is beautiful.  Whether you start down the steps from the Riu Hotel or across the cliff path from Olhos de Agua beach, you're immediately immersed in lovely scenery, with interesting plants and birds all over the place.There was plenty of time for the four of us to chat to each other, to the Portuguese sea anglers at strategic spots and to other people relaxing and enjoying the air and the views.If you don't feel up for as long a trek as we undertook, there are plenty of access points along the way, but we didn't check out how well connected any of them are to taxis or buses.  However, if you enjoy sunshine and salt water, and get bored just sprawled in one spot, walking the length of Falesia beach is a great alternative!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing beach and lovely view
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very nice beach. The views are amazing, the beach are extremely clean. If your looking for water activities this is not the place, even you can get surfing lessons here. We love this beach and it’s very close to our hotel ( Alpinus ) less than15 min walk

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Family holiday
reviewsWithKeywords.text: What a fantastic place to stay, stunning scenery and lovely accommodation, staff can’t do enough for you, lovely pool and restaurant, breakfast and evening meals available, excellent selection of food available, entertainment every evening, only a short walk down to the beach, stunning views, short walk to reception which is open 24 hrs, friendly staff, short walk to shops and restaurants,

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Miles of uninterrupted sand with stunning red/orange cliffs
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach, easy to find a spot especially if you move away from the sun loungers and cafes. There is also a lovely waking along the cliffs through the pine trees. Sat on the beach and watched the sunrise, definitely a bucket list experience.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful sandy beach that goes on and on. Lovely sea views and eating areas. Weather lovely 32 degrees in May.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: beautiful and clean
reviewsWithKeywords.text: nice quiet and clean beach to visit, kids had a great time.only thing is there was no ships near by

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful views and you can walk for miles. We were recommended this beach by a local and it did not disappoint.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning location!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Make this beach a must-see, absolutely stunning views, gorgeous! Not too over-crowded, beautiful place!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: One of the most beautiful beaches I have visited.  The amazing cliffs make for a fantastic sunset and give off a radiant glow.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Situated in a small cove this is a gorgeous clean quiet beach area with plenty of sunbeds for hire, toilet facilities and varied bars and eating establishments.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning white sands and clear water
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A beautiful stretch of water with clean sand and seas.Approx 8km of beach to walk along with a few level cafes to eat and drink at.Not to be missed.There are approx 100-200 steps down to this stretch depending on where you are staying .

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Absolutely stunning
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I was stunned when I walked up the hill and discovered this most beautiful beach. It really is breath taking with the lovely coloured mountains and pine trees. One of the prettiest beaches I have ever seen .Lovely clean sand and clear water. Could do with some type of beach hut selling cold drinks and maybe bucket and spades etc. They would make a fortune. There is a snack bar at top of the stairs which is really nice.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Praia Falesia
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great place, very impressive, should not be missed, a long walk along the falesia coast is possible, high waves, few people, you can walk on the beach or on top of the falesia rocks

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Amazing cliffs, wide sandy beach. Great place for longer stay as weather is really nice. For all watersports there is also good choice because of the waves.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A clean tranquil beach with sunbeds & shades
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The sea is cold so wear a wet suit if you want to try surfing. The sea breeze here is refreshing, the sand is clean. Steps down to beach. Well worth a visit.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: One of my top favorite beaches!!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is so much fun and kid friendly!!! The waves aren't too large and the beach doesn't get too crowded. It was a clean beach and we stayed in an Airbnb right up the road from the beach and we went to the beach every day and spent the whole day there. My family went to this beach when my siblings and I were younger and they were able to relax without being too worried about us; we (my siblings and I) could run around and pretend to be the Croods (because of the red rocks). I highly recommend going to this beach if you are in the Algarve region of Portugal. It is one of our favorite beaches and if we could, we would go back in a heartbeat!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Long white sands and plenty of space to relax with family. This beach is my favourite here and we simply love it!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: One of my favourite beaches on the Algarve.  It is a long stretch of golden sand with lots of shells along the shore. You can easily find a quiet spot to sunbath or just walk along and take in the views. It is simply stunning with the red cliffs in the background.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Carlsburg don't do beaches ...but if they did !! 😎
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is awesome.....clean fresh ....smells of sea fish and salt as it should ....perfect for families,walkers,paddlers never have a problem finding a pitch on this nutter ...it's like the mother in law it goes on and on and on .....Get on it and soak it up !!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Breathtaking
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is really beautiful, not too crowded and with lots of space for every need whether it is sitting in the hustle and bustle or relaxing somewhere more quiet. Definitaly recommend this beach for adults and children.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fantastic beach, you can walk for ages!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a beautiful wide and very long beach. It is absolutely stunning and like all beaches we visited in Algarve, very clean.   You can walk for ages. It was quite windy when we visited, so I would recommend taking some sort of wind blocking device if you plan to lay on the beach and relax.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The best beach on Algarve
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is spectacular! You can walk all the way from Olhos D'Agua to Vilamoura along the sand. The area around Falesia is beautiful with its high cliffs and stairways down to the beach (not good for people with walking problems). There is a café and toilet facilities at the top of the stairway at Falesia. The steps are steep with 'rest points' at intervals on the way down. There are a few bars along the walk to Vilamoura. The beach is safe for swimming, shoals out gradually and has little surf (in the main). It is possible to drive parallel with the beach to the car park at the Vilamoura end where it is easier to access the beach on a flat approach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Has to be seen
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Has to be seen..  why? Just because it is one of the Spots of Algarve. This place is magic and so beautiful you can't miss it...

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Stretches for miles, beautiful sand, beautiful cliffs. Even when busy you can find space away from others. If you want watersports head towards Vilamoura. They have the traditional stuff.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The Four Mile Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Miles of sandy beaches and interesting cave formations, very clean and safe to swim. Cafe bars are always close by and ample places to park, these may get busy in the height of the season

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Must see!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Spectacular beach with beautiful views. The shape of the "falesia" is unique and superb. Someting we had never seen before.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Walked this beautiful beach to Vilamoura with my husband.It is so clean and you can walk for miles .

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing colours and lovely beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Long stretch of beach with lots of places to rest.  There's also option to rent beach bench if you want to be more comfy.  There are sellers walkin around selling drinks and snacks.  There are also restaurants on the beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is beautiful, rugged orange coloured cliffs and a very long sandy beach.There are some areas with sun beds and umbrellas. And a few restaurants dotted along the way!Steep steps to get access so if you have mobility issues it’s probably not the one for you.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: mini Marsden rock
reviewsWithKeywords.text: found the beach by chance and returned a few times, shops bars and the odd lucky lucky man selling his goods

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Gorgeous beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We loved this beach-so pretty and a couple of great places to eat/drink. The pine trees and cliffs surrounding this beach are just beautiful!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Falesia Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A beautiful beach, very clean, lots of sunbeds to hire if required and a couple of sea view restaurants/bars to eat and drink.  Toilets there as well.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Day out to Falesia Beach.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Sightseeing bus drop off is around 20/25min walk to beach. Amazing views. 4km stretch of beach. Lovely location

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Bezch
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice beach with golden sand but think it's fake. Watch the shelf and currents with kids. Probably not that safe on anything but calm day.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Perfect beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely and huge beach which is all sand.. There is plenty of space to have a secluded spot. Great snack bar at the start near the stairs down to the beach

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Evening walk
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The day we arrived, after lunch and check in plus not knowing the place; we have decided walking Falesia Beach and it was wonderful 2 hours walk before dinner and only little bad weather put off but it would be lovely walking even everyday.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The steep walk back
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Staying at Falesia Portobay hotel and decided to walk down the lovely wooden steps to the beach. What a treat when we got there. Miles of uninterrupted views. Cliff faces of amazing colours. Lovely sand and clear waters. Well worth the visit but the steps back up were trying.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing Views and Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is by far one of the most beautiful, picturesque beaches I have ever seen!  The dark terracotta cliffs were an amazing backdrop to the beach and very clean!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing cliffs
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice view.. the rocks are amazing. The beloved beach is characterized by its incredible red cliffs. In fact, the translation of the beach is Beach of Cliffs.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice beach with plenty of sand and sea on it. Plenty of bars to use and even saw a bar with a sign outside saying free creche for men leave home free with beer money

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautifull duned beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Being at the Pine Cliffs Resort hotel, this was a breathtaking walk to the beach.300 steps or less if you take the lift, but what a surprise to enjoy the beautiful colours of this cliffs.Nice long beach good for long walks and enjoyment

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: That I walked from albufeira to the end of falesia beach (mission), absolutely stunning, beautiful beach.Only problem I had was finding it ochos de agua. But found the steps eventually

reviewsWithKeywords.title: One of the best beaches
reviewsWithKeywords.text: There is always something to see and do along this clean and interesting stretch of coast. Numerous sea birds and some birds of prey. Not too busy, before the sun beds get put out for Easter.Ideal for walkers of all ages, up & down or through to Vilamoura.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fantastic beach and beautiful cliffs!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We spent almost everyday on the beach while staying at the pine cliffs resort!  The beach was one of the cleanest I have ever been too and given the time of year, was not too busy!  We went in up to knee hight, but will def returned again to enjoy a full swim when it is warmer!  The walk up the main stretch of beach was fantastic and got to watch some surfing!  Also took some great pictures of the beautiful colour cliffs!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing Sunset , great beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We drove from Albufeira. Car rental is quite cheap off season. The sunset from this location is stunning. It’s private and not a lot of people are there near sunset time. It’s a good vibe , plus there’s plenty sun beds just to chill. Amazing views , clean beach. We stayed in Albufeira for 4 nights and pretty much went here daily for sunset .

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I love this beach! The water is very clean.. enjoyed every minute when we where there... most beautiful beach I ever seen...

reviewsWithKeywords.title: long walk

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fabulous beach goes on for miles !!!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is out of this world , goes on for miles . Fabulous soft sand . And nobody on it lol . Can’t belive it xxxx

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Visiting the beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach was lovely and enjoyed walking on beach wrote our names on the rock it was really nice and chilled.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Hiking and clean beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Good beach for walking and running in the morning. There's a long hiking trail but the only downside is that it's very long to reach the main cities. So that means not much shops around until you've reached the bigger cities.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful cliff colours
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Huge long beach with steep cliffs . Bright sunshine on exposed rocks and soil showed brilliant oranges, reds yellow and brown cliff faces . Lovely flat sand. Water on March too cool without a wet suit. Access limited by long steep stairs.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Large.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great beach this, very large open and really nice fine sand.Great for swimming here as there's so much room.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Only problem with this beautiful beach from the Olhos D’Agua location is the number of steps up and down to it.  It’s a great sense of achievement to do it but be prepared .

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Can walk for miles on this beach.Falesia Hotel provides bus to it.Busy at weekends, but acres of space, though limited parking. V goodrestaurant nearby called Sabores ?Next to Chinese restaurant in small,new complex. High amenity area, 2 or 3 five star hotels. Highly recommended.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful sandy beach.with the coastline worn by the waves into interesting shapes it is picturesque .

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Long stretch of sand, allows visitors to walk East to Vilamoura or West to Olhus D'Agua. Never too busy, always space.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice long stretch of sand with red cliffs
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We went in early freezing March so the beach was packed by burnt red British and no one else. You can walk for miles!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Just got back from our holiday, went down to the beach most days, beautiful and clean, lots of steps but well worth the climb.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beaches
reviewsWithKeywords.text: All beaches along the coastline are clean and accessible. You can walk or get one of the local buses. Many of them even have sun loungers. The sea is beautiful and clear making a lovely day out.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning cliffs
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We walked along Falesia Beach in the Algarve yesterday. It was 23° and a beautiful sunny day, the tide was out so we could walk on flat sand by the water. We walked to Vilamoura and it was the most peaceful, almost spiritual walk. The scenery is breath taking and we were in awe of how amazing this natural cliff and beach was.If you are planning a trip tp Albufeira, Falesia Beach should be a must to vist.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great views
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely beach, fantastic view, very clean. Only negative is the amount of steps down to the beach, not very easy to access if less mobile or carrying a lot of beach stuff

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Falesia Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great beach to visit and walk great views beautiful sun set and sun rise. this beach goes all the way to Vilamoura

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful clean beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We stayed at the fab hotel PortoBay Falesia and reached this beach via the 100+ wooden steps, well worth the climb.  This beach stretches for miles and is very clean and uncrowded (March) the beautiful coloured cliffs surrounding the beach are stunning.you can walk all the way from Olhos de Água to Vilamoura along this fab beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The beach of the Algarve
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Have known this beach for over 30 years when there were little tourists and when there were no constructions no sunbeds - so pure and beautifull - today it is commercialized ... nevertheless it is still the most beautifull pleasant of the south - with guards, clean, ideal for all

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Find the lookout on a map.!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We are not big beach people, so we discovered a lot of hiking trails at the cliffsides in the Algarve. On a map find the (lookout) Miradouro do Falecia up near the Tui Blue Falésia Hotel for the most spectacular view of these multi coloured cliffs.(There is also another, more accessible, but further away lookout called Miradouro do Parque a little further west)To go down to the beach there is road access with parking at the bottom, is the road is not too washed out, or simply walk down the road.Visit later in the day for best sunlit cliffsWell worth a visit, even with so many other fantastic view points all along the Algarve.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Falesia beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We went on a tuk tuk tour and they took us all around to different coastlines and the beaches this was a very nice beach but with going in February not that busy but can imagine in the summer time would be really busy there is also a cafe and a bar at this beach if you want a quieter beach and away from Albufeira main beach would recommend

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing place
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The amazing rock formations on Falesia beach are simply mind boggling. The beach itself is something to behold with a huge expanse of clean sand .

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Goes on forever
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Went down onto the beach in olhos de agua in low tide and decided to walk down the beach to Vilamoura, it is a wonderful walk if not a tiring one ,not sure of the exact distance but must be 5 mile which took us about 2.5 hours but well worth the exercise and the view of the cliff formations are stunning.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Most stunning beach in Algarve!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Algarve is full of beautiful beaches but for me and my husband this beach was just amazing - surrounded by cliffs and big rocks clean water - golden sandy beach is just what it was - we parked at the top of the cliff and took the steps down - been disabled i really enjoyed the way they have steps leading to the beach rather then the usual steep climb down or up - we went in december and the weather was around 21degrees.if you are ever in Algarve this beach is a must see!!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: One of the best beaches on Algarve
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Fantastic surroundings of red and large beach to take a swim on Algarve. Plenty of good restaurants near too.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning beach.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Quiet secluded beach but stunning views and miles of sand to spend all day enjoying yourselves and not commercialised. Small cafe and toilets at the entrance then miles of perfect beach. Well recommended.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is lovely. It’s definitely worth the trip! There’s a long stretch which takes you into Vilamoura.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Miss Weston
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Falesia beach is the most beautiful beach we have ever seen the walk to Vilamoura is a must visit you’ll wish you’d been years ago......

reviewsWithKeywords.title: amazing
reviewsWithKeywords.text: got to be one of the best beaches in the Algarve , safe for kids and it stretches to villamoura if you fancy a long walk

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very pleasant beach 🏖
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Just a short walk away from the marina in vilamoura and you find this long sandy beach 🏖 perfect for an out of season stroll. No danger of going hungry with a number of restaurants and beach clubs to choose from.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Wonderful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Wonderful beach very pretty, great for relaxing and enjoying your holiday. I would recommend this beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Spent a fair few hours on the beach in December Quality time.Sun was shining temperature around 21 degrees

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Spectacular beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach begins in Olhos de Água, Albufeira, and extends, for almost eight kilometers, to the beginning of the Vilamoura marina, where the mountains end up disappearing.Golden beach, surrounded by red and white cliffs, with hammocks, water sports, restaurant and bar.There are hotels near different categoryOn top of these cliffs are some of the most beautiful and luxurious hotels and resorts in the Algarve, such as Porto Bay Falesia, the Pine Cliffs resort of the Luxury Collection, with its golf course on the sea, the new five-star hotel Epic Sana and the hotel Falesia.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: love this beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: we always walk along this beach and return over the cliff walk.   It is always clean and the red cliffs are amazing !

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Absolutely beautiful long stretch of glorious beach.Only one bar/restaurant/toilet open in 3miles though on 5th jan lolSo get your walking shoes on. We're used to it, but some aren't !

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very nice beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Eight km from Albufeira. Very nice beach with a lot of colours. But no toilet and no restaurants. The beach is on Tripadvisers top 20 in the world, well, it is not I can tell yoy.But very nice!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Just a stunning beach Portugal at its best. It's a must to go too. It's unspoilt and a hidden gem lots if steps down but we'll worth it. A stunning place on a sunny afternoon in December.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Ideal location to watch the sunset
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a beautiful location, a great place to watch the sunset.There is a small carpark at the cliff top and an even smaller on further down. Both good for different reasons.Go and see, check it out. Whether you just want a beach or the landscape

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: For me this beach is the best one in Algarve. Is really nice to go to see sunset and relaxing your holidays.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Miles and miles of sand !!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Apparently it is possible to walk from the Olhos de Agua end all the way to Vilamoura . It would be a long trek indeed but as the terrain is flat , a comfortable way to burn some calories. Take water with you as the 2 bars at the Olhos de Agua end are pricy !

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beach to ourselves
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We walked along the beach every day we were in the area. Each time it was clean and uncrowded. There were plenty of litter bins on the beach so no excuses!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Wonderful beach with accessible cliff walks behind. Peaceful. Soft sand which goes on for about five uninterupted miles.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Not the best beach in the Algarve
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Summer time it is like most other beaches in the Algarve jam packed with people has amazing views of the ocean and the warm waters of the Summer Atlantic with water temps reaching up to 24c, not bad for the Atlantic!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It was worth the 40mins walk from our hotel the beach is quite small but the views and the cliffs are lovely this little place has shops /restaurants and bars is easy getting down to it but a steep walk back up to the main road.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: One of the world's best beaches
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Falesia Beach (Cliff Beach in English) is so named due to the wonderful cliffs behind it, which grow as you go westward from Vilamoura. It's beauty is the combination of sunshine, the blue sea, golden sand, the red cliffs and the green cactus on the cliffs. Parking is easy, either in a large parking area, whose fees depend upon the time of year, or fairly close by for free. You enter by way of a bridge over the Quarteira River, and pass an excellent beach cafe. There are sun loungers for rent, or just do your own thing. Behind the beach are a number of good cafes serving everything you want. There is also a life-saving service if you stay in the main area. Do not camp below the cliffs, which cab be dangerous!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing beach & view
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Wonderful views beaches & sea.Lovely golden sands & warm sea that you can swim in.There are a few restaurants where you can grab a bite to eat & drink.The cliffs are amazing & you can walk up them.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A gorgeous big beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We walked up there a few days and did a walk on the beach.  A huge beach with loads of room for everyone on it.  This beach is definitely worth going to.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Good clean beach and area to work around.Nice to chill out and relax by the sea front and have a drink or snack and a walk around.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing beach location and views
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach really is amazing and the views from and of the cliffs is breathtaking. There are quite a lot of steps to the beach but it's worth the effort and I didn't particularly struggle with a four-year-old, we just took our time!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Olhos de agua
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely little fishing village with a good amount of places to eat breakfast, lunch and dinner no need to venture out to other areas as it's all on you're door step. Friendly quaint with a romantic feel. We spent a week there two couples. We stayed in a apartment which overlooked the sea. Beautiful weather our favourite restaurant was Tarmarillo Restaurant which we visited regularly over our stay we were looked after very well by the brother's who worked there. We had fish,lamb,chicken and prawn dishes all delicious with good portions and very tasty. Price wise we found good for a party of 4.On average  €90 for the four of us including alcohol Brandy, beer,red wine. On one visit two of us decided to have a pudding and tried the Almond Cake which was delicious so good we put in an order for a whole one to take away. They were so accommodating it was no problem. Worth a visit or two.We also had the opportunity to book a coach trip to Eastern Algarve and Spain this was organised through the travel shop 5 mins from our apartment this was a fabulous trip which we throughly enjoyed including 5 stops for shopping and lunch in Spain. Beautiful churches we visited stopping at Marinas. Our driver was extremely friendly he called himself Johnny be good and had us all laughing throughout the trip. We met for 9.00 and returned by 7.15pm.Worth every penny would love to do it again. We also visited Old Town and the shopping mall paying a visit to good old C&A in Albufeira. Taxi to mall roughly  €17 for four of us. Old town good for strolling around and souvenir shopping drinks cigarettes nick backs. All in all a wonderful trip great beach, watching the sunset each evening . Would definitely recommend this place. Hope to return soon.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beach visit
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach was very clean with lovely golden sand. Views are amazing. Facilities were nice and handy and well looked after.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fantastic Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very clean & well kept beach as you’d expect in this area of the Algarve. Great views from the cliffs tops.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Test of walking skills
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Best beach in Portugal ? I think so......well serviced with lounges , tide never goes too far out....lifeguards....okay a lot of soft sand so a struggle....but move towards the cliffs and where from PINE CLIFFS hotels all the way to villamoura you can cheat by walking the cliffs....when towards Villamoura eating at number 3 is best beach bar

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Excellent beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very nice family beach but does get very busy in July and August. Would recommend though. Well worth a visit

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach and worth the visit
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very long, clean beach, with beautiful breathtaking views and cliffs.  We took the bus from Albufeira and there is a bus stop not far from the beach.  Worth the visit.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best beach in Algarve
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We visited this beach in October. Great location, free parking, Sandy and ideal for young family beach was not crowded as well.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Walk on the bezch
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The best beach to walk Lots of beach bars to enjoy and if fit try walking to Vilamoura fromPine. cliffs

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely clear sea, beautiful views to the surrounding cliffs. Plenty of comfortable sun loungers but a little expensive.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We spent a few hours here and it’s the most beautiful beach. Definitely worth a visit. Surround by cliffs with soft sand

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice pleasant  walk from Hotel
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The Beach is a the bottom of the road through O,lhos de Aqua there are bars shops and toilets the beach is pleasant but you have to be aware of the Tides there are some fresh water springs on the beach which is what the town is all about

reviewsWithKeywords.title: beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: was very impressed with this beach was very clean and very popular beautiful scenery and a lovely walk

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Super beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is stunning.  You can walk for miles.  There are wooden steps down to the beach.  There is a cafe at the top before the stairs but this is not commercialised so take water and snacks with you.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: 5km long
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We walked from Olhos De Aqua to Vilamoura, all 5km lol. Lovely sandy beach with a few cafe's/ bars along the way, not very busy when we were there so if you like a bit of peace & quiet its perfect.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Golden sand, dramatic cliffs, beautiful
