reviewsWithKeywords.text: The colour play at this beach was surreal. During this timenof the year not busy at all. Can walk for miles along the beach. Lots of sea shells. But: look out for the blue bottle jellyfish: they're supposed to sting like hell.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach with very colourful cliffs
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Spectacular cliffs the length of the beach about a mile long.  There are a couple of roads down to the beach but we got there on foot from Olhos de Agua.  There is a well-maintained staircase down to the beach not far from the Riu.  It's about 75 meters west of the turn in the road that runs south past the Riu and then goes west to the Tui Blue Hotel.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A hidden gem
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Boasting more than six kilometres of golden sand, stretching from Vilamoura in the west to Olhos do Agua in the east, Praia da Falesia is home to one of the longest beaches in Portugal.This sleepy residential town is known by the locals as 'beach town' and has managed to preserve something of its traditional Portuguese lifestyle. Backed by cliffs (falesia is Portuguese for cliff) decorated with pine trees the beach is accessed by steps that lead down from a clifftop car park.The sheer size of the beach and the laid-back atmosphere of the town contribute towards making this one of the more peaceful corners of the Algarve, although it is well-served by several top-class golf courses, a smattering of restaurants and bars and a number of accommodation complexes. Conveniently located between the towns of Vilamoura and Albufeira this quaint little town and its long, gorgeous beach are easily accessible by public transport.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: pristine beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I thought Praia da Rocha was unbeatable, but when I discovered Praia da Falesia ! wahooo, amazingly gorgeous place. Arrive early to find a parking space in the pine forest, walk down, (there's a café before going down the stairs) and then it's breath takingly beautiful. Easier if you have a car.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Vacation
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I come here two or three times each British winter. Always a comfortable time away from our winter. People are very warm and welcoming.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Visited this beautiful beach each time we go to Portugal after coming across it by chance. Just to sit on the bench on the wooden steps leading down to the beach and look at the sea, the cliffs and the sand is so relaxing.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful location
reviewsWithKeywords.text: That was lovely walk for couple of hours. Me and my wife we enjoyed of that beautiful landscape. Very interesting rock formations, pine trees growing on the side of cliffs very colorful. Luckily on this time of the year was very quiet, only a few tourist, some fishermen's.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing view
reviewsWithKeywords.text: One of the most beautiful beaches in Albufeira and Algarve , great views from the cliff. Beautiful clean water and miles of pure sand beach . You can walk or run plenty a restaurants and bars near by .

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunningly beautiful beach that goes for miles
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Falesia beach is picturesque with amazing ochre and white cliff faces flanking 5 kilometers of the cleanest sand you might ever walk on.  You can walk (or run) all the way from Olhos d'Agua to Vilamoura.  The beach is plenty wide, but walking it is easiest during low tide when you will have a fast expanse of level and firm wet sand under your feet.  When the tide is in your walk will be a little more challenging in the softer sand up closer to the cliffs.  Either way, it is a delightful way to get fresh sea air and good exercise while enjoying the beauty of the Algarve.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Blown Away !
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Visited during storm "Emma" that hit the Algarve for 4/5 days in Feb/March 2018.A lovely stretch of sand (without the debris from the storm).Dramatic atlantic colourful cliffs with pine woods overhanging.Photographers paradise.Walks along the beach with access to steep wooden steps up to surrounding areas with bars and restaurants.Easily accessible via lift from Pine Cliffs resort.Stunning dramatic scenery..Recommended if you are into a good walk in a natural enviroment.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great picturesque beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Visited here after arriving in Faro, 30 min drive then on to these stunning picturesque golden sand beaches with the sandstone rocks lit up by the bright sunshine. Some great restaurants and lovely little snack bars. Really nice beach and much favoured by the locals. Great place 100% highly recommended. Check out the offers in the restaurants on the top road! 4 course meal for 10 euros!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Awesome place
reviewsWithKeywords.text: One of the best and most beautiful beach of Portugal. In autumn you can even see whales from the cliff.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful clean sands
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Accessed via steps from hotels and car parks this 5 miles beach is spectacular. You can walk at all states of the tide but it's hard work at high tide on the soft sand. We walked the entire length and back a couple of times. Worth remembering that out of season there is poor access to toilets and refreshments so check first! You can extend the walk both ends with a bit of effort.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Long stretch of sandy beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach, very long sandy stretch  for about 5 kilometers and colorful cliffs. There is a nice little snack bar, serves all kinds of beverages and little snack items at the top of the cliff  right at the stairs.  From there you have a nice view of the beach. To get to the beach there are quite a few stairs to get down. The beach is good for walking, jogging, or just relaxing. Parking for cars is available before you walk down to the beach,on the side of the road, and also a parking lot up at the top of the hill. but in the summer you would have to get there early to get a spot for your car.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Miles of unspoilt sand
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We were lucky with the February weather. The beach was completely unspoilt, golden sand and clear blue waters.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great for walking
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Loved this beach, great for some early morning runs and some late afternoon walks.  Very pleasant to here the waves lapping up the beach.  Never too busy either

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fabulous!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The colours in the sand alone are incredible. Peaks, valleys, and sand as far as the eye can see and the blues of the ocean. Lots of stairs so take your time if you’re not very fit.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: If you want a beach to walk on this is it ! We walked from Alhos de Aha to Vilamoura marina 10+ on. Too cold to swim at this time of the year but can imagine it would be lovely in Summer. Steep steps up and down on Alhos de Aha side.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Perfect beach!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: 3 miles of firm sand .Ideal just for a paddle or a long brisk walk to Villamoura. Spent a very enjoyable day in mid February in lovely warm sunshine.One of the best beaches on the Algarve.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A must for anyone in the area. Beautiful beach to walk and take in the views. Only negative is there were no facilities opened during our visits in February.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely beach and parking available only a short walk away. Unfortunately, like most Algarve beaches, it is down a number of steep steps so not suitable for the elderly or infirm.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fantastic beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Wonderful beach, very beautiful and clean.The colour of the water is just perfect. Want to come back!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: ONE OF THE BEST BEACHES AT ALGARVE
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Algarve has, only at the south coast (some more at east, at Guadiana river, and other on the west Atlantic coast). around 300 kms of nearly ininterrupt lovely sandy beaches, most of them hidden on a typical limestone coast.This one, Falesia, is a wide open sandy beach "linked" to minor ones (Maria Luisa´s ; Olhos d´Agua beach) that, despite being really close to Albufeira (main touristic point) is wide enough, even in peak season, to those who want "sand and space".Easily reachable by car, you can park nearby, under pinetrees located over the surronding limestone cliffs where you can find lovely trails with a breathtaking view.Neverthelss, try to avoid peak season, if possible.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Came here nearly everyday on holiday it's just an absolute gorgeous beach surrounded by rocks and caves. Truly magical

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely beach to walk along
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Take the time for the steep walk down (car park at the bottom if you want to drive). Several shops and bars overlooking the beach. Can walk for miles (watch out for the tide). Nice quiet areas or large open beach. Plenty of space and not over popular (well it is February)

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fantastic beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: What a perfect way to have a lovely long walk on a bright sunny day. The colouration of the cliffs is fascinating and the long sandy beach is stunning and remarkably clean. We walked along the beach from Falésia to Vilamoura. The tide was almost fully in one day and out the following day which made walking on the exposed firmer sand so much easier. Highly recommended.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach and a good walk on the rocks/hills
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Falesia beach is very beautiful and we really enjoyed our family walk on the rocks/hill near the beach. The vantage point on the hill offered very good views and we clicked lots of photographs while we were the there. The beach itself is very neat and clean.We spent a nice quite afternoon with the family at the beach & loved it.We got the parking easily as well.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very good beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Falesia beach is very nice and clean beach in Algarve definitely you will love it also I heard that it is one of the best beaches in world.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Gorgeous
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beaches are just heartbreaking!! The view is fantastic. We discovered this beach by chance. It s about 60 Kilomètres from the real Bella vista hotel at Albufeira. Off peak season this area is just amazing to relax with a book.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: On the Beach and on the Rock
reviewsWithKeywords.text: My Husband and I went along the beach and then the adventure started up and down the rocks. Wow amazing waves. We both definitely experienced nature.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: One of our local landmarks
reviewsWithKeywords.text: One of our local beaches! 7 kms of sandy beach from Barranco das Belharucas to Vilamoura, a stretch of sand that will take approximately 1 1/2hours to walk. This can easily be done at low tide! The beach is lined with a backdrop of beautiful red and white cliffs million of years old, quite picturesque that give you great photo opportunities...in high season there are several beach bars scattered throughout the length of this beach serving light snacks, cold drinks and ice creams! These outlets are all served by lifeguards and have water sports available such as paragliding, jet skis, banana boats or windsurfing among others. Great for families and couples. Even off season this is a magical place to visit ideal for those beach walks, short or long, photo opportunities or simply admire the beautiful sunsets.P.S.- All photos copyright by the author.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: "Beautiful beach. Walk to Vilamoura."
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Long , clean sandy beach.  Beautiful views and photo ops . Sunset is stunning . Beach has sea on one side , colourful cliff face on the other. Lovely walk along beach from Olhos de Agua to Vilamoura. Takes 2 hours. There is access to beach cafes , restaurants and toilets at certain parts of the beach but mainly nearer to Olhos and Vilamoura. Take a drink with you if walking the whole distance. Beach can be accessed from long steep wooden staircases from the top of the cliff and from cliff hotels. Sea is lovely but very rough waves. I would not swim in the sea in the Algarve.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: wonderful sand and walking
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Just wonderful in the October sunshine to stretch your legs and walk along the beautiful clean beach in complete safety

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Blue flag beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach. Excellent facilities. Everyone friendly. Pay for a sunlounger, laze, paddle, swim in the turquoise waters, eat, drink plenty water, and enjoy!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Clean beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It is a long and clean beach, not far from Albufeira and Villamoura. We enjoyed walking next to the sea - it was too cold to get into the sea in January.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: lovely beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: idyllic beach & the beach bar is excellent white sandy very long beach great for walking along plenty of sunbeds or space to lie without sunbed.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nigel R
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great beach near hotel a few steps to get to it great for walking along with lots of beach bars and good for swiming

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A lovely long sandy beach with some nice restaurants
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Falesia Beach is well kept with nice sand, it is a long beach and has some nice sea front restaurants

reviewsWithKeywords.title: White sands long Romaric walks
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Falesia in Italian means something else but that for you to find out.  The beach is a long white sand expanse of lovelyliness.... walk in one direction when the tides out and end up at Ohlas de August a quaint fishing village walk the other way and you come across Vilamoura top end big yatch marina ... either way if your looking for walks on the beach with that special someone this where to go

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Wow
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Clean well maintained and wonderful restaurants easy access . We were there in the off season so loads of room to spread out and have fun. Brilliant

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely beach with plenty of miles to walk on
reviewsWithKeywords.text: You can either relax, or walk for miles on this stretch of beach with beautiful cliff tops all around you

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Wonderfull sand beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: For a walk, a run or just a romantic look at sun set, perfect beach, east to west from sunrise to sunset.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach! Must see in Albufiera
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is absolutely lovely. We went in December so it was slightly colder and not as many people were using it so in a way it was even nicer. Incredibly picturesque and the beach stretches for miles. But the best part of the beach had to be the sand hills just behind the beach. It's climbable for the bold and it's fun. You really have to see the beach for yourself... Words don't do it justice

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful long beach with colourful cliffs.A great place for a walk or swim. Several free parking areas

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Clean beach, quiet - but I think that was due to us being here in December. Water wasn't too choppy, but a few people near us were saying it can get strong currents. Lovely beach overall

reviewsWithKeywords.title: NOT YOUR TYPICAL BEACH
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Amazing not like any beach iv been on before. just because of the view!! could do with more shops for refreshments.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely clean beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: nice beach, kids loved it. not easy to get to, but is great. The steps to get to the beach are steep so not pushchair friendly. Very busy in the peace season.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Falesia Beach is a wonderful beach. For walking, sitting on and sunbathing. Lovely golden sands. Great for sunsets too.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: one of the nice beaches in the algarve. located conventienly next to a resort hotel. good restaurants, but not cheap.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A beautiful beach, well worth the walk.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Falesia beach is a bit of a walk but well worth the effort when you get there. We found it fairly quiet a great place for families, particularly those wanting to improve their sandcastle building skills.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Grate place to walk and sit (even get a few last rays in November)
reviewsWithKeywords.text: have been here many times now, well kept, busy in August but still, a great beach chose where you access the beach as some places have lots of steps whilst others can be accessed state from the car parks

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very nice beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Stairs down to the beach from our hotel. The beach was quiet. The colourful cliffs are really pretty.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely morning walk and paddle
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Got to the beach early so we were able to park very close and have a very pleasant walk along the lovely beach. Snack bar above the beach serves decent range of stuff and has good toilets.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Long walk down many steps to get to beach which has one of two restaurants, one was closed but the other is well appointed.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Love this beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is awesome, laden with a carpet of shells, clean with plenty of lifeguards.  A great place to sit and reflect on life!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Sand and sea
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful and clean, stretches on for as far as the eye can see. Sunbed and parasols can be hired.Chance of seeing dolphins if visiting in the right season and beautiful views from the clifftops

reviewsWithKeywords.title: fabulous family beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We went down to the beach for an afternoon and had a fabulous time playing in the sand and making sandcastles. The waves were a little too big for our girls but they are very young. There were plenty of children playing in the sea and enjoying themselves. The food at the restaurant there was very good. We had lunch and and evening meal before going back up the watch the sunset from the cliff tops above.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best beach for little ones
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We found this gem on our 3rd day in the area and fell in love with it. Beautiful, soft sand, flat beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beach for our back yard
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach had everything. Walking distance to other towns. The cliffs give a great backdrop for incredible photos. We had a villa right on the cliff above the beach and every morning started with a walk on the beach. You can walk for hours.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Safe Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great safe sandy beach, with reasonable access. A great place to relax and while away those sunny Algarve days.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Sunny beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely clear sandy beach wich runs between albufeira and villarmora .we walked down a wooden stepped terrace stairway which was ok for us but some people might have a problem with. Lovely coloured sandstone cliffs .beach nice and clean and waters are perfect for bathing.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Gorgeous Location
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A truly beautiful beach with a fantastic walk all the way from Olhos d Aqua to Vilamoura.  Took us 1.30min to get there and 1.15mins on the way back but a lovely walk

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is one of the most beautiful beaches I went to, pure shores, golden sand, nice vibe, not too crowded, just perfect!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Stunning long beach!AVOID THE ICE CREAM IN OLIVERS RESTERAUNT !!! 4 Euros for a cone is way too much.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Cracking views
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Some nice cafes and restaurants near the waterfront.Walking along the beach takes you up a path to reach the top of the cliffs. Warning signs for the cliffs so approach at own risk.If you do go up there are some beautiful views

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely sandy beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I feel the best time to visit the beach is early morning. You can see the sun rises above the horizon with shimmering colour. It is quiet all around except the sound of waves and wind. The sea is warm and you can walk barefoot on the beach as the waves are lapping at the sand. There are sea shells to pick and sandcastle to make.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: beautiful place
reviewsWithKeywords.text: extremely scenic beautiful.place . sun bed hire was expensive if I'm honest but sea was lovely and clear, sand was nice. wouldn't recommend to people with mobility issues as you can only access beach down some steps and of course back again for your trip home. enjoyed it despite the above .

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach..
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful place to rest and  exercise   safe and clean beach.Absolutely gorgeous.. most beautiful beach ever been.....

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Expensive sunbeds
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We twice walked a long way along the beach  but as we were staying at one end, this meant little change of scenery although the colouring or the cliffs is spectacular. The sea was quite rough for most of our stay (more suited to surfing) and so we only stayed on the beach one day - especially as a set of sunbeds cost 15 euros a day. TIPS: buy an umbrella (about 12 euros) and save a fortune; the cafes/restaurants on the beach are expensive - it was a lot cheaper for drinks to buy from the man who pulled his drinks box along the beach (4 euros a beer compared with 7 in the bars).

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best beach we found on the Algarve
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely for long walks. Not crowded. Beautiful cliffs with striking red stone that glow at sunset. And beautiful sunsets over the sea. Everything you need.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Love this beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Felt like our hotels beach even though it's open to the public.   The red cliffs are so beautiful and add a real exotic feel to the beach.  The water is freezing lol, but clear and crisp!   Feels so private.  2 Sun beds & an umbrella are €20 to rent so we bought a large umbrella for just €11.50 instead and it did the trick!   Love this beach, well worth the trip, so peaceful and idyllic 😊 the beach bar/cafe serves food all day, we had 2 burgers & a chip & 2 soft drinks, which came to just over €17, not bad for the location.  Yes a tourist trap, but not bad value for money.  Friendly service.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We’ve been here before and love the changing environment. Not the best of beaches if you don’t like the steps and parking can be an issue.  Seas can be strong at times but beach is guarded.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice and clean
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice and. Lean and when we went it was pretty empty. There are no nearby restaurants or cafes so bring your own supplies

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing red and ocher cliffs
reviewsWithKeywords.text: These red and ocher cliffs are typical of Falesia. There is a wonderful walk to discover above the cliffs leading from the city of Vilamoura to Falesia. The landscape is very wild and out of season little known from the cohort of tourists.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach with a few bars along the way. Can walk even at high tide, but low tide is easier. Lovely rock formations. Could walk along there every day

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Our family holiday
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is an amazing 😉 place to go to and I would definitely recommend it to anyone who is going to Portugal 🇵🇹

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Gorgeous beach really clean to, the sea was a little rough but we think this may have been the backlash from the hurricane as it was calmer towards the end of the week. Lots of little bars and restaurants along the way. Amazing views from the top of the cliffs but be careful as they are very fragile.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Probably one of the nicest beaches which are easily commutable too. This beach is pretty vast and has the perfect combination of sea, sand, cliffs and trail walks. It is also very local to various shops and restaurants which have some great little places to eat. I would recommend coming to this beach if you have the time!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach with lots of space
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I love the beaches in Portugal and this is one of the best. Golden sand with a refreshing breeze. Plenty off room to avoid being too close to other people. Very relaxing

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice beach, very busy
reviewsWithKeywords.text: If you like busy beaches, thats yours. Nice wide and lots of stuff to do.. However, there are much better beaches around. This one is very central

reviewsWithKeywords.title: sunbathing
reviewsWithKeywords.text: beuitiful beach clean loverly sand and streaches as far as the eye can see and clear water and can walk to a loverly little marina at the other end stunning veiws and cliffs

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Really nice beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We just came back from Algarve, stayed in Olhos de Agua where you can find one of the most beautiful beach.. long sandy beach. Perfect for children. Loved it!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing views during sunrise or sunset
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is the longest beach in southern Portugal (think it's ~ 7 km long), and the tide effects, combined with the sunrise or sunset lighting translate dreams to reality for any photography enthusiast.A must-see item if you're travelling in south Portugal, all-year-round.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely beaches
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beaches in Albufuera are big and clean with lots of touristy bars and cafes. The prices are high for the places near the beach but it's still well worth going there. Sadly the town offers and promotes bullfighting so as you're laying on the golden sand you have to think about the poor animals bleeding into the sand of the nearby arena as they are tortured to death.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The longest beach We have ever seen
reviewsWithKeywords.text: From taking the steps down from Porto bay Felesia hotel onto this beautiful beach is amazing. It stretches as far as the eye can see all the way to Villamoura. We walked the beach to Villamoura which took us around 2hours at a comfortable pace for us. We were amazed at the very chic marina with lively bars-resturants around the very up market boats . Dramatic coloured cliff faces of vibrant orange colours. It was a very enjoyable experience for us , stunning scenery.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: lovely beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: lovely beach and lovely views. a lot of steps down but worth it walked to the harbour , lovely weather beautiful place

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is the cleanest beach I have ever been to. The sand is white, you can watch a beautiful sunset.  There are no hawkers which is brilliant, you can be left alone to soak up the sun.  Lots of restaurants on the promenade, also the Mariner Is very close.Beautiful!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is stunning the rocks are a lovely colour you can walk for miles the only negative are the ants

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Birthday trip husbands
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful place great location Lovely beach great swimming an views of the cliffs Will definitely visit again soon

reviewsWithKeywords.title: What a beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Wow is all I can say! The best beach ever.....we got on it down the 300 odd steps near RIU Guarana & walked & walked all the way to Vilamoura & back. The tide was out & it was beautiful. Saw a few jelly fish & weird purple things but a lovely clean beach with lots of people just walking... 5star..👍

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful cliffs and beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: World class views and world class beach to stroll, explore and relax on.Lovely golden sands gentle waves.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We went there by taxi from old town which came around 15 euros for 6 people. The beach was lovely but the water was slightly cold since it was early weeks of October.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A long sandy beach with a couple of beach bars ,you can walk right along to vilamoura you have to go up a lot of steps  to go back up to the top but they are wide and gradual

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning scenary
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful setting. A long walk down steps but well worth it for the views. Lovely clean beach. Went in October and had the small beach to ourselves.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Sunbeds,  2 restaurants, Massage, steep climb to the hotel but has benches to rest on. Lovely views of the colourful cliffs.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: World Class Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Little can be added to the title. This is a beautiful beach with a beautiful cliff face as a background. Algarve is one of the best coastlines on the planet. This beach is the jewel in the Crown.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach but lots of steps!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach but lots and lots of steps to get down to it, and only one bar across the entire strip which sits at the top of the steps so you are constantly going up and down if you want drinks/food all day so best to take supplies with you.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a great beach.... difficult to get to but well worth it.... You do need to walk down around 80 wooden decked steps and there is a bar n cafe at the top. Clean beach with great waves in the sea.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great beach for walking or just relaxing. So vast, it never feels crowded. Plenty of local facilities.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beaches
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely beach not too crowded can't wait to go back today.parking is easy small cafe on hand for those extra drinks if needed perfect 😀

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fabulous
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Fabulous stretch of beachDotted with sunbeds and barsWalk all the way to vilamoura in 45 mins Never to busy and safe and clean for families Beautiful

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Falesia beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Fantastic sandy but long walk down but worth it . there's a few little bars and life guard stations sun beds and parasols .

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Gorgeous!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a lovely beach backed by red cliffs. There is parking nearby but it does get busy. However it isn't too far to walk from the car park in the village. There is a cafe and toilets at the top of the steps which take you down to the sand and there are beach beds and umbrellas available. The beach is wide and goes on for miles. As it's the Atlantic, the water was cold and quite strong so care should be taken especially with children. A beautiful setting and very clean.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Falesia Beach is nice and neat but lacks a boardwalk, bars, shops and restaurants around it.The surrounding rock formation is beautiful, the beach is not very crowded and has a lot of small sea shells.The only restaurant we saw was the one at the very top of the stairs where you can go down to the beach. On the beach itself there's nothing. To have access to other restaurants, shops, bars and coffee places you have to drive to the town close by probably 5 min. There's free parking on the curve that leads to the beach. If you have a car, I would suggest going to Praia de Rocha in Portimao (check my review on that beach), it's about an hour and a half from Albufeira.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Wonderful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Falesia beach is such a beautiful place, very clean and safe and with stunning scenery and views.  If you find out about the tide times you can walk for miles along the beach.  It takes a good hour and half or more to reach Vilamoura from Olhos d'Agua but it's so worth it.  The steps down to the beach (or specifically, back up) are a bit challenging but worth the effort.  There are a number of small bars with WCs along the beach - nothing fancy but perfectly adequate.  A wonderful area!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely beach that goes all the way from Olhos to Vilamoura. Will take a while, but great exercise and nice harbour bars when you get there.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A good beach for everyone
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It isn’t easy to rate beaches in Portugal where all beaches are perfect. But Falésia beach is neat, there are small restaurants, good and clean WC, showers...everything you need and the most important - with a beautiful view :)

reviewsWithKeywords.title: No facilities
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely long stretch of beach, clean sand and some sun beds.  Hotel courtesy bus dropped us off and we walked down quite a few steep steps to get to the beach only to find nothing other than the sun beds, if you needed drinks or the toilet you had to go back up they way and in 30 degree heat it was hot work, the bar and the toilet at the top was disgusting, no seat, no toilet roll or anything to wash hands with, didn't get name of the place though but I know it was not near the PineCliffs it was much further along the way to Villamoura.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Family holiday
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great Beach wave's a bit big for childrenBeach has good Sand now stone's on it me and my lovely wife have had some nice walks on it

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A beautiful pristine beach.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Albufeira is justifiably famous for its innumerable beaches that are really clean and Falesia Beach is one of my favourites.I love the look of this beach and last year when we visited Albufeira we swam from this beach,the waves can get a bit choppy and makes for a fun way to pass an hour or so .With temperatures hitting the 30°+ ( in October WOW ) we couldn't resist going in,the waves were stunning,took me off my  feet a few times and pushed around a bit by the force of the waves,I had a great time as did our group ,we stayed here about an hour before drying off in the sun and going to a beach front bar. Above the beach there are some nice bars and restaurants were you can enjoy a beer or a snack and admire the beach. A great beach and one of many on this resort and well worth checking out.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Falesia beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great beach clean plenty of lifeguards in attendance only negative surf comes in at some rate may need to keep an eye on youngsters and oldies as we saw several people being taken of their feet by the power of the surf.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning just stunning
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Gorgeous beach, lovely views and ideal for a quiet trip to the beach! Restaurant conveniently placed to get coffee and ice creams from and have a meal. Definitely worth the trip down the steps

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Worth a visit, as with most of the beaches in the Algarve !  Swimming can be difficult for the young children or older people, big waves and can be steep inclines.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lots of steps but worth it.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A good 20 minutes walk from Clube Humbria and lots of steps which don'tmake it easy for pushchairs. Restaurants on the beach and parasols/sunbeds

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Holiday
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach, we walked from portabay falesia to vilamora along the beach, which is a good 9 miles there and back, and if you do it when tides out its a lovely leisurely walk

reviewsWithKeywords.title: beautiful area and beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: stayed near this beach last year and would highly recommend. there are a lot of steps down to the beach so not good for anyone with mobility issues.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: STUNNING VIEWS
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach comprising fine sand and shallow beach.  Beach is backed by high cliffs subject to erosion for which signs indicate possible danger from falling rocks etc if you stand too close. If you view the sea from the top of the cliff there a great views but access has to be gained from elsewhere.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely beach with fabulous waves!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach has plenty of space, so there is no problem finding some space away from the crowds.  It was not noisy so peace to read and sunbathe and the water was great for swimming in, with some fantastic waves.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is beautiful. Ok its got shells on it but the views are stunning and plenty of sunbeds or just space to chill and relax.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice sandy beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful sandy Algarvae beach with red cliff. Not ideal for young kids as there is an undercurrent and strong waves. Fantastic sunset. The Pinecliff hotel has an access to the beach so has Epic Sana hotel .

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Holiday
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Sun ... swam... scenery superb... secluded stretches.... clean water... clean beach....beach restaurant very expensive.... better try ohlos De agua for better prices... enjoy....

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Walking on the sea beech set against giant red sand stone mountains
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It is a lovely walk for one mile, then you come back and enjoy the beech restaurant drinks and ice cream

reviewsWithKeywords.title: beautiful beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A small slice of heaven walking along the wonderful Falesia beach, soft sand and stunning cliffs as a back drop.  Highly recommend a visit

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stayed 10mins away from Falasia beach it,s stunning !
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We stayed for a week 10mins away from Falasia beach, it,s really stunning, beautiful beach, plenty of sun beds with umbrellas but we just used our towels as there quite expensive @ 10 euro,s per day !  It,s well kept and was,nt overly busy for this time of year Don,t know about the summer months though.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Gorgeous beach that's really nice and quite compared with some other beaches near albuferia. Must visit in the morning when the tide is out. Will be back.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: And chillax
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We visit this beach every day as long as we can get sun loungers & shade! Snack /drink bar on beach, prices reasonable! Only complaint I have are the loo, it is very well used But filthy, I don't think Any one cleans up or clears tissue mess all day, makes it more difficult to bear.Dont know if the staff looking after the loungers and snack bar, are responsible fog The Loo, but cold on it is 2017, we are a bit more civilised, other than that, beach is beautiful, lovely place to soak up the sun, listening to the waves and chilling out !

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful sandy beach.  Well kept and clean, plenty of room when we were there.  Need to take your own chairs/parasols but loads of space to spread out

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We loved this beach - you could walk for miles and miles. It had loads of space and loads of sunbeds.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: beautiful sandy beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach by far was one of the cleaniest longest you can walk all the way to villamour marina. A good workout fabulous views of the hills

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Super beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Must be one of the best beaches on the Algarve, Limited eating , drinking and shopping areas but plenty of space with a very long expanse of sand, lot of loungers available all day. Car parking available close to beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely beach!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Gorgeous beach. Life guards present and beautiful cliffs...some idiots climbing them!!!Clean beach and sea.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Golden sands
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A long gold sands beach with some cafes and toilets and occasional sun beds to hire. In early September it was never crowded

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach, shame about the super expensive restaurants on it!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Falesia beach is a beautiful long beach which allows for plenty of space for you to not be cramped up next to others like on some beaches close by. I recommend taking a packed lunch if you want to spend the day there as there are only two restaurants that we could see. We ate at one called Beach Club Pine Cliffs by Olivier but it was SOOO ridiculously expensive. You can get to this beach by car or by walking over some slightly rocky coves from the local beach in Olhos de Agua. We walked from the local beach which was a lovely little trek and took about 30 minutes.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very long beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Loved walking this beach every day. It's deceptively long. Once we walked as far as the Marina in Vilamoura- around 4K away. Really enjoyed the walkis, there's a nice breeze in September. And not overcrowded this time of year

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Expensive sunbeds !!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice clean busy beach over the top prices for sunbeds ! Because of that wouldn't go here .. Prefer to stay by pool at hotel 15€ for sunbed !!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Absolutely stunning beach but very few cafes/bars
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is stunning, especially on a clear sunny day where the red cliffs contrast so beautifully with the blue sky. The sea is clean and the sand is "proper" sand, lovely and golden. It's a huge, huge beach so depending on where you choose to sit, there aren't many beach chairs, bars or cafes on the beach. The beach chairs are fairly pricey (we paid around €16 for two) so pack some sun umbrellas if you want to save money. Where any taxi will drop you off, there's a little cafe, but they didn't seem to have much in the way of food. Pack some snacks and food! If you don't mind walking 5/10 minutes there are loads of places to eat up the main road where you enter. I also heard there's an amazing restaurant at some point on the stretch of beach, but we didn't go. Don't let the lack of beach bats put you off though, as it really is an amazing place to relax away from the super crowded beaches closer to the centre.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Paradise
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely clean beach, with white sand and clear sea water.  Bit cold at first but then lovely to swim in and nice waves which made it fun

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great Beach fantastic views
reviewsWithKeywords.text: psssst, don't tell anyone because we don't want to spoil it but this beech is fantastic.if you want hundreds of sun beds with hundreds of people sitting on them - your going to hate it.If however you want a nice beach thats not too busy this is the one - but don't tell anyone as we don't want to spoil it ;-)

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Holiday / anniversary
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Two weeks at the Sensimar to celebrate our wedding anniversary, a special thanks to Sandra Gabbert guest relations manager which made our day special.This was our 4th stay, as expected we had a fantastic time, the staff are amazing, very helpful, courteous and friendly.The rooms are clean, modern and well kept.There are plenty of sun beds No queues first thing in the morning like some hotels. Poolside is well managed and the gardens are lovely.Sandra Gabbert guest relations manager is excellent and goes the extra mile to ensure requests are met.Sensimar Los Gigantes maybe you should visit this hotel to see how a Sensimar should be run.Tom Yates  Warwickshire.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: One of the better beaches!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Really nice wide, long beach. No horrible rocks in the swimming areas unlike some of the other beaches. Really relaxing to paddle away and look at the beautiful cliffs.Warning: if you take the sun loungers to the right they are expensive at 9.00 euros each and you don't even get a mattress! Also the old guy who collected the money was rude and hovers around quite a bit, he made me feel really uncomfortable!!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Early morning walk, then great coffee & water
reviewsWithKeywords.text: You can walk Falesia beach for quite some time. Best time is to arrive "early" morning, but you will not be alone (lots of company !!). Still worth the walk, sea around your feet, & sound of the surf. Turn around after 30 mins & walk into the sun for your return trip. Arrive @ any of the beach bars, for a deserved coffee or water. Great sunbathing (& maybe a spot of lunch). Really popular (in season) or @ weekend with locals. A great place to simply chill.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: One of the Finest Beaches in all of Europe
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a wide and long (approximately 10km) sandy beach that sits directly below beautiful white and ochre cliffs with high pine trees, and that is perfect for taking long walks (you can even take a 1hr. long walk to the next town on Vilamoura).  The water is clear and free of stones or rocks, and the beach is well serviced.  The restaurant that is operated by the adjacent Pine Cliffs Resort is a bit pricey, but the burgers, the piri piri chicken, and the sangria are all amazing, and well worth the price.  In short, this beach is both comfortable and picturesque.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: What a fantasic beach...
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Clean, friendly and the water beautifully warm and paddling friendly. Bugger to get off as steps numerous but break areas and lovely cafe at the top with ice cream and beer!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very good and clean
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is wonderful. We spent some time there walking clean everywhere. Never seen any litter at any time.Plenty of space for privacy.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Wow
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I decided to go for a wander down there and was amazed how big and spacious it was.Water was very cold Hardly anyone in there.I ran on this beach the following morning and I got 2 miles one way and 2 miles back what a lovley run .Nice restaurant halfway too

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a lovely beach thats stretches for miles, there's plenty of sun beds and a couple of bars to sit at and enjoy the view. The sea is freezing cold!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: day at beach.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: great busy beach, many locals visit here..great beach bar on upper level and decking steps to beach on lower level..

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beach walk
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice beach to walk along with beach cafes along the way. Sunbeds and umbrellas available by the cafes.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Certainly not the best beach in the area !
reviewsWithKeywords.text: No outstanding features on this beach. Others had more to offer eg interesting rock formation, vibey restaurants etc.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fabulous beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We stayed at the Portobay Falesia and had great views of this wonderful beach from above the cliffs.  Access from the hotel and the areas alongside was by over 130 steps but in all honesty not arduous if take your time.  There is an access track down for vehicles and parking at the bottom by a beach restaurant or on road approach.  There are two restaurants we could see, first one is a great bar and restaurant serving great value snacks, lunches and dinner.  We visited several times, and fresh sardines were great as a treat for lunch.  Further along is another beach restaurant but this is linked to the Pine Cliffs hotel, so far more expensive and slick.  Not the place for a cheap snack.  Beach has areas of sundress and umbrellas as reports have already stated below, and also set areas for if you have brought your own seats and umbrellas, which was popular.  Sand was very nice and and sea  shelved nicely.  Surprisingly sea was not as cold as we expected, and welcoming to have a dip.  Waves are occasionally a touch bigger and great fun, but normally it excessive.  To the right there are areas of rock pools for the children, and adults like us for a bit of fun.  To the left the beach extends so far and great for long walk and guess you'd find yourself in Villamora eventually, not that we tried it.  Was t excessively crowded at all on any of our visits.Overall was great place to sunbathe, have a dip, nice walk, and visit the restaurant.  There were lifeguards on duty every time we were there.  Can't think of a better beach we found in the area.  Well worth a visit for the day.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very nice
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Recommend. You find parking places around the beach. The sunbeds are 18 euros during september and the beach is i credible nice !

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The Falésia was beautiful, it is definitely work walking up early to see the sun rise, it's a breath taking experience.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fabulous Falesia!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Stayed at Alfamar Villas which is 2 minutes away from this fabulous beach. On recommendation from a friend we went onto the beach out of the Alfamar and headed left towards Vilamoura. It's a long walk but the views are great all the way and there are watering holes just when you need them. There are also plenty of boardwalks if walking on the sand is too tiring. The reddish colour of cliffs, typical of the Algarve, which line the route blend beautifully with the soft golden sands of the beach and they have ever changing shapes, often looking as though they have started to melt. The cliff tops have regular clusters of conifers which add another dimension and another colour leaving only the blues of the sea and the sky to complete the palette. Bathing in the Atlantic is invigorating but beware as there are rip tides but warning notices are posted. If you are in the area and fancy a day on the beach, this is the one!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fantastic and beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We went as a family in April this year and this beach was a real highlight. Our children loved it and we many lovely walks along it. Not sure how busy it gets in the peak of summer but in April for Easter it was very pleasant . It's worth noting tide times as we found with two young children that high tide was not much use but the hours just before and after low tide left a wonderful safe playground for them which they happily occupied themselves for hours. We stayed at Pine cliffs and there is a restaurant on the beach which was a bonus although at busy times we had to wait some time for a table, tip is to get yourself on a waiting list an hour before you think you will want to eat.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Be prepared for 73 steps but worth it
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Stunning scenery, beautiful beach and cliff top walk. Be mindful of 73 steps down to the beach. If you want the cliff top walk, lots more to contend with, then back again. Cliff top has no safety rail, sheer drop down so keep a tight hold on the little ones.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great beach miles of golden sand. Safe to swim and families . With a couple of restaurants for a cool drink.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice view
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful coastline, the rusty colour of the rocks is amazing.Also plenty of pretty shells to collect.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We really enjoyed visiting this beach. The water was deep enough for a swim but safe enough for kids to go in too. Restaurants located on the beach were quite nice. We didn't know how to rent sun loungers so on the second day that we went down we took our towels and a parasol which was cheap enough from the local supermarket (about 5 euros i think). Lot's of steps down to the beach so be prepared to walk! There is a lift half way up though. Overall, very nice beach and we would visit again!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Quiet and open
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Clean and safe depth ideal for swimming and bath in. 2 high quality restaurants overlooking the beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Awesome Falesia
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Long stretch of beach along the Algarve coast. Lots of water activities and snack and drink shops. Beautiful ! Easy to rent chairs and umbrellas. Beach goes on for miles ! Great for a long walk and a refreshing Atlantic swim.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Falesia beach

reviewsWithKeywords.text: Most people set down around the entrance to the beach and beach huts with food.. Walking along the beach towards Vilamoura you can usually find a quieter spot. Although I must say Portuguese family's are perfect beach companions. Very happy and respectful :)

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Praia Da Falesia is one of the most beautiful beaches along the coastline of the Algarve and Albufeira in particular. A wide expanse of golden and red sands ,nice rock formations in the background and the waves here are gentle,perfect for swimming, its a popular beach but due to its size ,its a big long beach it never seems crowded even in high season, its a beach to most definitely check out if you're planning a holiday to Albufeira.

reviews.title: “Falésia Beach: a 6km paradise in the Algarve”🙏🏾😍

The blend of the colors of the golden sand, the crystal blue sea and the imposing cliffs make it one of the most beautiful beaches in Portugal.Perfect for both long walks and relaxing in the sun. A real postcard from the Algarve that deserves to be visited

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach!
reviews.text: Beautiful beach!!!! A must visit if you are in the area. We got a Uber and spent the day here. There is free parking.There is a restaurant with toilets. Sun beds are clean with parasols and wind breaks. X2 beds and parasol was 20euro, cash only.

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: The Beach of the Falls in Eyes of Water is simply stunning! From the moment we arrived, we were surrendered to the natural beauty of this place. The orange-tone cliffs, contrasting with the intense blue of the sea and the goldenness of the sand, create a landscape worthy of postcard — it’s hard to find words to describe such beauty.The beach is extensive, perfect for long walks by the sea, always with the incredible landscape of the arribas to accompany. The sand is fine, the water is clean and inviting, and even on the busiest days there is always room to relax.Another highlight is the tranquility: despite being a very sought after beach, its dimension allows you to enjoy moments of calm and quiet, ideal for both families and couples or even for those who like to practice outdoor sports.The infrastructure is excellent, with well-maintained accesses and support areas that make the experience even more enjoyable.Without a doubt, one of the most beautiful beaches not only of the Algarve, but of all of Europe. I recommend 100% and will come back whenever I can — it is impossible not to fall in love with this paradise!

reviews.title: Very good

Some dangerous waves, watch out for windy days, there's a lot of power. Pleasant water at 25 degrees.

reviews.text: The beach of Falésia Alfamar, has a concession, as I did not know in terms of hygiene. At the end of the day at 7:00, all mattresses are cleaned and disinfected. Then they are kept in the House of the Beach. Excellent Service for those who come the next day.

The best beach I've ever visited, well worth going is beautiful there's no place like this!  The beach is quite large and with plenty of space, it is a well spent day with a beautiful landscape and at sunset it gets even better!

reviews.text: For me, the prettiest. Considering I'm a Galician, that's a lot to say.The beach is huge and the water is very clean and with good temperature. But what distinguishes this beach from the others is its back, those wonderful slopes reminiscent of the Cappadocia or the Grand Canyon. Anyway, wonderful.

reviews.title: Falesia Beach – Beauty and Tranquillity Combined
reviews.text: Falesia Beach is truly a hidden gem. The scenery is absolutely breathtaking, with dramatic cliffs and pristine coastline creating a perfect backdrop for a peaceful day by the sea. The atmosphere was incredibly calm and relaxing, with most visitors simply enjoying the tranquillity — it was the ideal place to unwind.My fiancé and I loved it so much, we visited twice during our trip. To reach the beach, you take a lift down followed by a long wooden walkway, which in itself is an experience. The walk offers stunning views of the natural landscape and towering cliffs — it felt like part of the adventure.If you’re looking for a peaceful, scenic beach with a unique journey down, Falesia Beach is a must-visit.

reviews.title: Breathtaking Special Place
reviews.text: Amazing place. Breathtaking landscape and scenery. The whole area felt so safe compared to other beaches I've been on. It also seems to be less crowded than beaches in Albufeira. We paid €14 for 2 sunbeds with an umbrella which we could use all day, I thought was a fair price. Be aware that if you're driving to the beach there's little parking space so it might be better to take a shuttle bus. There is a small shop at the beach but only sells food so bring suncream, beach balls etc. with you. There's also a vendor walking the beach selling drinks, but again take your own to avoid paying a premium. Overall a lovely place

reviews.title: Beautiful beach with all facilities you need.
reviews.text: This is a stunning beach with excellent facilities. It has a laid back feel, plenty of sunbeds and parasols, but also plenty of room to just throw down a towel and sunbathe! The sea was warm, great for swimming and lifeguards on beach. Small snack bar at top of steps with toilets. Stunning dramatic cliffs, beautiful scenic beach that feels relaxed even when busy.

reviews.title: We just loved it.

reviews.title: A Beautiful Beach!

reviews.title: An enchantment...

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Beautiful beach, there's a few bars that do good food but quite pricey.The sea is blue, tide comes in and blocks the coves so be careful!

reviews.title: Location, location, location!
reviews.text: Stunning beach backed by red cliffs, goes on for miles. Sun beds etc available for rent, with a restaurant onsite when refreshment needed. reviews.title: A very nice beach

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: Large beach with different deckchair rentals, Awards vary by location.Few opportunities to go to the toilet near the deckchairs and no beach cafe either you have to leave the beach.

reviews.title: Falesia Beach
reviews.text: A superb beach to visit.  Si wide and long and unspoilt.  Breathtaking really, a wonderful place to spend the day.  Sunbathing and relaxing.

reviews.title: What a view!
reviews.text: Definitely a beach to visit. The rocks / cliffs connect to the beach making it a beautiful view from on top of the cliffs as well as below on the beach. You do have to take some stairs to get to the beach and the walk to the cliffs is of course a bit on the style side.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Absolutely beautiful coastline. The red cliffs are stunning. Only criticism is that there are no toilets at the beach.

reviews.title: Big but beautiful
reviews.text: large but impressive beach. beautiful sandy beach with beautiful rocks. It is busier because there are large stretches of free beach but definitely worth going there for a day

reviews.title: The beach has rightly received an Award
reviews.text: Have been totally enthusiastic about this beach as it extends over several kilometers. Means first of all, no mass tourism and close to lying. This is especially the case in well-known coves. Here you can relax wonderfully, walk on the beach and at the same time enjoy the picturesque scenery. Would come back again!

reviews.title: Lovely beach.
reviews.text: Great beach. Comfortable loungers most with parasols or canopies.Parking is chaotic but just be patient and a space will become available!!

reviews.title: Stunning beautufil beach.
reviews.text: Absolutely stunning landscape views. It is a bit hard to get to but you can get a cab to get there. Beautiful blue sea waters. beautiful people around.

reviews.title: cliffs of beautiful colors
reviews.text: yes but important overtourism,watch out for the swell.To do at least once for the beauty of the cliffs that inexorably crumble what will be left in 10 years,enjoy by maintaining

reviews.title: Beautiful, like so many others. She's ⁇  not the most beautiful in the world.
reviews.text: An exaggeration the alarm they make this beach. Don't go with so many expectations. Hard to park unless you arrive early. Albufeira and the whole Algarve has beautiful beaches and this in particular has more advertising than something exceptional.

reviews.title: Beautiful beaches
reviews.text: Stayed here for several days.What a beautiful setting and beautiful beach.Beach is super wide and clean and the cliffs are very nice. Can anyone recommend this beach

reviews.title: Beautiful crag
reviews.text: I remember with pleasure the colors of the sea and the cliff. Beautiful and very long beach, absolutely worth a visit.

reviews.title: Not the Caribbean
reviews.text: We have been coming to this beach for over  30  years . It is clean , it is wide and it has spectacular cliffs and scenery . As one that loves Caribbean beaches with white sands and warm waters , I can understand some comments . But Falesia is what it is . Not a Caribbean beach but a wild natural landscape with  a stunning backdrop . The Atlantic is cold !!

reviews.title: Praia Maravilha
reviews.text: One of the most spectacular beaches in the Algarve, considered one of the best in the world. Its extensive sandland invites to good walks, because of its hard and straight floor but only when the tide is low. When it is high despite its extension it almost no longer has areal. I think that the competent authorities should see what is happening in the Portuguese sandy areas and take measures in this direction because within a few years they will cease to exist.

reviews.title: Overrated beach.
reviews.text: I don't know why people love this  beach.  It's nothing special at all. And definitely not the best beach in the world. Clearly some people haven't traveled to the Caribbean.Firstly this beach is hard to get to. You must drive on unpaved gravel roads. It's a narrow beach with no amenities like showers and change rooms.It has one overpriced restaurant. The waves are insane. Not for kids that's for sure.Praia de Tunel is way better.

reviews.title: Beach with family
reviews.text: Beautiful beach with ochre cliffs.The water is clean and clear, with very few waves. You can swim away with your feet

reviews.title: Not for all
reviews.text: Very long beach in a beautiful setting.  Dont expect many amenities,  bars , shops etc.  No showers to wash off , no pedalos or jet skiing here. Making your own entertainment is a must. Some areas are not easily accessible for elderly or less abled.

reviews.title: Big cliff
reviews.text: This beach has many good things. I'll tell you.1 - It is huge, so even if there are many people it is easy to find quiet areas. 2 - It has some chiringuito along its extension.3 - Paid umbrella area on each of the staircases.4 - It is very flat and long so if you like walking is your beach. You can run perfectly even with sneakers. It is beautiful, different and the water is very crystal clear.5 - It doesn't have much swell so padel surfing is made comfortable.Council: If you drive and load..... As was my case, go with the vehicle to the end of the tarmac road. There's a roundabout, you stand there and let them get off with all the barbells. Then you have parking nearby. Use Google Maps and see how close it is. I leave you some pictures to help you.  It is almost everything down from the car park to one of the main downhills. We went when there were already a lot of people and still there was a lot of room to park in the place I indicated. In Google Maps it looks like you can park on the road descent but it does not, there are pivots on both sides to avoid this.

reviews.title: Praia da Falesia, what a beach!
reviews.text: One of the nicest beaches in the world.  The landscape with its “sandmountains” is spectacular.  The beach is wide and I have never seen it crowded, you can walk for miles….

reviews.title: Must see!
reviews.text: Beautiful beach and big enough, come in the morning because it fills up fast.The cliffs make it a must-see beach in algarve

reviews.title: Oasis of peace
reviews.text: Very long beach suitable for those who want to relax independently or want to stay away from the rest of the people given the vastness of space it has.Characterized by red cliffs and a soft golden sand that makes every step by the sea almost seem like a caress.It is absolutely not one of the most beautiful beaches in the world as the Portuguese claim but I loved it.

reviews.title: Pretty but crowded in summer
reviews.text: Nice beach but very crowded in summer. You have to be patient to find a good place especially in August when the big tide coefficients.

reviews.title: Best in the world.
reviews.text: Nicest beach in the world? I think so. Beautiful turquoise waters remaining shallow for a considerable distance, overlooked by gorgeous red cliffs and usually bright blue skies. Definitely worth a visit!

reviews.title: Relaxant
reviews.text: Falésia Beach, located in Eyes of Water, is one of the most impressive jewels of the Algarve, known for its extent of golden sands, crystal clear waters and imposing red cliffs that create a postcard setting. This beach offers a bathing experience that combines natural beauty with tranquility, making it an unforgettable destination for those who visit the region.

reviews.title: Spectacular and very nice
reviews.text: Excellent beach, super clean, sand without stone, water a little cold but tolerable, although there are hours when you do not feel so much cold, there is no strong surf, children can enjoy quietly.

reviews.title: Lovely simple friendly beach!
reviews.text: Best beach of our holiday so far. Wanted to try somewhere new but not a long drive away from Albufeira. There are a number of sunbeds and parasols for hire but not huge numbers. With most families bringing their own we did it have an issue. The sea is beautiful with the red cliff backdrop and you can walk out quite a way before having to swim. There are a lot of steps down to the beach so I’d recommend you buy drinks etc at the snack bar at the top when you arrive. They do takeaway and eat in pizza, baguettes, salads for lunch but prepare to queue! Definitely worth a visit 😊

reviews.title: Overrated
reviews.text: Nothing special except the cliff but super crowded. Few umbrellas available and even if you just want to lay out a towel difficult to find a space

reviews.title: Great day at an amazing beach!
reviews.text: Omg what a beautiful beach! My husband and I truly enjoyed our visit today. Parking was a nightmare but we lucked out and got a great spot. A little tough walking back up if someone has disability or walking issues. The little bar is nice but because of the crowds you will wait at least 30 minutes for a hot order . To be expected due to high volume of tourists .

reviews.title: A must see in the Algarve!
reviews.text: One of the most beautiful beaches in the Algarve! The beach is large, the water is warm, there are not many waves, it is ideal for swimming. The ochre cliffs just behind you are exceptionally beautiful.Place to absolutely see in my opinion.

reviews.title: Falésia Sempre
reviews.text: On Birthday.. We will be back soon..  It has apartments for rent, swimming pools for adults or children, shadows, with regular maintenance..

reviews.title: Beautiful landscape, excellent for some walks.
reviews.text: Beach elected the best in the world with a stunning cliff and a wonderful view.The variations of the color of the cliff and its height to the sand of the beach create a unique environment that makes us breathe deep and enjoy this little paradise.At the top of the cliff, it's fantastic to see the roots of the trees come out of the cliffWater is at a very good temperature, beautiful landscape, excellent for walking.

reviews.title: Super strand
reviews.text: Great beautiful beach, clean fine waves.Not too busy.Berliner bulbs are sold by people who live there. They walk around on the beach.You can rent sunbeds and umbrellas.

reviews.title: Spectacular Golden Beach
reviews.text: The beach is beautiful, spectacularly golden, very clean and the sea really is crystal clear.  We sunbathed without another soul around (it's a really long beach, it goes on for miles) and the kids swam in the sea, bit chilly for me, but I did a paddle.  It's close to where we stayed, Aldeia do Golf, and although easy to get on to from the Marina end, there is a quicker route to get directly on to the beach - but the sign is easy to miss, unless you actually stop by the main traffic lights in to Vilamoura and have time to look!  It could be much better signposted.  Plenty of free parking too and we walked directly on to the boardwalk and beach from the car park.

reviews.title: Not for buggies!
reviews.text: First there are some stairs to overcome, first down. With buggy absolutely not easy! Beach itself is very nice but busy! When closing stairs up also difficult and especially with buggy, although the bar upstairs is a big plus! (Ice cream is also possible)!

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Incredibly nice beach. Clean and beautiful water. There is parking a bit away but otherwise no cars allowed.

reviews.title: Normal beach like a thousand others. To see without expectations
reviews.text: Wide beach with the right spaces which is not bad.Not bad but nothing special.Equipped. There is also a nice walk

reviews.title: Superb beach, the most beautiful in Algarve in my review
reviews.text: Beautiful beach, the most beautiful in the Algarve Clean and hot water.Very few parking spaces (except on praia grande near armacao do pena, it is difficult to park near the beaches in the Algarve)Small snack with toilet at the top of the beach c is convenient

reviews.title: Beautiful but not as wonderful as they say
reviews.text: A beautiful beach but definitely not the most beautiful in the Algarve. I believe that the fame of the best beach made us frustrated when we visited... but it is beautiful, huge and clean.

reviews.title: Pretty
reviews.text: Parking would be limited on a very busy day. A little trek to the actual beach itself. It’s a little narrow but very pretty beach. Deck chairs and  umbrellas can be hired. Avoid all together with an onshore storm wind. Otherwise I would definitely return.

reviews.title: Very long and particular
reviews.text: This beach stretches for km between the village of Vilamoura and the town of Albufeira, is deep, equipped, with several dining options. The main feature is to have behind a long chain of reddish rocks, eroded by the wind, which are called cliffs, which create a show of colors with the sunset light. Beach not very crowded, also suitable for families.

reviews.title: Gorgeous experience
reviews.text: The beach is incredible and such friendly people. It wasn't till the second day we noticed the umbrellas to the right for the restaurant and we much preferred there as it was a bit more peaceful.Couldn't ask for more from a beach - wonderful place

reviews.title: Beautiful beach but increased Thefts!! Beware!
reviews.text: Beautiful beach, BUT.. someone broke our car window which was parked in the parking area next to the beach, took our belongings including bags which had wallets from the boot. So, we ended up calling the police and going back! Thefts have increased near the beach this year, so please dont keep anything valuable , your IDs etc., in the car. There is police patrolling the area, but these criminals know the gap between their patrols and have been increasingly targeting tourists this year near the beach! The police were quite helpful and they themselves told us about the increase in thefts near the beach area. We had gotten out of our car, went down to the beach. Came back up in 10 mins to get some cash for the Lidos and discovered the car was broken into! So it happened quite fast. :/ Those criminals must have kept an eye on us when we got there to have done that so fast. Unfortunately for us, the trip ended being a nightmare thereafter. Always advisable to get travel insurance and rental insurance if you are renting a car( which most tourists do).

reviews.title: Nice and well located
reviews.text: Nice beach, plenty to drink before going down to the beach and the sunbed rental was 6.5 EUR/person (for me because no price is shown)

reviews.title: Y'all must be crazy
reviews.text: I really do not understand how this beach or any beach in the south of Portugal be on top list. Spent a week in the Algarve and the beaches are mediocre at best. Whoever is giving this 5 ⭐ needs to go to south/southeast Asia. There is no comparison. That area of the world is in a different league when it comes to beaches. This is a good example of people who have not traveled rating beaches.

reviews.title: An inspiration!
reviews.text: One of the most beautiful beaches in the Algarve, with its cliffs and transparent water, large extent of sand to stroll. Improving ⁇  access to the beach and support infrastructure for swimmers.

reviews.title: Stunning

reviews.text: One of the most beautiful beaches ever seen for sand, water, rocks that form a backdrop with breathtaking colors and which seems to never end

reviews.title: Long walk and very beautiful colors.
reviews.text: Starting from Ohlos de Agua the beach is several kilometers long. A little crowded near the access points but very easy to be very quiet by moving away a little. Allows you to make a 15km round trip while walking on the sand. Very beautiful colors thanks to the cliff which dominates the beach. Several accesses by stairs with parking.

reviews.title: Gorgeous
reviews.text: Gorgeous beach with miles of golden sand. Access isn’t easy but various points that take you down to the sand and sea. Not a piece of rubbish in sight. Perfect for a morning stroll or evening wander.

reviews.title: We are opposite the EPIC SANA ALGARVE hotel, the place we stayed!
reviews.text: A wonderful beach to stay at, although the sea is still very cold, but it is beautiful!! But the formation of cliffs around the sea makes the beach more enchanting. It's wonderful, I highly recommend it!!

reviews.title: Relax, sun and sea. Beautiful
reviews.text: Very wide and beautiful beach, about 5 km long with beautiful water. You can take long walks with a stop in one of the small bars

reviews.title: Kilometers of sandy beach
reviews.text: Very beautiful, spacious kilometer-long beach with beautiful rock formations. You can walk for kilometers. The beach is accessible via a few wooden walkways.At sunset, the rocks glow in beautiful colors.

reviews.title: Sunrise
reviews.text: We went there at half 5am cause we went to see the sun rise. But unfortunately it didn't rise from that location.But when it started to get bright it looked like a beautiful place

reviews.title: Things to do on Praia da Falésia beach
reviews.text: This is a fabulous beach with soft sand and interesting rock pools at low tide. Plenty of deck chairs and umbrellas for 20€ a day (2 bed and Brolly). There is also a Massage hut near the entrance to the beach  (50€ full body) and it’s one of the best I’ve ever had.The O Golfinho restaurant serves snacks and meals, and I’d definitely recommend the strawberry or mango daiquiri… well worth a visit.

A lot of magnificent rocks and shell around.  A must..

reviews.title: Algarve Pearl
reviews.text: After seeing all the comments saying that this is the number 1 beach in Europe and one of the most beautiful in the world, I come here to give my positive vote because everything here is beautiful, beautiful cliffs, huge beach, white sand with no dirt, incredible . I loved it even though the water is still cold at this time of year lol

reviews.title: Best holiday's
reviews.text: Falesia is one of the most beautiful beaches in the Algarve, I recommend it because it is huge, wonderful, there is plenty of space to park if you take a car, and for children to play it is ideal.

reviews.title: A good beach.
reviews.text: A very comfortable beach. I went at the end of April, it wasn't very hot yet and the sandbanks weren't crowded. It was a very pleasant period.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Beautiful and relaxing. Good access with wooden stairs and benches along the way but you need to have reasonable mobility and strength. There are reasonable priced loungers with umbrellas for rent at the bottom of the stairs if you don't want to carry yours down.

reviews.title: too quiet
reviews.text: there is nothing much at this resort unless you are a total sunworshiperfinding out bus times was a nightmare so often had to get taxis back to resort

reviews.title: Great Experience at the beach
reviews.text: It was a beautiful summer day and the sun was shining bright. The sound of the waves crashing against the shore was soothing and relaxing. I could feel the sand between my toes as I walked along the beach, enjoying the warmth of the sun on my skin. The salty breeze blew through my hair as I sat down on the sand and watched the seagulls fly overhead. It was the perfect day to be at the beach, and I was grateful for the peaceful moments I was able to enjoy.

reviews.title: Great Place to Visit
reviews.text: Just amazing when seen for the first time, walk the beach or hike above it is definitely worth a trip the Praia da Falesia. Just the combination of ocean and very high hills is wonderful.

reviews.title: Magnificent
reviews.text: Fantastic long beach, peaceful, with lots of magnificent rocks and shells around. Good facilities. Worth it: the drive down to the parking lot is rather steep and narrow.

reviews.title: This is a must see!
reviews.text: Very impressive, lots of steps down and back up but it is worth the effort.  Once at the bottom the cliffs are a marvel of mother nature, and the walk of the beach at low tide is a great exercise.

reviews.title: Good

reviews.title: Beautiful beach, I hope they don't ruin it...
