reviews.title: Trip to beach with 4 year old.
reviews.text: Love this beach, it seemed nice and clean.  There are a few places on the way to the steps that are a sheer drop and a bit scary but only if you go near to the edge! Keep a hold of your kids on way to steps I’d recommend!

reviews.title: Stunning beach
reviews.text: This was an amazing beach with stunning views. The sea is a gorgeous blue colour and the beach is clean. It can get busy at peak seasons but if you walk down the beach there are always clear spots. My advice would be to bring your own parasol if travelling in peak time. They get booked up quick and your own will give you the freedom to base yourself anywhere. Also it takes about 25 minutes but you can walk all the way down the beach to get to Villamora Marina which is also stunning.

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: Lovely beach with white sand. Not too busy as it is very large. A few beach bars and restaurants dotted about. Plenty of sunbeds available

reviews.title: Lovely Sandy Beach
reviews.text: Miles of clean sandy beach. Rolling waves and surf boards for hire. Some water sports activities available but best for sun bathing

reviews.title: Beach with a view :)
reviews.text: I think that this beach is on top 3 for Algarve, nice view, silent place, good sand and cold ocean!! :)

reviews.title: Great beach
reviews.text: This is a lovely beach with lovely cafe at top of the steps. The only frustration is the cost of the beds now. Although we hadn’t been to Portugal for a few years, we weren’t expecting to pay €17 for 2 beds all day.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Just amazing scenery. The bright cliffs and dazzling blue sea couldn’t be any better. Came here everyday on my 7 day trip.

reviews.title: Great beach!!!!!
reviews.text: Loved every second being here.Excellent view from the cliff. Very impressive. Great beach no rocks strictley sand.

reviews.title: what a Beach
reviews.text: we stayed at the Pine Cliffs Resort and this beautiful beach with red rock formation is right in front of this resort. It is 8 km long , with beautiful, soft sand, clear ocean water for swimming, several restaurants on the beach as well, also good for long walks..

reviews.title: beautiful beach
reviews.text: Beautiful beach with a long stretch of soft sand and clean water. It is a must visit if you’re in the area

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: We walked this beach for four of the seven days we in Portugal. It’s a lot of steps down to the beach, but it is worth it. The beach is a credit to the local people. We saw only two pieces of litter on the beach whilst walking it ( and we picked it up). The cliffs are beautiful. Well worth the visit.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Absolutely gorgeous beach.  The cliffs are phenomenal. Parking in the area is a little tricky. The sand is soft and comfortable. Water was chilly but people still were enjoying a swim

reviews.title: Lovely Beach.
reviews.text: Falesia Beach was very clean and not too crowded when we visited in July. A bit of a trek down the steps though!!

reviews.title: My happy place
reviews.text: This beach is amazing.. so peaceful and lovely clean sand and sea. perfect for families and for a wee stroll and an ice cream :)

reviews.title: Great beach and fantastic view of the Cliffs
reviews.text: Excellent sandy beach, lots of fun was had by building sand castles.  The water was cold but the kids still loved it.

reviews.title: Access Difficult From Riu Guarana
reviews.text: Access is via a long wooden walkway and many steps which would be unsuitable for many. Take the branch to the right and you access directly onto a small cove/ beach with no facilities. Go to the left and you can access the main beach but over rocks and only at low tide

reviews.title: Enormous
reviews.text: Such a beautiful place. We did the hike on the cliffs for about 3,5kms, breath taking views, then went on to the beach. It’s so big you will have all the room you want. There are beds and umbrellas. Amazing place !

reviews.title: Beautiful but needs easier access
reviews.text: You have to walk down quite a few stairs to get to the beach at the Olhos de aguas end, other than that it’s beautiful, clean and has amenities like sunbeds/umbrellas and toilets, the Vilamoura end is a little easier accessed but doesn’t have the pretty cliff views.

reviews.title: Gorgeous beach!
reviews.text: Visited with all my family (group of 12) last June and this beach was stunning, gorgeous white sand and quite a few bar/restaurant options. Really pretty Portuguese beach.

reviews.title: Stunning beach
reviews.text: This beach is one of the best. It is really long so miles of soft sand to relax on. It wasnt too busy either so there was plenty of space. The beach is particularly safe for swimming as it remains shallow for quite a way and is mainly just sandy. There are also plenty of life guards on the beach. The beach is stunning, surrounded by orange sandstone cliffs and pine trees. There are also some rock pools at the end of the beach and you can walk around to another small cove.

reviews.title: Best beach in Portugal
reviews.text: Love this beach!!a gorgeous streach of beach with cliffs behind and a few nice bars to eat and drink at .If you are staying in olhos de agua the beach can be accessed by steps near the portobay hotel which leads you down to the first bar and restaurant which also has toilets and shower facilities. The whole beach is lovely soft sand great for long walks to get rid of that holiday weight you have put on!!

reviews.title: what a gem
reviews.text: just back from a week at this lovely place set in beautiful grounds with a short walk to an amazing beach.supermarket in east reach bars and clubs also close by.food was first class and the dining area fantastic plenty to choose for all tastes.Loved this place I didn't want to come home so booked another week in August with my two teenage daughters.plenty of sun loungers around the pool or you can either pay I think 15 euros for a couple on the beach.me and the other half had a great week could not fault the rooms aircon and modern Samsung TV not that it was on that much plenty to do I recomend the boat trip to the caves a short ride to the lively resort of Villamora or even a taxi to there or Albufira if you like it a bit more lively.Staff friendly and helpful all round great place cant wait to go back.

reviews.title: Beach walk
reviews.text: Praia Falesia is a lovely beach. It was a bit of a walk down the narrow steps. Snack bar over looking the beach. Very busy with plenty of room for everyone. Few restaurants along the beach. Not much shelter. Can walk to Vilamoura across the beach.

reviews.title: Pretty beach
reviews.text: The beach is very clean and aesthetically pleasing, situated at the bottom of cliffs. However, be prepared to bring your own parasol! The sunbed prices are 9 euros for a half day, and 15 euros for a full one! Haven't encountered that before at any other resort, so that was a surprise. It's most likely because the hotels do not own the beaches.

reviews.title: Stunning beach
reviews.text: Reached down many steps and backed by stunning multicoloured cliffs at low tide this is a great place to go beach walking and at high tide lay and listen to the crashing waves. I'm a wimp so only paddled and there was a small area with life guards should you wish to swim. Great photographic opportunities to be had.

reviews.title: Such a beach !
reviews.text: We had heard about this beach..and yes it was all true!Multi coloured cliffs and dramatic coastline encounterd by 200 steps or less ( depending on access point) or/ and a lift part the way from the impressive Pine Cliffs Resort).If your idea of a beach is commercial and loaded with sunloungers then think again ( certainly in June).Portugal does have its share of more 'organic ' beaches where you make your own sun spot. This is definitely one and it's no surprise that Falesia Beach has been voted one of Europe's best.  A cafe and some sun beds at one point. A small eating area further on. That's it. The rest is just amazing cliffs and sand..oh yeah.. and sun and the Atlantic.  What's not to like?!

reviews.title: Best beach in Portugal
reviews.text: This is indeed the place to visit in the summer . Clean water not too crowded .. simply the best.. super hiper recommended

reviews.title: Mrs
reviews.text: Beautifully clean sandy beach with easy access from our hotel  you can gain access to other coves via cliff paths

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Absolutely beautiful. We used this beach whilst staying at aldeia da falesia and found its surrounding and water perfect. Makes you want to emigrate.

reviews.title: Very steep
reviews.text: By far the best single feature of the Algarve is the beaches and Falesia is a prime example.Even in the height of June there is still so much space it's unbelievable!The beach has lifeguards in attedance in marked areas and you can rent a lounger / umbrella, but walk a few yards to either East or West and the beach becomes more and more deserted.There is plenty of parking but be warned,the access road is very steep and there is an equally steep staircase down the cliff to the beach itself. There's a small bar at the top of the stairs and I noticed that surf lessons are now avaialble.At busy times you will need to park at the top of the hill, the prime space go very early.A few minutes walk from the beach takes you to an area with quite a few restaurants and shops.Worth the effort

reviews.title: Popular but still unspoilt
reviews.text: Albufeira is sadly now overpopulated, not well kept, and run down in every way, as a town and seaside resort. Falésia beach remains unspoilt, well cared for and popular with the local hotel residents and locals alike. I hope when we return it is as lovely and clean and well cared for as it is right now. Hiring a sun lounger for the whole day is 7.50 euros, therefore 15 euros for two.  (It’s 9 euros for two for just half a day)

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Beautiful beach with dramatic red and cream cliffs. Very popular with locals. Lots of small roads lead down to beach as well as wooden steps from hotels.

reviews.title: Family beach
reviews.text: Small beach next to restaurants shops and bars.well used by locals and visitor's.There is another beach nearby called Maria Luisa which is bigger and tends to be less crowded. There is a beach bar and restaurant.Sun lounger and canopy's cost between 15/20 euro's for 2 people.

reviews.title: Holiday
reviews.text: We stayed in Olhos from the 13th to the 20th of June and visited this beautiful beach a few times.. this is a stunning beach and a handy walk from the hotel we stayed in.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Lovely sandy safe beach, very clean with drinks etc. Nice place to spend the day with life guards on duty.

reviews.title: The place to be
reviews.text: A beautiful beach, clean and well maintained, offers courses of surfing and diving, parking and a cafeteria at the hand of all those who want to enjoy refreshments, and typical Portuguese beers

reviews.title: So safe
reviews.text: Very very safe and peace full.life guards amazing even when see is calm.they never off duty well done lads and ladies.so clean such a happy place

reviews.title: Good place to stay
reviews.text: I went here several times because we were sleeping at albarve gardens. It is big, you can walk long ways and it is big, so it is possible to get a quiet place (different to another beaches which are small and noise). There are an entry by alfamar hotel, so I suggest you to leave your car in that hotel and go to the beach through it.

reviews.title: Very nice beach
reviews.text: Apart from sea being freezing cold 😂 the beach was lovely. Long walk down the cliffs on the stairs but worthwhile & not crowded at all.

reviews.title: One of the best beaches
reviews.text: Amazing beach, long, comfortable sand, so much space and very pretty with the red cliffs and rocks along it. A good place to take a swim, sunbathe or walk along, and can eventually take you up to Vilamoura.

reviews.title: Lovely quiet beach
reviews.text: We visited twice with our 16 month old and each time, without walking far, we got lovely quiet spots on sun beds, without being surrounded by lots of people.It’s immaculately clean, well staffed by life guards, and with good facilities. It’s just a shame said child absolutely hated the sand and refused to touch it....!

reviews.title: WOW!
reviews.text: Just read everyone elses' 5 star reviews! Cannot say enough! Walk as far as you can in either direction... dramatic!

reviews.title: Beach holiday visit
reviews.text: This is our 5 visit to this part of the Algarve, beach is fantastic, safe and well looked after. Cliff views are amazing.

reviews.title: Very impressive beach
reviews.text: Miles of sand , amazing sandstone cliffs and loads of sun!  This is a beautiful beach and not to be missed. There are sunbeds available or you can simply lie on the sand. Even on a busy day it isn't crowded because it is so big. There are places to eat and changing rooms as well as toilets. Lifeguards are on duty for those who want to swim safely.

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: One of the best beaches I've ever been lucky enough to walk along. Fine yellow sand, gently rolling in sea and fabulous re cliffs.Perfect holiday fodder.

reviews.title: Lovely beach
reviews.text: Slightly different than most of the beaches in algarve, yet extremely amazing.This year was the first time visiting this beach with my girlfriend and  we both had a lovely day.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: What an absolutely beautiful beach, the cliffs are stunning the water is warm. Lovely and quiet. A must is to visit the beach restaurant O Golphino fantastic food friendly service beautiful outlook and a Tuk tuk back to resort fantastic

reviews.title: Safe Beach
reviews.text: Spent a relaxing day on the sun loungers on this beach. Glorious clear water and lovely clean sand.Well worth a visit.

reviews.title: One of the best beaches in Algarve
reviews.text: We dropped by Falesia one morning and it wa quite stunningly beautiful beach. Long and sandy. Great place for kids as well. Good wave for bodyboarders or surfers. The rock formation looked fantastic. Definitely beach for family with kid if you are in Algarve

reviews.title: beautiful
reviews.text: this beach is beautiful. you may find yourself mesmerized by the landscape and beauty of the area, dont forget the waves, just perfect for some water fun like surfing or boogie boards. great place to get snacks and drinks there as well

reviews.title: It was a FAMILY visit.
reviews.text: Great stroll along the beach.  Pity we climbed some steps with mi  mam's dodgy knees and got hopelessly lost. No bar. Cripes.  Great beach though, with sand and stuff...

reviews.title: Great beach
reviews.text: It's a great beach, beautiful sand and wonderful red cliffs, and sandstone cliffsWaves are useally high 1-2.5m But are nice place to see the sunset or a day at the beach Lifeguards are available most  places

reviews.title: Stunning
reviews.text: Stunning like all beaches in the Algarve.  A must see.  Cold in March so you can't swim but definitely sunbathing weather and the beaches are quieter at this time of year.

reviews.title: Visit during May 2019
reviews.text: Very clean and wonderful to walk along! Stunning white sands with nicely placed cafes along the way!

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: Bit of a track to get to but you will not be disappointed you can walk for miles on probably the cleanest beach in europe

reviews.title: Excellent beach
reviews.text: Wonderful beach and great at sunset. One of the best beaches in europe there is a bit of a trek down and back up but it's worth it.

reviews.title: Long walk
reviews.text: Beautiful long walk along the beach.You can walk miles before you need to get round some rocks to get to the next beach.Stopped about halfway for coffee.Two places to get food and drink.

reviews.title: Is the horizon in the sea showing land (Africa) or just a mirage?
reviews.text: It is a 5km long sandy beach , with a special dark blue sea which is beautiful in the morning light. You can find diverse shells in the low tide and the currents are safe for swimming. The only caution is to stay away from the pine cliffs as they are in threat of erosion.

reviews.title: travelling hopefully
reviews.text: This title isn't meant to suggest that Vilamoura, our destination on a lovely May Sunday, isn't worth arriving at - only that the best part of our experience was the eight-kilometre walk there from Olhos de Agua. It's the Algarve, so the sand is clean and the sea is beautiful.  Whether you start down the steps from the Riu Hotel or across the cliff path from Olhos de Agua beach, you're immediately immersed in lovely scenery, with interesting plants and birds all over the place.There was plenty of time for the four of us to chat to each other, to the Portuguese sea anglers at strategic spots and to other people relaxing and enjoying the air and the views.If you don't feel up for as long a trek as we undertook, there are plenty of access points along the way, but we didn't check out how well connected any of them are to taxis or buses.  However, if you enjoy sunshine and salt water, and get bored just sprawled in one spot, walking the length of Falesia beach is a great alternative!

reviews.title: Amazing beach and lovely view
reviews.text: Very nice beach. The views are amazing, the beach are extremely clean. If your looking for water activities this is not the place, even you can get surfing lessons here. We love this beach and it’s very close to our hotel ( Alpinus ) less than15 min walk

reviews.title: Family holiday
reviews.text: What a fantastic place to stay, stunning scenery and lovely accommodation, staff can’t do enough for you, lovely pool and restaurant, breakfast and evening meals available, excellent selection of food available, entertainment every evening, only a short walk down to the beach, stunning views, short walk to reception which is open 24 hrs, friendly staff, short walk to shops and restaurants,

reviews.title: Miles of uninterrupted sand with stunning red/orange cliffs
reviews.text: Beautiful beach, easy to find a spot especially if you move away from the sun loungers and cafes. There is also a lovely waking along the cliffs through the pine trees. Sat on the beach and watched the sunrise, definitely a bucket list experience.

reviews.title: Lovely beach
reviews.text: Beautiful sandy beach that goes on and on. Lovely sea views and eating areas. Weather lovely 32 degrees in May.

reviews.title: beautiful and clean
reviews.text: nice quiet and clean beach to visit, kids had a great time.only thing is there was no ships near by

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Beautiful views and you can walk for miles. We were recommended this beach by a local and it did not disappoint.

reviews.title: Stunning location!
reviews.text: Make this beach a must-see, absolutely stunning views, gorgeous! Not too over-crowded, beautiful place!

reviews.title: Stunning beach
reviews.text: One of the most beautiful beaches I have visited.  The amazing cliffs make for a fantastic sunset and give off a radiant glow.

reviews.title: Lovely beach
reviews.text: Situated in a small cove this is a gorgeous clean quiet beach area with plenty of sunbeds for hire, toilet facilities and varied bars and eating establishments.

reviews.title: Stunning white sands and clear water
reviews.text: A beautiful stretch of water with clean sand and seas.Approx 8km of beach to walk along with a few level cafes to eat and drink at.Not to be missed.There are approx 100-200 steps down to this stretch depending on where you are staying .

reviews.title: Absolutely stunning
reviews.text: I was stunned when I walked up the hill and discovered this most beautiful beach. It really is breath taking with the lovely coloured mountains and pine trees. One of the prettiest beaches I have ever seen .Lovely clean sand and clear water. Could do with some type of beach hut selling cold drinks and maybe bucket and spades etc. They would make a fortune. There is a snack bar at top of the stairs which is really nice.

reviews.title: Praia Falesia
reviews.text: Great place, very impressive, should not be missed, a long walk along the falesia coast is possible, high waves, few people, you can walk on the beach or on top of the falesia rocks

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: Amazing cliffs, wide sandy beach. Great place for longer stay as weather is really nice. For all watersports there is also good choice because of the waves.

reviews.title: A clean tranquil beach with sunbeds & shades
reviews.text: The sea is cold so wear a wet suit if you want to try surfing. The sea breeze here is refreshing, the sand is clean. Steps down to beach. Well worth a visit.

reviews.title: One of my top favorite beaches!!!
reviews.text: This beach is so much fun and kid friendly!!! The waves aren't too large and the beach doesn't get too crowded. It was a clean beach and we stayed in an Airbnb right up the road from the beach and we went to the beach every day and spent the whole day there. My family went to this beach when my siblings and I were younger and they were able to relax without being too worried about us; we (my siblings and I) could run around and pretend to be the Croods (because of the red rocks). I highly recommend going to this beach if you are in the Algarve region of Portugal. It is one of our favorite beaches and if we could, we would go back in a heartbeat!

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: Long white sands and plenty of space to relax with family. This beach is my favourite here and we simply love it!

reviews.title: Stunning beach
reviews.text: One of my favourite beaches on the Algarve.  It is a long stretch of golden sand with lots of shells along the shore. You can easily find a quiet spot to sunbath or just walk along and take in the views. It is simply stunning with the red cliffs in the background.

reviews.title: Carlsburg don't do beaches ...but if they did !! 😎
reviews.text: This beach is awesome.....clean fresh ....smells of sea fish and salt as it should ....perfect for families,walkers,paddlers never have a problem finding a pitch on this nutter ...it's like the mother in law it goes on and on and on .....Get on it and soak it up !!

reviews.title: Breathtaking
reviews.text: This beach is really beautiful, not too crowded and with lots of space for every need whether it is sitting in the hustle and bustle or relaxing somewhere more quiet. Definitaly recommend this beach for adults and children.

reviews.title: Fantastic beach, you can walk for ages!
reviews.text: This is a beautiful wide and very long beach. It is absolutely stunning and like all beaches we visited in Algarve, very clean.   You can walk for ages. It was quite windy when we visited, so I would recommend taking some sort of wind blocking device if you plan to lay on the beach and relax.

reviews.title: The best beach on Algarve
reviews.text: This beach is spectacular! You can walk all the way from Olhos D'Agua to Vilamoura along the sand. The area around Falesia is beautiful with its high cliffs and stairways down to the beach (not good for people with walking problems). There is a café and toilet facilities at the top of the stairway at Falesia. The steps are steep with 'rest points' at intervals on the way down. There are a few bars along the walk to Vilamoura. The beach is safe for swimming, shoals out gradually and has little surf (in the main). It is possible to drive parallel with the beach to the car park at the Vilamoura end where it is easier to access the beach on a flat approach.

reviews.title: Has to be seen
reviews.text: Has to be seen..  why? Just because it is one of the Spots of Algarve. This place is magic and so beautiful you can't miss it...

reviews.title: Stunning
reviews.text: Stretches for miles, beautiful sand, beautiful cliffs. Even when busy you can find space away from others. If you want watersports head towards Vilamoura. They have the traditional stuff.

reviews.title: The Four Mile Beach
reviews.text: Miles of sandy beaches and interesting cave formations, very clean and safe to swim. Cafe bars are always close by and ample places to park, these may get busy in the height of the season

reviews.title: Must see!
reviews.text: Spectacular beach with beautiful views. The shape of the "falesia" is unique and superb. Someting we had never seen before.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Walked this beautiful beach to Vilamoura with my husband.It is so clean and you can walk for miles .

reviews.title: Amazing colours and lovely beach
reviews.text: Long stretch of beach with lots of places to rest.  There's also option to rent beach bench if you want to be more comfy.  There are sellers walkin around selling drinks and snacks.  There are also restaurants on the beach.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: This beach is beautiful, rugged orange coloured cliffs and a very long sandy beach.There are some areas with sun beds and umbrellas. And a few restaurants dotted along the way!Steep steps to get access so if you have mobility issues it’s probably not the one for you.

reviews.title: mini Marsden rock
reviews.text: found the beach by chance and returned a few times, shops bars and the odd lucky lucky man selling his goods

reviews.title: Gorgeous beach
reviews.text: We loved this beach-so pretty and a couple of great places to eat/drink. The pine trees and cliffs surrounding this beach are just beautiful!

reviews.title: Falesia Beach
reviews.text: A beautiful beach, very clean, lots of sunbeds to hire if required and a couple of sea view restaurants/bars to eat and drink.  Toilets there as well.

reviews.title: Day out to Falesia Beach.
reviews.text: Sightseeing bus drop off is around 20/25min walk to beach. Amazing views. 4km stretch of beach. Lovely location

reviews.title: Bezch
reviews.text: Nice beach with golden sand but think it's fake. Watch the shelf and currents with kids. Probably not that safe on anything but calm day.

reviews.title: Perfect beach
reviews.text: Lovely and huge beach which is all sand.. There is plenty of space to have a secluded spot. Great snack bar at the start near the stairs down to the beach

reviews.title: Evening walk
reviews.text: The day we arrived, after lunch and check in plus not knowing the place; we have decided walking Falesia Beach and it was wonderful 2 hours walk before dinner and only little bad weather put off but it would be lovely walking even everyday.

reviews.title: The steep walk back
reviews.text: Staying at Falesia Portobay hotel and decided to walk down the lovely wooden steps to the beach. What a treat when we got there. Miles of uninterrupted views. Cliff faces of amazing colours. Lovely sand and clear waters. Well worth the visit but the steps back up were trying.

reviews.title: Amazing Views and Beach
reviews.text: This is by far one of the most beautiful, picturesque beaches I have ever seen!  The dark terracotta cliffs were an amazing backdrop to the beach and very clean!

reviews.title: Amazing cliffs
reviews.text: Nice view.. the rocks are amazing. The beloved beach is characterized by its incredible red cliffs. In fact, the translation of the beach is Beach of Cliffs.

reviews.title: Lovely beach
reviews.text: Nice beach with plenty of sand and sea on it. Plenty of bars to use and even saw a bar with a sign outside saying free creche for men leave home free with beer money

reviews.title: Beautifull duned beach
reviews.text: Being at the Pine Cliffs Resort hotel, this was a breathtaking walk to the beach.300 steps or less if you take the lift, but what a surprise to enjoy the beautiful colours of this cliffs.Nice long beach good for long walks and enjoyment

reviews.title: Stunning beach
reviews.text: That I walked from albufeira to the end of falesia beach (mission), absolutely stunning, beautiful beach.Only problem I had was finding it ochos de agua. But found the steps eventually

reviews.title: One of the best beaches
reviews.text: There is always something to see and do along this clean and interesting stretch of coast. Numerous sea birds and some birds of prey. Not too busy, before the sun beds get put out for Easter.Ideal for walkers of all ages, up & down or through to Vilamoura.

reviews.title: Fantastic beach and beautiful cliffs!
reviews.text: We spent almost everyday on the beach while staying at the pine cliffs resort!  The beach was one of the cleanest I have ever been too and given the time of year, was not too busy!  We went in up to knee hight, but will def returned again to enjoy a full swim when it is warmer!  The walk up the main stretch of beach was fantastic and got to watch some surfing!  Also took some great pictures of the beautiful colour cliffs!

reviews.title: Amazing Sunset , great beach
reviews.text: We drove from Albufeira. Car rental is quite cheap off season. The sunset from this location is stunning. It’s private and not a lot of people are there near sunset time. It’s a good vibe , plus there’s plenty sun beds just to chill. Amazing views , clean beach. We stayed in Albufeira for 4 nights and pretty much went here daily for sunset .

reviews.title: Great beach
reviews.text: I love this beach! The water is very clean.. enjoyed every minute when we where there... most beautiful beach I ever seen...

reviews.title: long walk
reviews.text: Too far away from the hotel and a long walk - badly sign posted.   The ere is a good restuanrt at the beach and the beah itslef mis wide clean and sandy

reviews.title: Walk the beach/walk the cliff top
reviews.text: From hotel to first bar is a 45minute walk. Perfect at the end of the day with a glorious sunset as a reward

reviews.title: Fabulous beach goes on for miles !!!!
reviews.text: This beach is out of this world , goes on for miles . Fabulous soft sand . And nobody on it lol . Can’t belive it xxxx

reviews.title: Visiting the beach
reviews.text: The beach was lovely and enjoyed walking on beach wrote our names on the rock it was really nice and chilled.

reviews.title: Hiking and clean beach
reviews.text: Good beach for walking and running in the morning. There's a long hiking trail but the only downside is that it's very long to reach the main cities. So that means not much shops around until you've reached the bigger cities.

reviews.title: Beautiful cliff colours
reviews.text: Huge long beach with steep cliffs . Bright sunshine on exposed rocks and soil showed brilliant oranges, reds yellow and brown cliff faces . Lovely flat sand. Water on March too cool without a wet suit. Access limited by long steep stairs.

reviews.title: Large.
reviews.text: Great beach this, very large open and really nice fine sand.Great for swimming here as there's so much room.

reviews.title: Great beach
reviews.text: Only problem with this beautiful beach from the Olhos D’Agua location is the number of steps up and down to it.  It’s a great sense of achievement to do it but be prepared .

reviews.title: Beautiful beach.
reviews.text: Can walk for miles on this beach.Falesia Hotel provides bus to it.Busy at weekends, but acres of space, though limited parking. V goodrestaurant nearby called Sabores ?Next to Chinese restaurant in small,new complex. High amenity area, 2 or 3 five star hotels. Highly recommended.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Beautiful sandy beach.with the coastline worn by the waves into interesting shapes it is picturesque .

reviews.title: Amazing Beach
reviews.text: Long stretch of sand, allows visitors to walk East to Vilamoura or West to Olhus D'Agua. Never too busy, always space.

reviews.title: Nice long stretch of sand with red cliffs
reviews.text: We went in early freezing March so the beach was packed by burnt red British and no one else. You can walk for miles!

reviews.title: Stunning beach
reviews.text: Just got back from our holiday, went down to the beach most days, beautiful and clean, lots of steps but well worth the climb.

reviews.title: Beautiful beaches
reviews.text: All beaches along the coastline are clean and accessible. You can walk or get one of the local buses. Many of them even have sun loungers. The sea is beautiful and clear making a lovely day out.

reviews.title: Stunning cliffs
reviews.text: We walked along Falesia Beach in the Algarve yesterday. It was 23° and a beautiful sunny day, the tide was out so we could walk on flat sand by the water. We walked to Vilamoura and it was the most peaceful, almost spiritual walk. The scenery is breath taking and we were in awe of how amazing this natural cliff and beach was.If you are planning a trip tp Albufeira, Falesia Beach should be a must to vist.

reviews.title: Great views
reviews.text: Lovely beach, fantastic view, very clean. Only negative is the amount of steps down to the beach, not very easy to access if less mobile or carrying a lot of beach stuff

reviews.title: Just magnificent
reviews.text: That's it, just magnificent. Nothing needs adding but unless I use 100 characters I can't tell you that.

reviews.title: Falesia Beach
reviews.text: Great beach to visit and walk great views beautiful sun set and sun rise. this beach goes all the way to Vilamoura

reviews.title: Beautiful clean beach
reviews.text: We stayed at the fab hotel PortoBay Falesia and reached this beach via the 100+ wooden steps, well worth the climb.  This beach stretches for miles and is very clean and uncrowded (March) the beautiful coloured cliffs surrounding the beach are stunning.you can walk all the way from Olhos de Água to Vilamoura along this fab beach.

reviews.title: The beach of the Algarve
reviews.text: Have known this beach for over 30 years when there were little tourists and when there were no constructions no sunbeds - so pure and beautifull - today it is commercialized ... nevertheless it is still the most beautifull pleasant of the south - with guards, clean, ideal for all

reviews.title: Find the lookout on a map.!
reviews.text: We are not big beach people, so we discovered a lot of hiking trails at the cliffsides in the Algarve. On a map find the (lookout) Miradouro do Falecia up near the Tui Blue Falésia Hotel for the most spectacular view of these multi coloured cliffs.(There is also another, more accessible, but further away lookout called Miradouro do Parque a little further west)To go down to the beach there is road access with parking at the bottom, is the road is not too washed out, or simply walk down the road.Visit later in the day for best sunlit cliffsWell worth a visit, even with so many other fantastic view points all along the Algarve.

reviews.title: Falesia beach
reviews.text: We went on a tuk tuk tour and they took us all around to different coastlines and the beaches this was a very nice beach but with going in February not that busy but can imagine in the summer time would be really busy there is also a cafe and a bar at this beach if you want a quieter beach and away from Albufeira main beach would recommend

reviews.title: Amazing place
reviews.text: The amazing rock formations on Falesia beach are simply mind boggling. The beach itself is something to behold with a huge expanse of clean sand .

reviews.title: Goes on forever
reviews.text: Went down onto the beach in olhos de agua in low tide and decided to walk down the beach to Vilamoura, it is a wonderful walk if not a tiring one ,not sure of the exact distance but must be 5 mile which took us about 2.5 hours but well worth the exercise and the view of the cliff formations are stunning.

reviews.title: Most stunning beach in Algarve!!
reviews.text: Algarve is full of beautiful beaches but for me and my husband this beach was just amazing - surrounded by cliffs and big rocks clean water - golden sandy beach is just what it was - we parked at the top of the cliff and took the steps down - been disabled i really enjoyed the way they have steps leading to the beach rather then the usual steep climb down or up - we went in december and the weather was around 21degrees.if you are ever in Algarve this beach is a must see!!!

reviews.title: One of the best beaches on Algarve
reviews.text: Fantastic surroundings of red and large beach to take a swim on Algarve. Plenty of good restaurants near too.

reviews.title: Stunning beach.
reviews.text: Quiet secluded beach but stunning views and miles of sand to spend all day enjoying yourselves and not commercialised. Small cafe and toilets at the entrance then miles of perfect beach. Well recommended.

reviews.title: Great beach and trails to explore.
reviews.text: Had a long walk along the beach and explored the other great trails to enjoy the views and great feeling.

reviews.title: Beautiful!!
reviews.text: The beach is lovely. It’s definitely worth the trip! There’s a long stretch which takes you into Vilamoura.

reviews.title: Miss Weston
reviews.text: Falesia beach is the most beautiful beach we have ever seen the walk to Vilamoura is a must visit you’ll wish you’d been years ago......

reviews.title: amazing
reviews.text: got to be one of the best beaches in the Algarve , safe for kids and it stretches to villamoura if you fancy a long walk

reviews.title: Very pleasant beach 🏖
reviews.text: Just a short walk away from the marina in vilamoura and you find this long sandy beach 🏖 perfect for an out of season stroll. No danger of going hungry with a number of restaurants and beach clubs to choose from.

reviews.title: Wonderful
reviews.text: Wonderful beach very pretty, great for relaxing and enjoying your holiday. I would recommend this beach.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Spent a fair few hours on the beach in December Quality time.Sun was shining temperature around 21 degrees

reviews.title: Spectacular beach
reviews.text: This beach begins in Olhos de Água, Albufeira, and extends, for almost eight kilometers, to the beginning of the Vilamoura marina, where the mountains end up disappearing.Golden beach, surrounded by red and white cliffs, with hammocks, water sports, restaurant and bar.There are hotels near different categoryOn top of these cliffs are some of the most beautiful and luxurious hotels and resorts in the Algarve, such as Porto Bay Falesia, the Pine Cliffs resort of the Luxury Collection, with its golf course on the sea, the new five-star hotel Epic Sana and the hotel Falesia.

reviews.title: love this beach
reviews.text: we always walk along this beach and return over the cliff walk.   It is always clean and the red cliffs are amazing !

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Absolutely beautiful long stretch of glorious beach.Only one bar/restaurant/toilet open in 3miles though on 5th jan lolSo get your walking shoes on. We're used to it, but some aren't !

reviews.title: Very nice beach
reviews.text: Eight km from Albufeira. Very nice beach with a lot of colours. But no toilet and no restaurants. The beach is on Tripadvisers top 20 in the world, well, it is not I can tell yoy.But very nice!

reviews.title: Stunning
reviews.text: Just a stunning beach Portugal at its best. It's a must to go too. It's unspoilt and a hidden gem lots if steps down but we'll worth it. A stunning place on a sunny afternoon in December.

reviews.title: Ideal location to watch the sunset
reviews.text: This is a beautiful location, a great place to watch the sunset.There is a small carpark at the cliff top and an even smaller on further down. Both good for different reasons.Go and see, check it out. Whether you just want a beach or the landscape

reviews.title: Amazing beach
reviews.text: For me this beach is the best one in Algarve. Is really nice to go to see sunset and relaxing your holidays.

reviews.title: Miles and miles of sand !!
reviews.text: Apparently it is possible to walk from the Olhos de Agua end all the way to Vilamoura . It would be a long trek indeed but as the terrain is flat , a comfortable way to burn some calories. Take water with you as the 2 bars at the Olhos de Agua end are pricy !

reviews.title: Beach to ourselves
reviews.text: We walked along the beach every day we were in the area. Each time it was clean and uncrowded. There were plenty of litter bins on the beach so no excuses!

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Wonderful beach with accessible cliff walks behind. Peaceful. Soft sand which goes on for about five uninterupted miles.

reviews.title: Not the best beach in the Algarve
reviews.text: Summer time it is like most other beaches in the Algarve jam packed with people has amazing views of the ocean and the warm waters of the Summer Atlantic with water temps reaching up to 24c, not bad for the Atlantic!

reviews.title: Lovely
reviews.text: It was worth the 40mins walk from our hotel the beach is quite small but the views and the cliffs are lovely this little place has shops /restaurants and bars is easy getting down to it but a steep walk back up to the main road.

reviews.title: One of the world's best beaches
reviews.text: Falesia Beach (Cliff Beach in English) is so named due to the wonderful cliffs behind it, which grow as you go westward from Vilamoura. It's beauty is the combination of sunshine, the blue sea, golden sand, the red cliffs and the green cactus on the cliffs. Parking is easy, either in a large parking area, whose fees depend upon the time of year, or fairly close by for free. You enter by way of a bridge over the Quarteira River, and pass an excellent beach cafe. There are sun loungers for rent, or just do your own thing. Behind the beach are a number of good cafes serving everything you want. There is also a life-saving service if you stay in the main area. Do not camp below the cliffs, which cab be dangerous!

reviews.title: Amazing beach & view
reviews.text: Wonderful views beaches & sea.Lovely golden sands & warm sea that you can swim in.There are a few restaurants where you can grab a bite to eat & drink.The cliffs are amazing & you can walk up them.

reviews.title: A gorgeous big beach
reviews.text: We walked up there a few days and did a walk on the beach.  A huge beach with loads of room for everyone on it.  This beach is definitely worth going to.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Good clean beach and area to work around.Nice to chill out and relax by the sea front and have a drink or snack and a walk around.

reviews.title: Amazing beach location and views
reviews.text: This beach really is amazing and the views from and of the cliffs is breathtaking. There are quite a lot of steps to the beach but it's worth the effort and I didn't particularly struggle with a four-year-old, we just took our time!

reviews.title: Olhos de agua
reviews.text: Lovely little fishing village with a good amount of places to eat breakfast, lunch and dinner no need to venture out to other areas as it's all on you're door step. Friendly quaint with a romantic feel. We spent a week there two couples. We stayed in a apartment which overlooked the sea. Beautiful weather our favourite restaurant was Tarmarillo Restaurant which we visited regularly over our stay we were looked after very well by the brother's who worked there. We had fish,lamb,chicken and prawn dishes all delicious with good portions and very tasty. Price wise we found good for a party of 4.On average  €90 for the four of us including alcohol Brandy, beer,red wine. On one visit two of us decided to have a pudding and tried the Almond Cake which was delicious so good we put in an order for a whole one to take away. They were so accommodating it was no problem. Worth a visit or two.We also had the opportunity to book a coach trip to Eastern Algarve and Spain this was organised through the travel shop 5 mins from our apartment this was a fabulous trip which we throughly enjoyed including 5 stops for shopping and lunch in Spain. Beautiful churches we visited stopping at Marinas. Our driver was extremely friendly he called himself Johnny be good and had us all laughing throughout the trip. We met for 9.00 and returned by 7.15pm.Worth every penny would love to do it again. We also visited Old Town and the shopping mall paying a visit to good old C&A in Albufeira. Taxi to mall roughly  €17 for four of us. Old town good for strolling around and souvenir shopping drinks cigarettes nick backs. All in all a wonderful trip great beach, watching the sunset each evening . Would definitely recommend this place. Hope to return soon.

reviews.title: Beach visit
reviews.text: The beach was very clean with lovely golden sand. Views are amazing. Facilities were nice and handy and well looked after.

reviews.title: Awesome
reviews.text: Fantastic beach and water. Missed restrooms and food/beverage service on the beach though. Excellent in fall when there is no people yet lovely in the water. Want to go back!

reviews.title: Fantastic Beach
reviews.text: Very clean & well kept beach as you’d expect in this area of the Algarve. Great views from the cliffs tops.

reviews.title: Test of walking skills
reviews.text: Best beach in Portugal ? I think so......well serviced with lounges , tide never goes too far out....lifeguards....okay a lot of soft sand so a struggle....but move towards the cliffs and where from PINE CLIFFS hotels all the way to villamoura you can cheat by walking the cliffs....when towards Villamoura eating at number 3 is best beach bar

reviews.title: Excellent beach
reviews.text: Very nice family beach but does get very busy in July and August. Would recommend though. Well worth a visit

reviews.title: Beautiful beach and worth the visit
reviews.text: Very long, clean beach, with beautiful breathtaking views and cliffs.  We took the bus from Albufeira and there is a bus stop not far from the beach.  Worth the visit.

reviews.title: Best beach in Algarve
reviews.text: We visited this beach in October. Great location, free parking, Sandy and ideal for young family beach was not crowded as well.

reviews.title: Walk on the bezch
reviews.text: The best beach to walk Lots of beach bars to enjoy and if fit try walking to Vilamoura fromPine. cliffs

reviews.title: Stunning
reviews.text: Lovely clear sea, beautiful views to the surrounding cliffs. Plenty of comfortable sun loungers but a little expensive.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: We spent a few hours here and it’s the most beautiful beach. Definitely worth a visit. Surround by cliffs with soft sand

reviews.title: Nice pleasant  walk from Hotel
reviews.text: The Beach is a the bottom of the road through O,lhos de Aqua there are bars shops and toilets the beach is pleasant but you have to be aware of the Tides there are some fresh water springs on the beach which is what the town is all about

reviews.title: beautiful
reviews.text: was very impressed with this beach was very clean and very popular beautiful scenery and a lovely walk

reviews.title: Super beach
reviews.text: This beach is stunning.  You can walk for miles.  There are wooden steps down to the beach.  There is a cafe at the top before the stairs but this is not commercialised so take water and snacks with you.

reviews.title: 5km long
reviews.text: We walked from Olhos De Aqua to Vilamoura, all 5km lol. Lovely sandy beach with a few cafe's/ bars along the way, not very busy when we were there so if you like a bit of peace & quiet its perfect.

reviews.title: Golden sand, dramatic cliffs, beautiful
reviews.text: This is another stunning beach on the  southern coast of Portugal and a bit of a walk from our hotel, RIU Club Hotel Guarana. Getting to this beach included  the descent of 120 plus steps, going down counted 125 on the way back up 126 (rough idea).We visited this beautiful place a number of times during our 2 week holiday.Just at the bottom of the steps is Praia do Barranco das Belhalruchus which eventually leads  to this amazing beach with its dramatic multicoloured sandstone cliffs.From Praia das Belhalruchus there is a temporary boardwalk along the back of the beach, it runs out by the Sheraton Hotel sun beds (blue towels). That is where Praia Falesia beginsThere are no sunbeds or umbrellas here, in fact there are no facilities on this beach, there are 2 restaurants on Praia das Belhalruchus, Mare and O Golphino.Ideal spot to spread out the beach mats and towels, relax enjoy the glorious sunshine and the stunning scenery.Would recommend visiting this beach, it is much less crowded than the beach next door. Would also recommend to bring some water, or something to drink.From Praia das Belhalruchus through Praia Falesia, is a very popular walk, which eventually leads to Vilamoura, it is a lengthy walk.It is important to maintain this beautiful area that visitors take all their rubbish home with them or make use of the bins provided.Every now and again beach sellers turn up, selling table cloths etc, or drinks, they are no hassle, just say no thanks and they go away.

reviews.title: Great time
reviews.text: Lovely area to relax and chill out in the sun. Unlike a lot of beach's you are left alone. Near to shops and restaurants, without hearing them

reviews.title: Lovely walk from Vilamoura to Olhos do Agua
reviews.text: This is a beautiful sandy beach shielded from inland by the cliffs. At Vilamoura end there are several beach restaurants and facilities on the first half mile from the marina. If you are feeling fit then it is about an hour and a half walk to the pretty resort of Olhos De Agua which is accessed either by a steep set of wooden steps or an adventurous climb over the "dunes" onto the very small beach.

reviews.title: Great beach for lovely walks
reviews.text: We went for a walk along the beech every day for an hour or so. Clean and lovely views of Falesia beach.

reviews.title: Beach day
reviews.text: Had a great day at this beach but was really windy and there was big waves, although my daughter had a great time they were quite strong. Steps down to beach so bear on mind if you have elderly or buggies/wheelchairs etc. Beach bar at top good with reasonable priced coffee, sandwiches etc.

reviews.title: falesia beach
reviews.text: A really stunning beach lots of vistors but superb sand and great views , water is cold with biggish waves , few places around europe are better than here .A place to spend the day for sunworshipers

reviews.title: Stunning beach
reviews.text: We just returned from a fantastic week at hotel Tui Blue Falesia above the beach . We walked to Villamoura 7km it was absolutely amazing and the sea was warm . It really is a wonderful beach

reviews.title: Great big sandy beach
reviews.text: We walked along this lovely sandy beach many times during our  weeks stay near Albufeira.Lovely coloured cliffs and a few cafes to choose from.Great walk and also sun beds and sea bathing available.

reviews.title: amazing beach
reviews.text: amazing view and water. Even in Oktober the water was still amazing. I can Imagine in july and august would be overcrowded. In October was amazing. Remembered on Canoa Quebrada / Brasil

reviews.title: Cracking and clean beach
reviews.text: As per title. Clean beach with stunning coloured cliffs as backdrop. Selection of beach bars to choose from.

reviews.title: Outstanding
reviews.text: There is no comparison between this beach and the one at Olhos d'Agua.  The latter is a small bay but this one runs for over 6 km, almost to Vilamoura.  The only problem is that there are 125 steps down to the beach and the same number when you want to return.When we were there the sea was rather rough and people were trying to surf the waves. Behind the beach are some very colourful cliffs and there were hang gliders flying from them further down the beach.There are two beach cafes but because of where they are they are expensive €4 for a can of coke and €10 for a bottle of beer.  Well worth a visit if you are in the area.

reviews.title: Long beach with impressive cliff
reviews.text: Wow! This was my first word when I saw it from the top of the stairs. The place is stunning, kilometers of sandy beaches next to this 50 meters wall of coloured sandstone.

reviews.title: Great beach
reviews.text: Lovely long sandy beach and great for a day out. The beach is a bit of a mission to get to if you’ve a pushchair we had to carry it down and up the steps. There’s a cafe/bar at the top which is very good. One tip is don’t use the sun beds on the right as there very expensive and the sun bed man stinks like a polecat on heat and can be rude when you question his prices ( €5 extra than other beaches we’ve visited locally) but having the little one with us we needed shade but we had a lovely peaceful day doing all the normal beach stuff, swimming, reading etc

reviews.title: Wide and long....
reviews.text: Praia Falesia is one of longest Algarve sandy beaches. It could be reached by car, but mostly through the few hotels in the first row to the ocean, like Pine Cliffs (Sheraton), Portobay Felasia...There are sunbeds and sunshades available for a 15 Eur/day. There are also a few bars where you could have a drink or a light meal.A good choice to enjoy the ocean.

reviews.title: Spectacular Red Cliff Beach
reviews.text: Red beautiful beach red cliffs blue ocean umbrella pine trees!!! Horse back riding massages great packed sand for running!

reviews.title: Can't be beaten
reviews.text: Beautiful long stretch of beach - a bit steep getting down - but worth the visit - stunning cliffs and views

reviews.title: clean pleasant beach
reviews.text: nice sandy beach. Sunbeads available. Lifeguard presence. Bit of  a climb up and down if you have buggy/disabled person not great accessiblity. Bar nearby at top of steps.

reviews.title: Lovely beach
reviews.text: Beautiful beach and lovely restaurants to eat at.people really nice and the views are amazing would definitely go back.

reviews.title: amazing beach with orange coloured cliffs
reviews.text: If you like walking a beach this is the one for you.  7km of golden sand, with relentless waves and a beautiful back drop of orange cliffs.

reviews.title: Wonderful !
reviews.text: We visited everyday! Beautiful, not crowded, and lovely to swim in. Well worth a visit. The sea can be quite strong and I can see why lifeguards are there. Loved just lying on a beach towel all day relaxing. A bar/snacks is available just before walking down the steps to the beach. Has clean toilets also.

reviews.title: Amazing Beach !!!!
reviews.text: This beach has to be one of the most amazing beaches in the Algarve , You can walk along to Olhos D Agua along the beach at low tide . 2 beach restaurants , and you can find a quiet spot , Love it

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: Very clean beach, with lifeguard. Sun loungers were €5 each, also a snack bar for drinks etc. Absolutely worth a visit.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Beautiful beach with amazing colours. The only down side is the sand. Sand is a bit rough and if you're not careful you can hurt your feet.

reviews.title: Only had a look .
reviews.text: We are not beach lovers do we just had a quick look...it's absolutely stunning.. gets a few photos..

reviews.title: It is rated : one of the most beautiful beaches in the world
reviews.text: And this title is well deserved:You have to see it at least 3 times: sunrise; sunset; during the day.If you are lucky (like us) and you see it in winter, you are alone in the beach, big storm, high waves, water of silver colour, you know how perfection looks like.Of course winter means temperatures around 15 to 18 degrees; so you don’t freeze. But resist the temptation to go swimming: there is always a wave that surprises you and you get wet feet while shooting photos and videosBut in the sea, you are « gone with the wind »

reviews.title: Worth all the steps!
reviews.text: We were staying at nearby hotel. The steps down are in good condition and easy to negotiate. The beach is amazing! Truly an unforgettable experience. The cliffs are so picturesque and the sea is litter free and clean. We enjoyed several walks along here and would thoroughly recommend.However climbing the steps back up was taxing but with rest along the way we survived!

reviews.title: Fantastic beach
reviews.text: The longest and cleanest beach at 7Km that I have been on. We walked from Olhos de Agua to Vilamoura. The beech has a nice gentle slope but try to walk at low tide. Lots of people use the beech and stops along the way.

reviews.title: Fabulous 5 mile beach
reviews.text: Beautiful 5 mile long beach, the best on the Algarve. Ask locally for the directions from the town (approx. 15 minute walk).

reviews.title: Nice clean beach
reviews.text: Lovely clean beach with fresh wind blowing in from the Atlantic,water is cold but beautifully clear,I'm sure if give it a visit you'll enjoy it

reviews.title: Lovely Walk
reviews.text: Walked this beach from Ohos d’Agua to Vilamoura which took around 2 hours. Lovely and clean with plenty of stops available en route.

reviews.title: Lovely beach
reviews.text: This beach is beautiful and goes on for miles. Very clean and plenty of space for all. The sea was clear but very wavy which we liked.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach!
reviews.text: This is a beautiful beach at the base of the stairs from the 3HB resort. The beach is clean, there are loungers to rent but also plenty of sand to pitch your own umbrella. There are washrooms at the restaurants. The water is clean and was warm and wavy in September. It was also a quieter and less crowded beach than others we went to.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach with lovely rocks
reviews.text: Was staying at the Falesia Hotel and went out a couple of times at 07:30,  Turn right out of the doors, down the steps and right at the bottom.  Then hug the road around to the right, turning right at every junction (signposted to the beach).  Steep slope and steps down to the beach and then turn right and beautiful walk with hardly anyone on the beach at that time in the morning and the sun just coming up.  So peaceful and quiet.  Walk all the way along until you get to the café.  Walk up the wooden man-made path (with steps) and take the lift up to Pine Cliffs resort.  Bear slightly left at the top, across the grass and go in through the doors at the back of the Sheraton Hotel.  Walk through and come out the front, follow the road around to the exit and then bear right and it takes you back to the Falesia Hotel.  With a reasonably brisk pace it takes an hour.  There are steps so bear this in mind.

reviews.title: The beach with rocky orange cliffs!
reviews.text: We enjoyed a day at the beach. The access to the beach was good (through the resort). Not my favourite type of sand, a bit chunky for me, I prefer thin sand. The surroundings are very nice with the orange rocky cliffs. Not my favourite beach in Portugal but it is ok.

reviews.title: Lovely beach
reviews.text: Long, beautiful beach. Clean and flat. Beach bar available and water sports. Great for swimming, clear water.

reviews.title: water full of weeds,
reviews.text: no restaurants or cafe around, very disappointed. It is supposed to be one of the best beaches in Europe. Hello

reviews.title: Just perfect !!!
reviews.text: Absolutely beautiful beach with great facilities. The Golfinho Restaurant  is conveniently located offering a great range of drinks and food and shower/wc. A friendly welcome every day !! Would definitely recommend.

reviews.title: Nice
reviews.text: Lovely little beach, if a little on the small side, pity there is no walk way to the other beach. Some nice places to eat..

reviews.title: Nice beach
reviews.text: Very clean beach. Restaurants are 5 minutes walking distance to enjoy the whole day there. Parking is sometimes a bit difficult

reviews.title: Amazing beach
reviews.text: This beach was beautiful. Alot of sun beds and shades if you wanted but we walked a little way from them and had a lovely quiet spot under the cliffs.

reviews.title: Really good!
reviews.text: Nice beach not so many people in September. Good view with the rocks. There are options for nice lunch.

reviews.title: Lovely beach and views but not if you have mobility issues
reviews.text: A number of hotels offer courtesy buses to the beach we chose to walk, not that far from most of the hotels. When you arrive the views are beautiful but you are faced with hundreds of steps down and then later back up. Steps in excellent condition with handrail but if you have any mobility concerns you would be best to travel to another beach. Lots of beds available, or just sit on the sand from which you can walk gently into the sea to cool off.

reviews.title: Lovely but very busy!
reviews.text: The beach looks really lovely as you approach it from above. There are roughly seventy steps to climb down before reaching it though - you have to climb back up at the end of the day remember! Once on the beach you can hire sun beds and umbrellas or shades or you can take your own. If you take your own then there are certain areas where you are not allowed to put your umbrella i.e. in front of the hired equipment which is a good idea. Unfortunately for us the beach was a little too crowded which is only to be expected in school holidays and the height of the season. I would like to visit the beach again though but maybe late June or early September before the crowds arrive.

reviews.title: Fantastic
reviews.text: We went in August 2018, beautiful hotel, the Tui reps were lovely and every member of staff were friendly and helpful. Everyone works really hard to make your stay superb. Food is plentiful and the quality is great. Overall 10/10 thank you for the best holiday we will be visiting again.

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach, Great Views!
reviews.text: What a lovely beach! To access the beach you walk down hundreds of wooden steps, this is an adventure in itself! Te beach is amazing to walk on. Very scenic and picturesque!

reviews.title: day by the beach
reviews.text: love this popular beach, hired a beach lounger for 6 euroes each for the day..we were with elderly parents so only choice..very clean beach and toilets and cafe at top of several steps..not suitable for wheel chairs difficulty with walking down or up stairs..lovely day..

reviews.title: Worth the hike down the steps!
reviews.text: This beach is truly breathtaking.  It’s about 7km of glorious sandy beach with beds for hire along the way.  The cliffs are red and white rock a bit similar to the isle of white with better weather & really warm sea.   The cliffs are known for providing great wind cover.  We came here 3 times.  Our first visit was nearest to Olhos de Água  but be mindful there are a lot of steps to get to the beach. We strolled along about 3/4 miles to The main falasia beach and got an Uber back only €5.50 as we didn’t really know where we were we & walked through a big hotel complex & got in the cab near the bleu hotel.  On our next visits we had a hire car & drove to the main area of Falasia beach - there are still a number of steps but not so arduous.  The weather is fantastic about 27oC ideal for walking & lazing.  There are plenty of water sports along the beach if you are interested & surf learning & hire shops.  The beach vendors are Portuguese selling local stuff mainly ground towels and dresses - be sure to haggle their prices down. They are friendly and will instantly go away if you say you are not interested no hassle for sure! This is a true treasure totally unspoilt a must see put it on your must do list if you are in the region I can not recommend it enough - truly beautiful!

reviews.title: Worth the walk..
reviews.text: Many ways to get it on foot.. Great view from the cliff top.. We used the route through the Rui Hotel complex.. Good steps down.. Wide sandy beach.. Bars every so often if you fancy a walk to Vilamoura.. We did.. And got a cab bag..

reviews.title: Perfect beach
reviews.text: Rolling cliffs, temped waters and lots of space. Perfect beach to spend the day with family, partner or friends

reviews.title: Away from the pool
reviews.text: This beach has access from our hotel the Portobay via wooden stairs so it is worth a visit. This year the beach was very busy unlike last year so it has become very popular.There are sunbed available to hire but these need attention as they have seen better days. Chairs are very close together so not much room to turn chairs when the sun moves around.There is a lovely beach restaurant serving fresh fish which is not to be missed.Both worth a visit, but remember the stairs back to the hotel after a relaxing day in the sun.

reviews.title: You got to go there !!!!!
reviews.text: Incredible beach, very high cliffs.Water was a little cold but very refreshing. The city should consider providing bathroom facilities.  This is a must see if you are in the Faro / Albufeira area.

reviews.title: Best Beach Ever!
reviews.text: Excellent views, clean, fantastic for famalies, use entrance at Olhas Da Agua for most scenic view, good parking here also.

reviews.title: Beautiful wide sweep of sand
reviews.text: Beautiful spot with gently sloping golden sand. You need to find the access points to the beach - generally near hotels. Some have steep steps such as near Epic Sana. Others where there is a car park have a long slow climb eg Olhos de Agua or in Vilamoura no slope at all. From Vilamoura to Olhos de Agua you can walk about 5 miles before you have to cut inland. Low red and yellow unstable cliffs fringe the beach. The sand is very wide at low tide and all along is excellent for making sand castles and structures. Life guards and pay to lay sun beds and shades and a few cafes every half mile or so where the access points are.

reviews.title: Great Beach
reviews.text: Great Beach with lots of shells to hunt around for, water is great fun but can get choppy with is still fun but not so good for the kids if they are nervous.

reviews.title: Very clean
reviews.text: I think this is one of the best beaches in Europe. It is very clean with an interesting cliff backdrop to it. There are plenty of sun loungers for hire and a few beach cafe/bars too. Very pleasant to walk on.

reviews.title: Tranquil
reviews.text: My husband and I visited this beach a few times whilst we were on our weeks holiday, it was so beautiful, peaceful and clean, the rock formation and views were amazing. We found the steps down to beach ok as we went down the 300 odd steps and came up the 100 step way, which you will find up the side of the cafe where the Portuguese flag flys and through the Carpark on the left. Can not wait to visit this beach again

reviews.title: Stunning
reviews.text: Beautiful beach with usually warm water and soft sand. Always very clean, great for swimming, sunbathing and long walks by the sea. Has lots of places to eat and drink all along the beach. A must visit beach of the Algarve

reviews.title: Lovely beach
reviews.text: Great beach but with very strong waves! Only 9 euros a day to hire a lounger, great value for money. There was a snack bar at the top of the stairs which was really handy. Would visit again!

reviews.title: Stunning
reviews.text: Great beach , very clean , sun beds available and not expensive No litter or cigarette dimps as you may find on other beaches

reviews.title: Romantic stroll
reviews.text: Staying at the resort nearby lots of steps to get down, but it was safe.Quiet, locally used beachBeach bars along the beach - nice for snacks or dinnerFriendly staffClean sandy beach

reviews.title: Lovely beach
reviews.text: Lovely beach with some water sports activities to do. Can always find a quiet spot if you are what it

reviews.title: Beautiful quiet sandy beach
reviews.text: A steep climb, was worth it to visit this lovely beach, the ocre  coloured cliffs,topped with pine trees,  yellow sand and clean ocean.   However, difficult for anyone with mobility issues, but that does mean the beach is relatively quiet for a resort beach.

reviews.title: Great beach with water sports
reviews.text: Visited with my husband , 9 and 10 year old whilst staying in the Algarve as 15mins drive from Loule where we were staying. Parking free and plenty of space on the hill leading down to the beach or at the top in the road. Bar/cafe at the top of steps leading down to the beach which has the usual sun bed and parisole areas. Lots of water sports on offer, my son and husband tried paddle boarding for 15 Euro’s. One of the best beaches in the Vilamoura area.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: You would be hard pushed not to find a beautiful beach in this area but Falésia Beach is something special. A short 15 minute walk from our hotel, the beach is down a fairly steep hill and then accessed by wooden steps but definitely worth the effort. Stunning views, especially at sunset, the area is picture prefect and clean, great for families with plenty of space for you lounger or towel.Well worth a visit!

reviews.title: Stunning Beach
reviews.text: This beach is pure paradise long beach amazing cliffs and it is clean. You can have great walks here and also enjoy the lovely sunset.

reviews.title: Gorgeous Beach
reviews.text: Gorgeous beach that goes on for quite a way so definitely one for a long walk if you fancy it. At the top where the stairs are it is very busy but if you wander down for 10 minutes or so there are quieter sections of the beach. Bit of a walk down but 100% worth it.

reviews.title: Lovely beach
reviews.text: Stayed up the hill at falesia gardens stunning beach  very clean and well kept  not as busy as other beaches near by

reviews.title: Stunning
reviews.text: No words can do this beach justice as it’s absolutely beautiful. Gets really busy but you can really appreciate it’s beauty early hours when the sun is coming up in peace and quiet around 6am was my favourite time. Starts getting busy about 9 /9:30Runs for a fair few miles all the way to vilamoura and has a number of cafes water sports etc along the way. Good day out for all. Plenty of loungers and umbrellas if needed at certain parts of the beach.

reviews.title: Long sandy beach with quiet areas
reviews.text: The orange cliffs make this beach stand out from the rest.- lovely for a long stroll in the shallows. You can go for miles!Several areas protected by life guards - but note these get very crowded with tourists and locals alike. Nevertheless, just a few metres walk and you can find a peaceful stretch. Sea can be rough with strong currents, but usually lovely.

reviews.title: Clean beach
reviews.text: Loved having a swim in the sea. There were clear boundaries that people had made. If you walked to the right, children occupied that beach with games and floats and loudness and on the left, adults only and quiet. There is a shower there to wash yourself afterwards and even an option to have a massage out in the open. We had great weather in August and would highly recommend this beach.

reviews.title: Falesia Beach
reviews.text: Beautiful clean beach   a steep climb down from the main street but well worth the climb  not to over run

reviews.title: exelent beach
reviews.text: Nice beach to go to. Exelent restaurant. Parking is almost unavailable. The water temp is ideal for all.

reviews.title: Absolutely Gorgeous
reviews.text: We visited the beach in the morning and at night. The backdrop is unique and worth the trip alone. We walked the beach for awhile and the scenery is gorgeous.

reviews.title: Beautiful backdrop
reviews.text: Worth a visit. It was very crowded but that seems to be the Algarve in July-August. Arrive early to get parking.  This is a long beach compared to most beaches in this area. The cliffs are a beautiful red and white. Very nice.

reviews.title: Nice but crowded
reviews.text: The sand was fine, the rock was beautiful, the waves were great, the view is nice but it is so so crowded...

reviews.title: Nice beach
reviews.text: The beach is large and goes for miles which in turn means you can find space.The sand has a lot of small shells in it however you can find areas where it is pure sand.The sea seems to have a little bit of seaweed floating in it but it's not enough to put you off. I would prefer to come here over the beach right next to us in the old town Albufeira as it is extremely busy there.

reviews.title: Beach
reviews.text: Always a great beach to visit- that’s why is on the top 20 beaches to go on trip advisor. Although Portugal is blessed with lots of great beaches, my favourite is Galé about five miles to the west!

reviews.title: Great vibe
reviews.text: This is a lovely beach. We got here at 10.15, would recommend getting here an hour earlier. There are sun beds here. It is a walk down from the car park to the steps, which then take you down to the beach (79 in total, we counted), we managed fine with a 3 year old. It does get very busy, but it has a great vibe. If you want more space, walk further down and the crowd thins out. It is quite unique to go to beach with red cliffs behind.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach!
reviews.text: Can walk for miles, sea is different every day due to the tides. Some watersports, jet ski, paddle boards, pedalos, flying sofa. Could do with a little beach shop selling refreshments there are a couple of restaurants.

reviews.title: Best beach in Algarve
reviews.text: Not even too crowded, for a EUROPEAN beach. Gentle 1 foot rollers at low tide. Beach goes on forever!

reviews.title: Falesia beach
reviews.text: Lovely and clean life guards there all day really nice beach plenty of places to buy food there if need be

reviews.title: Had to do the walk
reviews.text: They said it was a challenge due to the number of steps down to the beach in 35c they were right but well worth the sweat and toil nice clean beach

reviews.title: Great beach, great walk
reviews.text: Outstanding clean beach backed by spectacular red cliffs that are a photographers dream.  My recommendation walk the length of the beach from Falesia to Vilamoura (about 3.5miles, have a nice drink on arrival, take in the sights and walk back over the cliffs, brilliant. Of course you can always catch a bus back they run at regular intervals so give it a go and enjoy the whole occasion.

reviews.title: Unique and very nice beach
reviews.text: An excellent, clean, beautiful beach set in a unique landscape. Apart from the absence of a beach bar, it offers all the other facilities (surveillance, water sports, hats, etc). The visitors / vacationers must however have in mind some aspects that may not please: access to the beach is done through a staircase with 80 steps; July and August have quite a few people (peak of the Algarve / Summer / vacation) so the space in the sand may not abound; the beach itself does not have a support bar; there is yes but on-site access to the beach. Of regret that some occupants deface the cliff with some trash (bags, bottles, papers) and go up the finds to write in the same. The cliff wants itself as it is: natural. For the wear already enough is promoted by nature.

reviews.title: Great beach
reviews.text: Lovely location,you can park in the wooded area and walk down to the beach. there are some great photos opportunities, along the way.There is a little bar at the top of the stairs .with a toilet.The beach has the usual loungers and water sports .Not far by car from Albufeira .

reviews.title: Probably one of the most beautiful beaches in Europe
reviews.text: Saw many beaches and for example the ones in Sardegna are on a high level but Falesia with the colorful rocks is extraordinary.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Loved the beach. Water sports available too. Clean and sunbed hire available.  White sands, orange cliffs and blue sea.  Beautiful.

reviews.title: Nice clean beach
reviews.text: I would recommend Falésia beach , very clean and so vast , it is very popular but if you don’t mind walking from the steps in either direction along the beach you can always find a spot with room , toilets are in the bars situated along the beach and snacks are available there too, the sea was cold on one particular day we went , with a drift from the Atlantic coming in but that’s nature ! We were staying near Olhos d’Agua and walked from Falésia to there along the shore when the tide was out , fantastic end to the day

reviews.title: Nice beach, pity about so many many people...
reviews.text: Nice beach but so many people on it, it was hard to get past people almost. There must be quieter ones around the area.

reviews.title: Lovely beach!
reviews.text: This beach has such a lovely scenery with good facilities. Lots to keep everyone occupied - rock pools, banana boats, paddle boards, pédalos etc... would definetely visit again!

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: The beech is beautiful, golden sand and lovely clear water. Two restaurant/bars on the beech. Pedlows available and other waste r sports. Mixture of tourists and local people visiting the beech which creates a lovely atmosphere.

reviews.title: Miles and miles of soft sandy beach...
reviews.text: This is a very long beach.  It's a fair few steps down to it, with the only bar being at the top of the steps.  There are no toilets close by.  The sea is safe, you can hire beds and parasols and there is a water sports centre.  However, it lacks the facilities of some of the smaller local beaches with beach side restaurants.

reviews.title: Night Visit
reviews.text: A very different perspective on a visit to this lovely beach. In the evening it is very peaceful, there are few people on the  beach and it is a totally different experience e to the crowded day.There were fishermen to watch and a few others walking enjoying an evening walk.A very relaxing experience

reviews.title: Portugal summer Vac
reviews.text: Falesia and its surrounding beaches ,shops,restaurants, coffee shops and fantastic accommodation is the one stop shop of vacations. Always a pleasure to visit here-always want to come back

reviews.title: Busy beach  - don't bother!
reviews.text: The pictures of this beach are nothing like the reality. It is very busy and overcrowded. Not a pleasant experience and certainly not worth the steps down to it!

reviews.title: August 2018
reviews.text: The fabulous beach 'Praia da Falesia runs from Olhos de Agua in the west all the way east to Vilamoura, with numerous beach accesses to choose from.But here's an insider tip; drive in the direction of the Alfamar Hotel and then east to Roxa Baixinha. The tarmac road then goes to a dirt road for another 750 meters where you will find the entrance to 'Praia dos Tomates' (Tomato Beach). Parking just off the beach will cost you 2.50€ for the day in high season, but believe me, it is worth it!The beach is just fabulous, with long stretches of white sand and a gentle slope into the turquoise waters, with the amazing back drop of low orange-hued cliffs.When the heat gets too much - and it will - there is a beach bar at the entrance to the beach called 'Quebra Côco' (broken coconut), where they serve cool beer in iced glasses and have a delicious array of snacks and salads.Life just doesn't get any better!

reviews.title: Nice beach!
reviews.text: A nice, long and wide beach. Possibility to park the car nearby. A small bar nearby. Only cold water...

reviews.title: Never on a Sunday in August
reviews.text: Arrived around 1pm and eventually managed to find parking.  Walked along to the wooden steps down to the beach and was greeted with the human equivalent of an ant colony.
