The beach was packed like I have never seen before and as we live on the Costa Del Sol we see a lot of beaches!Stayed less than an hour.  Sunbeds all taken so no shade. It may be as beautiful as other reviewers say when it's a bit quieter but this day was the worst beach experience I have ever had.

reviews.title: Heaven
reviews.text: This is one of the best beaches we have been to . The rocks above it make it  magical and as if it is something from Jurassic Park ! Stunning views and very wild. Has clean toilets and showers . Has a couple of cafe shops / bars for light lunch . Guarded beech as well. Bring your own parasol, cold bag, sun protection and you will be in Heaven !

reviews.title: Great beach
reviews.text: Spent a great day at this beach recently. It offers great facilities; beach umbrellas, sun loungers, showers, toilets and plenty of restaurants. The highlight were the water activities. We went parasailing and hired a pedalo too. All in all a great day at the beach.

reviews.title: Beautiful beautiful beach
reviews.text: Fantastic beach - absolutely perfect place to spend the day with your family. Beach is as natural as can be - the sea water is freezing.

reviews.title: Amazing beach
reviews.text: This was the most beautiful beach we visited in Algarve. We have visited several beaches in the area from Lagos up to Albufeira and this has been my top pick. The water was actually warmer and crystal clear with out any seaweed. There weresome waves but small enough to feel safe with the Kids swiming. Ideal for Kids and families. There is a small restaurant that sells pizza and sandwiches and ice cold beer! But bring your own food and water because there is not much to buy. It was so beautiful we stayed to watch the sunset.

reviews.title: Lovely beach near restaurants
reviews.text: Lovely beach where you can pay for a lounger or bring your own accessories. Near restaurants and shops.

reviews.title: Praid de Falesia - great for early morning runs
reviews.text: Lovely stretch of beach running from Olhos d'agua to Vilamoura.  Early morning when the tide was out enjoyed jogging along in the relative cool.

reviews.title: Most beautiful Falesia Beach
reviews.text: This is the most beautiful beach. It is our 4th stay at the Portobay.  They have built a new wooden stair access (100+ steps)  with handrails down to beach.  We stay to the right side. There are padded lounge chairs with umbrellas available for 15 euros for the full day. It is a guarded beach.  When the tide is out you can enjoy a pretty walk across the rocks all the way to the Olhos d Agua beach/town. There are bathroom facilites and a full restaurant, O Golfino, perfect for lunch or snack, reservations taken. There is a shower also available, but is not free.  Perfect beach, the red cliffs topped with dark green pines and the whitest cleanest sand as far as you can see and the beautiful Atlantic ocean in front, more than beautiful. Be sure to enjoy the bolinhas they walk around to sell.  I even bought a beautiful beach. Bolinhas are the best.Blanket from a sand vendor, you can sit back and they pass right by.  Very enjoyable beach.

reviews.title: Best beach in the algarve.
reviews.text: This is the finest beach we have ever visited. Very long, white sand, clear blue water, safe for children, clean.Plenty of places to nip off for a bit of food or drink. Definitely don't miss this one.

reviews.title: Gorgeous if a little busy
reviews.text: Wonderful stretch of sand, if you head further down the beach it is quieter. The first beach on the right is very good, the second is high end with high prices

reviews.title: Lovely Beach
reviews.text: Beautiful beach, has wooden steps to access with a small cafe bar for snacks and drinks. The sand is lovely, and has beds and umbrellas to rent.

reviews.title: Worth the trek
reviews.text: This is a spectacular beach which I understand is four miles long. We were staying at Clube Humbria in Olhos D’Agua which has its own beach. However that beach is ok but gets quite busy. It is a 10/15 min walk from our hotel whereas Falesia beach is 20 mins but well worth the trek. We walked the first time but with two small children we tried a taxi the second time. This was a mistake as we were dropped a mile further along the beach where the nearest road access allowed. So we walked back along the beach to our favourite spot nearer to where our walk had taken us on the first visit and where we hired loungers and there were rock pools for shrimping , crabbing and fishing.

reviews.title: lovely views and sunsets
reviews.text: worth a look, sandy and Little Rock pools for the kids to look in too.   probably need decent shoes to walk on this beach though.

reviews.title: Beautiful expansive beach
reviews.text: This beach seems to go on for ever. It is worth taking the time to walk to the quieter sections in the middle. The water is also clearer there. Take a picnic and parasol and set yourself up for the day. Some water sports available and parasol and lounger hire. Very little natural shade. The cliffs are stunning.

reviews.title: Beach Bums
reviews.text: This is a beautiful beach with steps going down to the beach. The sand wasn't too hot to walk on and the sea was a bit chilly.The beach has a lifeguard and sunloungers and parasols. The parasol get taken up quick.

reviews.title: Great beach but too busy
reviews.text: Visited late in the day. Unless you are ultra early, leave the car at the top of the track because parking on the beach is a nightmare.  Apart from that it's ok.

reviews.title: Lovely relaxing beach
reviews.text: Great beach never over crowded. Clean and relaxing  and be accessed from Porto Bay Falesia hotel. Great day for all

reviews.title: Great beach day
reviews.text: Many of the beaches in the Algarve that we’ve visited have been scenic but very packed. This beach is both scenic and has lots of room to spread out without feeling you were on top of people. There is a vendor at the top of the cliff before descending down the stairs to the beach that sells beach items (towels, beach toys, umbrellas, etc) that was helpful. Great day all around!

reviews.title: good trip
reviews.text: perfect beach for relaxing and rest, good for long walks and chill in the sun. easy access to the sea.

reviews.title: Sandy gem
reviews.text: Beach very clean and stretches for miles. Very popular when we were there. There is a car park but I'm unsure how it is accessed. There are toilets and showers and place to eat. Would suggest a few more waste bins. Water very clear but beware of the drag of the waves it can be quite strong. Also freezing!!

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Go to this beach from Clube Humbria not the Praia dos Olhos de Agua which is pebbly small overcrowded and has loads of seaweed.

reviews.title: Beautiful, large beach
reviews.text: Beautiful beach. Yes it's busy with tourists but the beach is so large my girlfriend and I found a spot easily with more than ample space. Waves were extremely fun and not harsh. We parked down the hill from where you turn to go into the beach so it was a 5-10 minute walk but not too bad. Check out the restaurants down the hill for some amazing piri piri chicken and gelato ice cream. Happy travels!

reviews.title: Top
reviews.text: Superbe plage ! Il suffit de marcher un peu pour être seuls ! C’est magic !Magnificent beach ! Just walk a bit and there will be nobody around. It’s magic !

reviews.title: Nice
reviews.text: Quiet , well kept . And lovely . Loungers available at a cost . Restaurant there which sells drinks and ice creams too

reviews.title: Cliff top view and clean beach
reviews.text: Fantastic view from the cliff top that run all the way along the beach, the road down to the beach is very steep and then you have to walk down a wooden staircase, some older visitors may find the walk difficult especially but up the hill,

reviews.title: Day Visit
reviews.text: Nice few hours here , very busy & touristy . Lovely beach & great views . Lots to do , lots of bars & restaurants to eat & drink .

reviews.title: Recommend a visit - enjoyable experience
reviews.text: Recommend a visit - enjoyable experience, especially when weather is very hot. Plenty of available facilities - view excellent.

reviews.title: Fab
reviews.text: Loved it! Spent two days there, watersports were great fun, definitely worth a visit. Parking was awkward though and be aware there’s a lot of steps

reviews.title: Nice safe family beach right next to the marina
reviews.text: This beach is the nearest to the marina and is busy in July and August. It has 3 good beach bars/restaurants. It is popular with young families as the sea is pretty calm and shallow.

reviews.title: Wonderful
reviews.text: A walk down 137 steps which seems like 20. Clean sandy beach stretching for miles. Very cold water! 🤤 Still inviting. 🏊‍♂️

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: Although this beach is amazing, it could be an issue for anyone not good at walking, climbing stairs or with heights phobias. There are steps down to the beach but there is a lot of them.

reviews.title: Beach
reviews.text: Beach is Clean and locals friendly. The cafe at the top supply hot and cold food and a lovely shaded area to eat .

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Recommended a visit . A clean beach with plenty of sunbeds.  There is a bar / restaurant so you can get a drink and of course there are toilets.

reviews.title: The beach of all beaches
reviews.text: Wow this beach must be 5 or 6 miles long of beautiful sand in a clear pale green sea. Lots of entertainment in the form of watersports in various places up and down the beach along with places to eat, along with sunloungers and shade should you wish to rent them. Waves are good too, its one of those places if your near you have to go and visit

reviews.title: Looking to soak up some sun and have FUN.
reviews.text: We loved the area, the beach the atmosphere,too bad the water was too cold for swimming, other than that we enjoyed our visit.You can get an area with two beach chairs and umbrella for €18 for a whole day.

reviews.title: Swimming
reviews.text: Beautiful beach however overpriced restaurants that are not worth it. Plus the energy is not good down there ! There are plenty better beaches that you should see ;)

reviews.title: Red sand but nothing special
reviews.text: If you are close to the beach you should give it a try. But if you are coming form another part of the town just to see it don't bother. You will find a red sand beach, but  noting special in my opinion.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: There’s honestly not a lot I can say about it, you really have to be there to experience it. Lying on it is relaxing, and the view of the ocean is breath-taking.

reviews.title: Stunning beach views.
reviews.text: Amazing place for clifftop walks. We aren't the types to lie on the beach these days but there were plenty who did and the area is very clean and well kept.

reviews.title: very clean beach
reviews.text: nice sunchairs and relaxing. good bar and restaurant - water a bit cold but nice to walk on this beach.

reviews.title: Perfect
reviews.text: A very long beach 6 miles I think I was told clean fresh sands sun all day sun cream and brolly`s a must vast amounts of cliff faces all with fab colours and flowers, a few beach bars serving the normal if here with young children please ensure they are covered up even on a cloudy day.  you can go down, at night to watch the sun sets you will not be disappointed. You can if you want walk 1 way to Albufeira just watch the tides, the other way to Vilamoura or just pop round the corner to Olhos D Auga olld fishing village another beach bars and shops not to be missed. On the beach you can hire beds and brolly`s at a price take your own.Save some drink for the climb back up.

reviews.title: beach
reviews.text: beautiful beach well worth a visit especially at nightime gorgeous sunsets as well.ideal for walks brilliant

reviews.title: First visit not the last
reviews.text: 1st visit to this hotel and not the last. The hotel is spotless, rooms and beds are large, and atmosphere is relaxing and happy. The manager Carlos know how to get the best out of his staff. Every member from the great waiters and bar staff and cleaners were so very helpful, accommodating  and friendly. Everybody had a smile on their face including the guests. The entertainment team,Harry,Chloe,Dani , Dom and the house band Panache were wonderful. But a special mention must go to Harry , who's sense of humour and caring attitude to every guest made our holiday even more special. The guy needs a commendation from TUI.We'll be back next year God willing. Rob and Liza

reviews.title: 50th Birthday
reviews.text: Beautiful beach not to busy. Couple of cafesQuite a few steps down to it so not for anyone with walking difficulties.

reviews.title: Beautiful long sandy cliff lined quiet beach
reviews.text: This is our favourite past time walking around Vilamoura marina over the small pedestrian bridge & then along the beautiful cliff lined beach as far as we can & then stop & have a beer at one of the cafe/bats along the route then walk home. There are quality facilities along the beach more spread out the further from Vilamoura you venture, the cliff formations are worth the wander alone, the perfect day.

reviews.title: Quiet
reviews.text: Very nice beach, quiet and lots of space to find your own spot. Safe for kids although in June the weather was a bit windy and not so hot and the water was just 18 degrees but felt v cold.

reviews.title: Love this place!
reviews.text: The reception staff were very friendly & helpful. The apartment, 1232, was spacious, comfortable & clean. All outside areas were immaculate. We had bed & breakfast, the food was great. We had one dinner there, it was reasonably priced. We ate out every in the village every night, plenty of choice. Lovely walk down to the beach from the resort. Hired chair beds & brolly, very comfortable, 15euros a day. Beach cafe was also very good. We hope to return in early October!

reviews.title: Glorious long beach
reviews.text: Miles & miles of soft sand with only the Atlantic Ocean on the horizon. Fantastic to walk along at low tide. Backed by cliffs, with various access points up wooden steps for well trodden cliff walks with stunning views. Sunbeds for hire at intermittent points along the way, with mile after mile of empty beach in between. There is a regular bus service from Albufeira, takes about 25 minutes, a worthwhile day out, which picks up at Oura Intermarche,  St Eulalia, & Olhus d'Agua.

reviews.title: Miles and miles of golden sand
reviews.text: Miles and miles of golden sand describes this beach pretty well. Although busy there was plenty of space so it never felt crowded. The beach is clean and safe with toilets near by. I can strongly recommend hitting one of the restaurants close byto have a Somersby Apple cider to cool off.

reviews.title: Beach walk
reviews.text: Just a fabulous beach. Clean accessible and beautiful. Plenty of space. Beach bars are great. Will come back

reviews.title: Spectacular
reviews.text: Lovely sandy beach where, if you walk a little you can be away from the crowds or you can stay near the entrances and beach restaurants and still not be too crowded. The sea is not as cold as the English Channel but then only the Artic is colder than the English seas! There are life guards at certain points but the sea can be choppy and does shelve quickly so it is important to keep a close eye on children. The cliffs are fascinating in their colours and formations. And finally if you fancy a decent beach walk then there are 7 km of continuous sand to enjoy starting from the marina at Vilamora.

reviews.title: A sandy cove in centre of Albufeira
reviews.text: Cove surrounded by cliffs, some nice rock pools for children and stronger swimmers can swim out to marked bouys.  Beach with sunbeds for hire and a restaurant/bar/toilets.  Walk cliffs to reach Old Town in 15-20 mins.   Limited parking right down at the beach if follow the beach signs from the main road (near MacDonalds junction)  and arrive before midday.

reviews.title: best beach to visit
reviews.text: i would definitly recommend going to Falesia beach as its beautiful and breathtaking:)there might be a struggle with parking a car in a busy peak time as its limited.

reviews.title: Nice beach
reviews.text: Nice beach that is not crowded at all. Plenty of room for everyone. Not suitable for wheelchair since there are many steps and stairs down to the beach from road and parking.

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: Whilst it is a long way down a lot of steps the time and effort spent is well worth the effort.  Turn left at the bottom and you can walk for 5 miles to Villamora. The beach is clean and comfortable sand to walk on with fantastic scenery with cliffs of a variety of shades.

reviews.title: Beautiful in every aspect
reviews.text: The views are outstanding. It's not very crowded and loungers are available for about €17-19 for two with an umbrella

reviews.title: Lovely beach
reviews.text: Stunning beach with a couple of nice places to eat sun beds with umbrellas to hire ( not sure of cost as we did not use them )

reviews.title: At the end of the road
reviews.text: This beach was accessed by a well maintained staircase. It was overseen by lifeguards and was not overcrowded at the times we went.

reviews.title: Magical
reviews.text: I go there every year it's a clean well kept beach i can spend all day here  and the light and the views are just breath taking

reviews.title: Day out
reviews.text: We walked 30 minutes to get to beach and the views were amazing there is a bar at the top of the steps so you can get cold drinks and food

reviews.title: One of the most beautiful beaches in Algarve
reviews.text: Very nice and beautiful beach, not overcrowded  (at least in the middle of June). There is a very nice view from above:)

reviews.title: Best beach
reviews.text: This beach provides for all the famiky ..fun optiins for sport , swimming and more . Long walks for romantics and fab restaurants to chill under the setting sun. Clean facilities with showers also available

reviews.title: Stunning views
reviews.text: Great place for lots of photos. The beach is beautiful. There are lovely local restaurants nearby like Neptuno and Frango Real. There prices are cheap for a snack, lunch or dinner. Fabulous walks along the beach into Vilamoura or Olhos de agua. If you have kids or mobility issues there is parking on the main road leading down to the beach but it can get very busy during summer. There is quite a few steps leading down to the beach but well worth it.

reviews.title: Walking
reviews.text: Absolutely beautiful beach to walk. Goes on and on. Even the odd place to stop for s beer or coffee. Great for photography

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Lovely walk to nearest town velermoura. Restaurants.life guards toilets . Think wheel chair may struggle as it's Sandy beach .

reviews.title: Falésia Beach
reviews.text: Nice rocks with intensive colours mixing the red, white and some yellow just beside the blue ocean  - it is wonderful. I took a walking tour from the bus station at Pine Cliffs stop beside nice hotels and pines. At the end of the walking tour I found this really nice Beach. Lovely sandy beach with red rocks, parasols, plants. Unforgettable adventure

reviews.title: Just stunning
reviews.text: This is quite simply one of the most beautiful beaches in the area.If you like long sandy beaches, with clear safe water to swim in then look no further.You can walk as far as Vilamoura marina if you have the energy, or just a stroll along to one of the beach bars dotted along the long beach.Parking can get busy, so you can drive to further points along the beach to find other parking. If you are prepared to walk a bit, you will find your own space on the beach.Fantastic cliff formations and erosin to look at.A great walk a long the beach and back along the top of the cliff if you like a circular walk!

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Stunning beach. Beautiful setting. Long steps down to get on the beach, but definitely worth it. Fantastic backdrop of cliffs.

reviews.title: stunning scenery!!
reviews.text: the scenery is awesome   and almost white sand !! we walked from villamoura to  falesia  and  its stunning

reviews.title: Good
reviews.text: Very nice beach . Although when i went the weather was awfull. Rides where ok.Certainly we would return

reviews.title: Paradise
reviews.text: Falesia beach is elected one of the most beautiful beach in the world; it deserves this title 100%:A mixture of the national parks in the USA; Brice Canon, Zion , Canon de Chelly, etc

reviews.title: Popular, yet quiet
reviews.text: We've been there on 2 June. Sea is freezing cold during that time of the year. Well, if you're not a nordic family. :) Family friendly beach.

reviews.title: memorable
reviews.text: this is one of the best beaches I have ever spent anytime on. The combination of cliffs, beach and ocean make for an incredible nature experience that you will not forget. Remember to bring your camera.

reviews.title: Beautiful views
reviews.text: Very clean and beautiful beach , beautiful views. Everyone has to visit. Few restaurans in the beach. Definately recomending.

reviews.title: Very good
reviews.text: We found the beach was kept very clean with good facilities , we would definitely make a return trip to this area.

reviews.title: Just gorgeous!
reviews.text: The beach is spotless, unspoilt with access to 2 restaurants/bars which have easy accessible toliets and showers outside. No need to worry about cutting through the restaurant to go to the toliet. For 3 sun loungers it cost us 13 euro per day, very reasonably priced.

reviews.title: Lovely beach
reviews.text: Lovely beach with golden sands, toilets and a bar so got your comfort stops, this is a beach that doesn't get crowded thankfully, must also say Galway entertainer you are very wrong about the bullfighting the Bull is not killed, nor is it tortured I've not seen any of the Bulls bleed the whole event is carefully choreographed all the animals are very well cared for

reviews.title: Stunning
reviews.text: An absolute must see if you're in this area. It's an incredible place to walk and relax. The cliffs really are breathtaking, many pictures don't do them justice. The most beautifl and peaceful place I think I've been.

reviews.title: Great little beach
reviews.text: Was lovely and quiet when we went.. so so peaceful. There is also a bar and toilets at tge beach entrance for comfort stops.

reviews.title: Wonderful Beach
reviews.text: The water quality is excellent. Always sunny. Very clean beach and extremely safe. Perfect for families. Any person's dream holiday - I highly recommend this beach.

reviews.title: Overpriced deck chairs but nice beaxh
reviews.text: The red cliffs are stunning and the beach is lovely, however the sand is quite coarse compared to Sao Rafael beach and the deckchairs were overpriced!

reviews.title: Long, clean beach
reviews.text: Typical Algarve beach, in that it's backed with cliffs making for a walk down but that is what gives it the scenic appeal.Seems OK for swimming and good for just pottering, walking or doing nothing. Couple of places for refreshments.

reviews.title: Falesia Beach
reviews.text: The beach was excellent was very clean and extended for miles we were able to walk along tthe beach to the next town of Vilamoura . First class. Water cold in May though.

reviews.title: Calm and beautiful place
reviews.text: The beach was by to the hotel and was so beautiful and calm. This place offer a nice infra structure and you can rent a chair and umbrella for all or half day... Also you can find a restaurant or you can enjoy a massage at the beach. The only thing is that in May the sea is cold, sometimes impossible to get some sun refreshing.

reviews.title: Lovely Beach
reviews.text: Beach was straight out the back of our hotel. Sunbed and shade hire quite pricey, which is the only downside to the beach I.e for two beds and a shade the cost was 15 euros. However the beach does provide life guards and it's a sandy beach. Lovely walk in either direction from the beach ... Can be a bit of a scramble at times however.

reviews.title: Lots of steps
reviews.text: Lovely beach, but expensive sun beds. There are many steps, you needs to very fit! Make sure you don’t forget anything and have to go back!

reviews.title: Great clean beach - not croweded beginnig of may
reviews.text: this beach is extremely clean and we travled here in the first week of May and was not crowded at all -- only down side is there are solicitors begging you to buy sunglasses, blankets and other trinkets, mostly from Africa

reviews.title: Love this beach
reviews.text: A long, sandy beach which we always enjoy during our visits to the Algarve.  There are places to have  can obviously sunbathe to your hearts content or if like us you just like to stroll along the sand the this is the place to do it.

reviews.title: Mikes of clean sand and blue waters
reviews.text: We traveled by bus from Faro.Very regular service.Hiwever check the timetable as there is a break in the middle of the day.These buses get crowded as they collect from the airport but if you get in / off at the terminal end/beginning...Far or the beach....you’ll be fine.We couldn’t see access to public toilets although there are plenty of cafes and restaurants.Very clean beaches..not filled with load music.Loved it

reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: This is a stunning beach on which you can walk for miles.I would recommend a visit.It is beside Villamoura and a great escape for a more laid back day.

reviews.title: Great beach - fantastic scwnery
reviews.text: Loved this beach, amazing scenery & lovely places to eat or get a drink. It must get very busy here on high season

reviews.title: gorgeous beach
reviews.text: Nearest beach to our hotel. Just over 100 steps down and back up, but shaded areas with benches to have a rest if you need it. Car parking available (quite small) down there, but an awkward bit of road (?) to negotiate with craters and potholes. Glad I didn't have to drive.Plenty of sand, nice for dipping the toes in the sea. A few places for an eat and drink, toilets. Beautiful orange colour of the cliffs against the pure blue sky.All in a lovely spot. Plenty of room for everyone. Recliners and parasols to hire in various places.

reviews.title: Great beach
reviews.text: Travelled with small toddler & 4 adultsBeach amazing, lovely sand, heat trapWe took some beers to beach as no bars localVery cleanLifeguards on part of beach to Adriana beach club hotel

reviews.title: Beautiful Golden Beach
reviews.text: A wonderful beach which was located just next to our hotel. My girlfriend and I walked the length of the beach to Vilamoura, which is around 7km, and enjoyed every bit of it.

reviews.title: The place behind the pines
reviews.text: Marvelous beach. One hundred wooden steps guided us from the hotel to the beach, passing through a pine forrest. Fine sand, spectacular yellow-red-green cliffs....and the continous sound of the ocean. Clean and not overcrowded.

reviews.title: A beautiful blue flag beach.
reviews.text: This was in front of our hotel down exactly 128 steps - quite steep going back up but with seats strategically placed to rest.

reviews.title: Stunning!
reviews.text: One of the most beautiful beaches I have ever seen. So picturesque.We stayed at the Adriana Beach Club and had to swipe in and out of the hotel to access the beach.

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: One of the highlights of our trips, beach was spotless and not overly busy. Great atmoshphere and my son loved it

reviews.title: Beautiful and not busy (yet)
reviews.text: Definitely a great beach to visit when you're in the Algarve. The water is only a bit cold in May! The only thing we missed was a little bar or restaurant at the beach.

reviews.title: Nice beach and surrounding area
reviews.text: Nice beach and surrounding area. One of the beaches where I partcularly like to go early in the morning at sunrise. Spectacular colours

reviews.title: Stunning beach but not easily accessible
reviews.text: Stunning beach, spotlessly clean and plenty of loungers etc. Steep hill to climb down followed buy lots of wooden steps - even worse coming back up!!!!

reviews.title: big stretch of beach in southern portugal
reviews.text: the sand is shell to Orange colored.the waters are blue green from the Atlantic. clean overall.lots of people on the beach. if you're staying at the hotels like epic sana, they have direct access to the beachfront.i believe it's a much longer walk from public.

reviews.title: Nice and sandy but lots of rocks.
reviews.text: Because of the spectacular cliffs the beach has lots of rocks. You can only go so far and have to watch where you are walking in some places. You also have to know the tide times because if you attempt to cross the large rocks in places you can get cut off.

reviews.title: stunning beach & views
reviews.text: This beach is one of the most beautiful in the Algarve. Follow signs to the beach.At the end of the road, it makes a left turn and down a hill, (or you drive over the cliff into the ocean).When you reach the point of the left turn, It is possible to turn right and park there at the top of the hill, under the trees. At the bottom of the hill are the access stairs to the beach. There are not a lot of stairs, and there are benches to rest at every 1/3 of the way. There is a snack & drink shop at the top of the stairs. They sell beer, tea, coffee, ice cream, and snacks. All of the seating is outdoor. Take care around the cliffs. There have been a lot of winter storms and a lot of erosion. Do not get close to the edge of cliffs and keep hold of small children. When you are on the beach, take care and don't set up camp too close to the cliffs. Rocks and earth are eroding quickly after the storms. For everyone's safety, stay off the cliffs where danger exists.

reviews.title: Great views
reviews.text: Lovely beach with great views of red and white cliffs. Decided to propose to my girlfriend on the cliffs!

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: It's the second time we visited the beach and won't be the last! Amazing views, once you there you might want to wait for the sunset, it will worth it.

reviews.title: Lovely
reviews.text: We came on an over cast day and a sunny day and enjoyed both. lots to explore and find. Good for shells and birdwatching

reviews.title: Lovely beach
reviews.text: We were staying at the nearby Epic SANA hotel which has direct access to this lovely sandy beach. The sand was clean and the sea not too chilly. Sun beds and parasols are available to hire but they weren’t available when we were there due to it not being the main season. There is a reasonably priced snack bar, just up from the main stairs selling a variety of drinks, snacks and ice creams.

reviews.title: Great beaches
reviews.text: So lovely to walk along paddling in the sea and plenty of bars along the beach for a refreshing drink

reviews.title: Home sweet home
reviews.text: I've lived in the Algarve all my life so I'm pretty familiar with the majority of beaches, and this one is definetly one of my favourites. These cliffs are just beautiful and different. If you've been to the algarve before you know that majority of cliffs are alike, they look like they're made of sand and not many of them look like this. The beach is clean, the water is clear, and it's perfect for a sunrise and a sunset walk, as the views and its colours are a feast to the eyes. Definetly recommend.

reviews.title: Lovely beach walk
reviews.text: We walked along the beach, stopped for a drink in the beach cafe and it was delightful. It is a beautiful beach and lovely to walk over the rocks.

reviews.title: Beautiful views
reviews.text: This beach is spectacular, surrounded by stunning views and rustic rock. It’s a great place for walks and just to sit, relax & soak up the views. A great spot for every one

reviews.title: Great beach
reviews.text: Great beach. Very long great for a long walk. Little vendors on the cliffs to stop for a drink. If you go in summer months you will find reasonably priced sun beds and shades.

reviews.title: Pretty
reviews.text: pretty beach and a nice treat to stop by to see. We were there a day after a rainstorm and it was interesting to see the pools of colors in the sand that washed down from the cliffs.  Keep in mind that when you step to the edges of the overlooks, the cliffs are only sand. I was surprised that there werent more warnings.

reviews.title: Going there for surf
reviews.text: I like the place where is not crowed by season tourist, wonderful cost for biking and nice calm peak for surfing :)

reviews.title: Atlantic escape
reviews.text: AMAZING natural beach, great waves, walks, views, sea air. So good for the soul and well being. We love this beach

reviews.title: Amazing beach
reviews.text: Lovely rich sand and gentle waves on the day we were there plus the spectacular cliffs all added up to a good visit.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: We're used to Caribbean beaches, which are quite different from these. The cliffs are spectacular. It was too early in the season to fully enjoy the beach and the sea. The venues were still closed. We really enjoyed the walk on the beach and the views. Took some very nice pics.

reviews.title: large strip of nice sandy beach
reviews.text: Very nice beach. Long and sandy. The bus service was not too good... we waited for 1 h and not a single taxi to be seen. (there may be taxis but we saw none... maybe unlucky!

reviews.title: One of my favourite places on Earth
reviews.text: The beauty the tranquillity the colours the temperature the noises and the smells what a beautiful place to visit.  Great for walking lovely and clean great for families having fun lovely clear warm waters for children to swim safely and the scenery.  Did I mention I liked it ?

reviews.title: Endless beautiful beach
reviews.text: Went here on a rather overcast day. Endless beach with dramatic cliff backdrop. You could walk for hours here. Very beautiful and well worth a visit. You could spend a whole day here in good weather. Natural setting and not commercialised at all.

reviews.title: A beautiful beach
reviews.text: The beach is clean and had plenty of cafes along the way for refreshments and restrooms. We walked across the beach to Valimore. Recommend a visit.

reviews.title: Nice beach.
reviews.text: This is a nice beach when you want a place without wind.  The beach is very long so ideal for a beach walk.  I went in april so it was not to crowded.  I don't know if it's nice in summer.  I doubt that because it's in a very touristic area.

reviews.title: Day away from the hotel
reviews.text: Massive beach and really good to have come away from the hotel to enjoy the beauty of the coastline.

reviews.title: Beautiful long beaches
reviews.text: These beaches are well worth a visit.  They are very long and whether you want a long walk or a quiet sit, play or swim, they are beautiful.  Life guards also have a presents as well as visit by local police in their jeeps.  There are regular drinking a eating spots along the beach.The beach, however, has steep cliffs and is therefore only accessible at certain points along the cliffs.  We accessed through Pine Cliffs, down a lift and then down some easily accessible step, graduated, 3/4 step then a 2 metre flat, then repeated.  Other places to access where with steps and the a hill up.

reviews.title: Gorgeous beach
reviews.text: So this beach is amazing also it was near to where we stayed, I would not advise any one to visit if they are not very mobile as there are many steps down to the beach. But once there it's so beautiful, with fine powdery sand which stays cool under a hot sun, it must be miles long and looks spectacular because it's lined with these Sandy coloured cliffs the whole time. Only thing is if you leave something in the car or want something in the shop it's a trek back up. But all the same well worth visiting.

reviews.title: Holiday
reviews.text: Pleasant beach area with cafes,bars and restaurants to suit all tastes and budgets.Toilet block which we didn't need to use.

reviews.title: " Praia da Falesia "
reviews.text: Falesia Beach is part of a continuous stretch of sand which is approximately 7 km in length. It has a dramatic backdrop of high cliffs which are rich in colours ranging from reds to cream. The erosion of the cliffs provides deep grooves and gullies and in some areas the sand has formed what looks like giant termite mounds. There is access along the top of the cliffs with meandering path ways through pine groves and stunning vistas towards the sea. Please be advised that although there are some warning signs pertaining to the dangers of the cliffs, there are no barriers or fences, so families need to be vigilant regarding the safety of their loved ones.  I visited this beach in March 2018 and some days I could walk for miles without seeing another person. I would imagine that this would all change during the main holiday season as this beach is very popular with tourists and the local population. My advice is to visit this beach out of season to appreciate its beauty, tranquillity and cleanliness. The wild life on this part of the coast especially birds is very good. I saw many Waders, Red Legged Partridge, Hoopoe & Azure Winged Magpie. Also, there were the first signs of summer approaching with Swallows and Martins along with Sardinian Warblers and Black Redstarts arriving daily. Falesia Beach in my humble opinion is very impressive. However, it is not the easiest beach to access especially from the Olhos de Agua end. There are wooden stairways to negotiate which have hundreds of steps to and from the beach so this could prove problematic for some people.  Also, it is prudent to check the tide times as the sea can come in very quickly in some areas and you will find your beach walk cut off by the incoming tide.

reviews.title: Beautiful and unspoilt
reviews.text: A beautiful and unspoilt beach. Must be Three miles long. It sits at the bottom of cliffs so access for disabled is an issue. Lovely walks with unbelievable views along the cliff paths above the beach. You can hire beds and wind breaks and the beach does have some beach bars but not a lot. Unspoilt is the watchword and very beautiful and dramatic

reviews.title: Needs a clean
reviews.text: Beach needs addressing a few safety issuesThe walk ways are unsafeAnd a good tidy would help lots of rubbish and unsafe rock which isn't protected by any say netting, there is a safety signBut they still allow people on the beachIt's an accident waiting to happen.

reviews.title: Great beach
reviews.text: This beach is well worth the visit. It was a beautiful walk along the sand with the amazing cliffs as a backdrop. There were a lot of people walking and enjoying the peace and quiet. We came back via the road and it was only then we realised how far we had walked.

reviews.title: Decent beach
reviews.text: Decent beach with plenty of food places very very near . Sunbeds to hire and rocks to explore .watersports available

reviews.title: Simply stunning
reviews.text: This is one of the loveliest child friendly beaches I have visited in the Algarve.  With the ability to go out pretty far and still be shallow, it was excellent for my adventurous child.  The cliffs as a backdrop and stunning and they walk back either up the road or back toward olhos dagua beach round the rocks is very pleasant.

reviews.title: Beautiful and expansive beach
reviews.text: Stunning beach, with soft sand, goes on for miles. Deckchairs were 6 euros when we went. Only slight negatives were the long set of steps to get down to shoreline which may cause an issue for the elderly or those with a pram.

reviews.title: Nice stretch of beach
reviews.text: We accessed this beach from the top of the hill and there is a new staircase (129 steps to be precise!) built to gain access to the beach. Once on the beach there is a nice stretch of clean sand but there wasn't any sunbeds???This beach was not busy at all so you could pick wherever you wanted to set up camp 😄 There are a couple of restaurants scattered about which offer really nice food and drink.Worth a visit if in the area.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: We walked along the beach from Vilamoura not realising that we had walked all the way to this lovely beach.  We returned in the car and walked the rest of the way along the other way as the whole beach from Vilamoura is over 7 km long.  Really great cliffs back the beach all the way along and safe paths too, otherwise I would not normally recommend walking on the cliffs in the Algarve as they can be dangerous.  Lovely beach.

reviews.title: Superb beach
reviews.text: Miles of golden sand. Walk to Villamoura in two hours. Photo opportunities by amazing cliffs all the way.

reviews.title: As beautiful as 30 years ago
reviews.text: I visited here almost 30 years ago with my girlfriend who is now my wife. This year we have our son with his girlfriend with us and the beach was as beatiful as before.

reviews.title: Great beach with family
reviews.text: Staying at the Pine Cliffs resort and really enjoyed the beach here. Very accessible for the kids which are ages 10, 8, and 4. Low waves and good sandcastle making.

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: Beautiful beach walked to vilamora and back every day .Exceptionally clean and the scenery is stunning

reviews.title: Beautiful Views
reviews.text: In our last day in the Algarve, before our flight at 7 PM, we got the car and drove around many different places. We started quite early, at 7 AM to get the low tide, that allows people to see the water springs in Olho D'água. It is interesting to see non-salt water coming out from the sand. The springs are on the right hand side of the beach, but do not expect massive springs, they are small ones and you need to pay attention to the ground, they can only be seen during the low tide. There are some pools in which you can sit and relax, but as it was early in the morning, it was still cold for us to do that. We walked along the beach and through the "Falesias". Albufeira is a beautiful place and there is a lot to be explored. You can spend a day at Olho D'água or Falesia beach, as there are  restaurants along the coast, but you can also organize a day trip to see some beaches. Try a walk and enjoy the views from the top of the cliffs. In April it was cold in the morning, but the temperature rose by midday. We decided to wear trainners as we were doing some walks on the top of the cliffs, but we had flip flops and beach wear in the backpack, so we could also enjoy the beaches. You only need a couple of hours in each beach and it took us only 20 minute to drive between them. As I am from Rio and I had traveled to many places with astonishing coast in Brazil, a beach needs to be outstanding to blow me up, do not get me wrong, the ones in the Algarve are beautiful, but I think the walks above the cliffs and exploring the country side is a lot more worth it. If you enjoy spending a day by the sea, though, go for it, the infrastructure to make you comfortable is there!

reviews.title: Stunning beach
reviews.text: We enjoyed a wonderful stroll here yesterday . Gorgeous long sandy beach  that stretches from Olhas D”Água  towards Vilamoura.  It was a pleasure to enjoy the views . There are a few cafes either end of the beach if you wished to stop off en route . Well worth a visit !

reviews.title: Beautiful and clean sand beach
reviews.text: Very clean and clear beach. Has a long coastal line which is nice for a walk.As we visited in first week of April water was a bit cold for a swim.

reviews.title: Albufeira beaches
reviews.text: One of many stunning beaches on the Algarve we visited during our 3 week holiday.Recommended to all visitors. .

reviews.title: Beach visit
reviews.text: Excellent beach. Very clean. I really enjoyed staying on this beach.  Lots of local restaurants and a wide variety of shops all within easy reach.

reviews.title: Fantastic beach and views

reviews.title: Stunning
