reviews.title: Great beach
reviews.text: Great beach, very clean , lots of stairs but lift back up. You can walk from vilamoura all the way along.

reviews.title: Totally worth a visit
reviews.text: A wonderful beach to visit! There are short hiking paths and a stair case through the dunes. A must go from Albufeira!

reviews.title: Clean, calm & relaxing
reviews.text: Clean and close to large car park. Busy in the summer but were the only ones there today, probably due to the weather! Can't believe someone reviewed this beach as 'gritty'!!!!!

reviews.title: Spectacular red and white cliffs
reviews.text: A huge beach to the east of albufeira. Beautiful colours in the cliff. Wide sandy beach. Good wooden staircase down to the beach. Not a lot of parking considering the size of the beach. The small cafe at  the stairs has decent washrooms.

reviews.title: Boys trip
reviews.text: Was unable to sample the beach as the weather was pretty horrible. Beach looked very clean but sandy looked imported and quite gritty.

reviews.title: One of the best hotels in portugal excellent serive and hospitality
reviews.text: We will definitely return to the Falesia hotel many more times during the year because we know we will be well looked after and enjoy excellent food and good comfort.

reviews.title: Great beach
reviews.text: What can you say, it's a beach. In its favour is it natural beauty and ease of access. Ideal place to relax.

reviews.title: Alfarmar
reviews.text: Stayed at the Alfarmar, walked to villa ours, beautiful beaches, clean and nice. Not a lot of restaurants but probably because it’s still out of season. Enjoyed the views though

reviews.title: Took my breath away
reviews.text: The colour play at this beach was surreal. During this timenof the year not busy at all. Can walk for miles along the beach. Lots of sea shells. But: look out for the blue bottle jellyfish: they're supposed to sting like hell.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach with very colourful cliffs
reviews.text: Spectacular cliffs the length of the beach about a mile long.  There are a couple of roads down to the beach but we got there on foot from Olhos de Agua.  There is a well-maintained staircase down to the beach not far from the Riu.  It's about 75 meters west of the turn in the road that runs south past the Riu and then goes west to the Tui Blue Hotel.

reviews.title: A hidden gem
reviews.text: Boasting more than six kilometres of golden sand, stretching from Vilamoura in the west to Olhos do Agua in the east, Praia da Falesia is home to one of the longest beaches in Portugal.This sleepy residential town is known by the locals as 'beach town' and has managed to preserve something of its traditional Portuguese lifestyle. Backed by cliffs (falesia is Portuguese for cliff) decorated with pine trees the beach is accessed by steps that lead down from a clifftop car park.The sheer size of the beach and the laid-back atmosphere of the town contribute towards making this one of the more peaceful corners of the Algarve, although it is well-served by several top-class golf courses, a smattering of restaurants and bars and a number of accommodation complexes. Conveniently located between the towns of Vilamoura and Albufeira this quaint little town and its long, gorgeous beach are easily accessible by public transport.

reviews.title: pristine beach
reviews.text: I thought Praia da Rocha was unbeatable, but when I discovered Praia da Falesia ! wahooo, amazingly gorgeous place. Arrive early to find a parking space in the pine forest, walk down, (there's a café before going down the stairs) and then it's breath takingly beautiful. Easier if you have a car.

reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: I come here two or three times each British winter. Always a comfortable time away from our winter. People are very warm and welcoming.

reviews.title: Lovely beach
reviews.text: Visited this beautiful beach each time we go to Portugal after coming across it by chance. Just to sit on the bench on the wooden steps leading down to the beach and look at the sea, the cliffs and the sand is so relaxing.

reviews.title: Beautiful location
reviews.text: That was lovely walk for couple of hours. Me and my wife we enjoyed of that beautiful landscape. Very interesting rock formations, pine trees growing on the side of cliffs very colorful. Luckily on this time of the year was very quiet, only a few tourist, some fishermen's.

reviews.title: Amazing view
reviews.text: One of the most beautiful beaches in Albufeira and Algarve , great views from the cliff. Beautiful clean water and miles of pure sand beach . You can walk or run plenty a restaurants and bars near by .

reviews.title: Small but nice
reviews.text: Found this place by chance. We were following the coast line villages with a rented car, trying to find our way back to our hotel ...kind of lost through all the small streets. Saw a sign La Falaisa, so went down a small street that ended at the falaisa. Picturesque view of the ocean and abrupt rock façade. Many steps to get to the beach, but the view from above is nice anyways. A small restaurant is available for refreshments. I would not set out a day dedicated to the visit but if you come upon it make sure to visit.

reviews.title: Stunningly beautiful beach that goes for miles
reviews.text: Falesia beach is picturesque with amazing ochre and white cliff faces flanking 5 kilometers of the cleanest sand you might ever walk on.  You can walk (or run) all the way from Olhos d'Agua to Vilamoura.  The beach is plenty wide, but walking it is easiest during low tide when you will have a fast expanse of level and firm wet sand under your feet.  When the tide is in your walk will be a little more challenging in the softer sand up closer to the cliffs.  Either way, it is a delightful way to get fresh sea air and good exercise while enjoying the beauty of the Algarve.

reviews.title: Blown Away !
reviews.text: Visited during storm "Emma" that hit the Algarve for 4/5 days in Feb/March 2018.A lovely stretch of sand (without the debris from the storm).Dramatic atlantic colourful cliffs with pine woods overhanging.Photographers paradise.Walks along the beach with access to steep wooden steps up to surrounding areas with bars and restaurants.Easily accessible via lift from Pine Cliffs resort.Stunning dramatic scenery..Recommended if you are into a good walk in a natural enviroment.

reviews.title: Lovely
reviews.text: Brilliant beach, weather not good, but the sea pounding in was spectacular... visit this place if you do algarve

reviews.title: Great picturesque beach!
reviews.text: Visited here after arriving in Faro, 30 min drive then on to these stunning picturesque golden sand beaches with the sandstone rocks lit up by the bright sunshine. Some great restaurants and lovely little snack bars. Really nice beach and much favoured by the locals. Great place 100% highly recommended. Check out the offers in the restaurants on the top road! 4 course meal for 10 euros!

reviews.title: Awesome place
reviews.text: One of the best and most beautiful beach of Portugal. In autumn you can even see whales from the cliff.

reviews.title: Olhos dagua
reviews.text: Falesia beach is outstanding. Miles of endless beauty. So much space away from the accesses. The sea is just heavenly.

reviews.title: Beautiful clean sands
reviews.text: Accessed via steps from hotels and car parks this 5 miles beach is spectacular. You can walk at all states of the tide but it's hard work at high tide on the soft sand. We walked the entire length and back a couple of times. Worth remembering that out of season there is poor access to toilets and refreshments so check first! You can extend the walk both ends with a bit of effort.

reviews.title: Long stretch of sandy beach
reviews.text: Beautiful beach, very long sandy stretch  for about 5 kilometers and colorful cliffs. There is a nice little snack bar, serves all kinds of beverages and little snack items at the top of the cliff  right at the stairs.  From there you have a nice view of the beach. To get to the beach there are quite a few stairs to get down. The beach is good for walking, jogging, or just relaxing. Parking for cars is available before you walk down to the beach,on the side of the road, and also a parking lot up at the top of the hill. but in the summer you would have to get there early to get a spot for your car.

reviews.title: Miles of unspoilt sand
reviews.text: We were lucky with the February weather. The beach was completely unspoilt, golden sand and clear blue waters.

reviews.title: Great for walking
reviews.text: Loved this beach, great for some early morning runs and some late afternoon walks.  Very pleasant to here the waves lapping up the beach.  Never too busy either

reviews.title: Fabulous!
reviews.text: The colours in the sand alone are incredible. Peaks, valleys, and sand as far as the eye can see and the blues of the ocean. Lots of stairs so take your time if you’re not very fit.

reviews.title: Great beach
reviews.text: If you want a beach to walk on this is it ! We walked from Alhos de Aha to Vilamoura marina 10+ on. Too cold to swim at this time of the year but can imagine it would be lovely in Summer. Steep steps up and down on Alhos de Aha side.

reviews.title: Perfect beach!!
reviews.text: 3 miles of firm sand .Ideal just for a paddle or a long brisk walk to Villamoura. Spent a very enjoyable day in mid February in lovely warm sunshine.One of the best beaches on the Algarve.

reviews.title: Stunning
reviews.text: A must for anyone in the area. Beautiful beach to walk and take in the views. Only negative is there were no facilities opened during our visits in February.

reviews.title: Lovely beach
reviews.text: Lovely beach and parking available only a short walk away. Unfortunately, like most Algarve beaches, it is down a number of steep steps so not suitable for the elderly or infirm.

reviews.title: Fantastic beach
reviews.text: Wonderful beach, very beautiful and clean.The colour of the water is just perfect. Want to come back!

reviews.title: ONE OF THE BEST BEACHES AT ALGARVE
reviews.text: Algarve has, only at the south coast (some more at east, at Guadiana river, and other on the west Atlantic coast). around 300 kms of nearly ininterrupt lovely sandy beaches, most of them hidden on a typical limestone coast.This one, Falesia, is a wide open sandy beach "linked" to minor ones (Maria Luisa´s ; Olhos d´Agua beach) that, despite being really close to Albufeira (main touristic point) is wide enough, even in peak season, to those who want "sand and space".Easily reachable by car, you can park nearby, under pinetrees located over the surronding limestone cliffs where you can find lovely trails with a breathtaking view.Neverthelss, try to avoid peak season, if possible.

reviews.title: Stunning
reviews.text: Came here nearly everyday on holiday it's just an absolute gorgeous beach surrounded by rocks and caves. Truly magical

reviews.title: Lovely beach to walk along
reviews.text: Take the time for the steep walk down (car park at the bottom if you want to drive). Several shops and bars overlooking the beach. Can walk for miles (watch out for the tide). Nice quiet areas or large open beach. Plenty of space and not over popular (well it is February)

reviews.title: Fantastic beach
reviews.text: What a perfect way to have a lovely long walk on a bright sunny day. The colouration of the cliffs is fascinating and the long sandy beach is stunning and remarkably clean. We walked along the beach from Falésia to Vilamoura. The tide was almost fully in one day and out the following day which made walking on the exposed firmer sand so much easier. Highly recommended.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach and a good walk on the rocks/hills
reviews.text: Falesia beach is very beautiful and we really enjoyed our family walk on the rocks/hill near the beach. The vantage point on the hill offered very good views and we clicked lots of photographs while we were the there. The beach itself is very neat and clean.We spent a nice quite afternoon with the family at the beach & loved it.We got the parking easily as well.

reviews.title: Very good beach
reviews.text: Falesia beach is very nice and clean beach in Algarve definitely you will love it also I heard that it is one of the best beaches in world.

reviews.title: Gorgeous
reviews.text: The beaches are just heartbreaking!! The view is fantastic. We discovered this beach by chance. It s about 60 Kilomètres from the real Bella vista hotel at Albufeira. Off peak season this area is just amazing to relax with a book.

reviews.title: On the Beach and on the Rock
reviews.text: My Husband and I went along the beach and then the adventure started up and down the rocks. Wow amazing waves. We both definitely experienced nature.

reviews.title: One of our local landmarks
reviews.text: One of our local beaches! 7 kms of sandy beach from Barranco das Belharucas to Vilamoura, a stretch of sand that will take approximately 1 1/2hours to walk. This can easily be done at low tide! The beach is lined with a backdrop of beautiful red and white cliffs million of years old, quite picturesque that give you great photo opportunities...in high season there are several beach bars scattered throughout the length of this beach serving light snacks, cold drinks and ice creams! These outlets are all served by lifeguards and have water sports available such as paragliding, jet skis, banana boats or windsurfing among others. Great for families and couples. Even off season this is a magical place to visit ideal for those beach walks, short or long, photo opportunities or simply admire the beautiful sunsets.P.S.- All photos copyright by the author.

reviews.title: "Beautiful beach. Walk to Vilamoura."
reviews.text: Long , clean sandy beach.  Beautiful views and photo ops . Sunset is stunning . Beach has sea on one side , colourful cliff face on the other. Lovely walk along beach from Olhos de Agua to Vilamoura. Takes 2 hours. There is access to beach cafes , restaurants and toilets at certain parts of the beach but mainly nearer to Olhos and Vilamoura. Take a drink with you if walking the whole distance. Beach can be accessed from long steep wooden staircases from the top of the cliff and from cliff hotels. Sea is lovely but very rough waves. I would not swim in the sea in the Algarve.

reviews.title: wonderful sand and walking
reviews.text: Just wonderful in the October sunshine to stretch your legs and walk along the beautiful clean beach in complete safety

reviews.title: Blue flag beach
reviews.text: Beautiful beach. Excellent facilities. Everyone friendly. Pay for a sunlounger, laze, paddle, swim in the turquoise waters, eat, drink plenty water, and enjoy!

reviews.title: Clean beach
reviews.text: It is a long and clean beach, not far from Albufeira and Villamoura. We enjoyed walking next to the sea - it was too cold to get into the sea in January.

reviews.title: lovely beach
reviews.text: idyllic beach & the beach bar is excellent white sandy very long beach great for walking along plenty of sunbeds or space to lie without sunbed.

reviews.title: Nigel R
reviews.text: Great beach near hotel a few steps to get to it great for walking along with lots of beach bars and good for swiming

reviews.title: A lovely long sandy beach with some nice restaurants
reviews.text: Falesia Beach is well kept with nice sand, it is a long beach and has some nice sea front restaurants

reviews.title: White sands long Romaric walks
reviews.text: Falesia in Italian means something else but that for you to find out.  The beach is a long white sand expanse of lovelyliness.... walk in one direction when the tides out and end up at Ohlas de August a quaint fishing village walk the other way and you come across Vilamoura top end big yatch marina ... either way if your looking for walks on the beach with that special someone this where to go

reviews.title: Wow
reviews.text: Clean well maintained and wonderful restaurants easy access . We were there in the off season so loads of room to spread out and have fun. Brilliant

reviews.title: Lovely beach with plenty of miles to walk on
reviews.text: You can either relax, or walk for miles on this stretch of beach with beautiful cliff tops all around you

reviews.title: Wonderfull sand beach
reviews.text: For a walk, a run or just a romantic look at sun set, perfect beach, east to west from sunrise to sunset.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach! Must see in Albufiera
reviews.text: This beach is absolutely lovely. We went in December so it was slightly colder and not as many people were using it so in a way it was even nicer. Incredibly picturesque and the beach stretches for miles. But the best part of the beach had to be the sand hills just behind the beach. It's climbable for the bold and it's fun. You really have to see the beach for yourself... Words don't do it justice

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Beautiful long beach with colourful cliffs.A great place for a walk or swim. Several free parking areas

reviews.title: Lovely
reviews.text: Clean beach, quiet - but I think that was due to us being here in December. Water wasn't too choppy, but a few people near us were saying it can get strong currents. Lovely beach overall

reviews.title: NOT YOUR TYPICAL BEACH
reviews.text: Amazing not like any beach iv been on before. just because of the view!! could do with more shops for refreshments.

reviews.title: Lovely clean beach
reviews.text: nice beach, kids loved it. not easy to get to, but is great. The steps to get to the beach are steep so not pushchair friendly. Very busy in the peace season.

reviews.title: Lovely beach
reviews.text: Falesia Beach is a wonderful beach. For walking, sitting on and sunbathing. Lovely golden sands. Great for sunsets too.

reviews.title: Nice beach
reviews.text: one of the nice beaches in the algarve. located conventienly next to a resort hotel. good restaurants, but not cheap.

reviews.title: A beautiful beach, well worth the walk.
reviews.text: Falesia beach is a bit of a walk but well worth the effort when you get there. We found it fairly quiet a great place for families, particularly those wanting to improve their sandcastle building skills.

reviews.title: Grate place to walk and sit (even get a few last rays in November)
reviews.text: have been here many times now, well kept, busy in August but still, a great beach chose where you access the beach as some places have lots of steps whilst others can be accessed state from the car parks

reviews.title: Very nice beach
reviews.text: Stairs down to the beach from our hotel. The beach was quiet. The colourful cliffs are really pretty.

reviews.title: Lovely morning walk and paddle
reviews.text: Got to the beach early so we were able to park very close and have a very pleasant walk along the lovely beach. Snack bar above the beach serves decent range of stuff and has good toilets.

reviews.title: Lovely beach
reviews.text: Long walk down many steps to get to beach which has one of two restaurants, one was closed but the other is well appointed.

reviews.title: Love this beach
reviews.text: The beach is awesome, laden with a carpet of shells, clean with plenty of lifeguards.  A great place to sit and reflect on life!

reviews.title: Sand and sea
reviews.text: Beautiful and clean, stretches on for as far as the eye can see. Sunbed and parasols can be hired.Chance of seeing dolphins if visiting in the right season and beautiful views from the clifftops

reviews.title: fabulous family beach
reviews.text: We went down to the beach for an afternoon and had a fabulous time playing in the sand and making sandcastles. The waves were a little too big for our girls but they are very young. There were plenty of children playing in the sea and enjoying themselves. The food at the restaurant there was very good. We had lunch and and evening meal before going back up the watch the sunset from the cliff tops above.

reviews.title: Best beach for little ones
reviews.text: We found this gem on our 3rd day in the area and fell in love with it. Beautiful, soft sand, flat beach.

reviews.title: Beach for our back yard
reviews.text: This beach had everything. Walking distance to other towns. The cliffs give a great backdrop for incredible photos. We had a villa right on the cliff above the beach and every morning started with a walk on the beach. You can walk for hours.

reviews.title: Safe Beach
reviews.text: Great safe sandy beach, with reasonable access. A great place to relax and while away those sunny Algarve days.

reviews.title: Sunny beach
reviews.text: Lovely clear sandy beach wich runs between albufeira and villarmora .we walked down a wooden stepped terrace stairway which was ok for us but some people might have a problem with. Lovely coloured sandstone cliffs .beach nice and clean and waters are perfect for bathing.

reviews.title: Awesome beach
reviews.text: Wonderful beach goes on as far as the eye can see. Not easily accessible for the elderly or infirm but must be worth a visit. Such a terrific photogenic place.

reviews.title: Gorgeous Location
reviews.text: A truly beautiful beach with a fantastic walk all the way from Olhos d Aqua to Vilamoura.  Took us 1.30min to get there and 1.15mins on the way back but a lovely walk

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: This is one of the most beautiful beaches I went to, pure shores, golden sand, nice vibe, not too crowded, just perfect!

reviews.title: Stunning
reviews.text: Stunning long beach!AVOID THE ICE CREAM IN OLIVERS RESTERAUNT !!! 4 Euros for a cone is way too much.

reviews.title: Cracking views
reviews.text: Some nice cafes and restaurants near the waterfront.Walking along the beach takes you up a path to reach the top of the cliffs. Warning signs for the cliffs so approach at own risk.If you do go up there are some beautiful views

reviews.title: Lovely sandy beach
reviews.text: I feel the best time to visit the beach is early morning. You can see the sun rises above the horizon with shimmering colour. It is quiet all around except the sound of waves and wind. The sea is warm and you can walk barefoot on the beach as the waves are lapping at the sand. There are sea shells to pick and sandcastle to make.

reviews.title: beautiful place
reviews.text: extremely scenic beautiful.place . sun bed hire was expensive if I'm honest but sea was lovely and clear, sand was nice. wouldn't recommend to people with mobility issues as you can only access beach down some steps and of course back again for your trip home. enjoyed it despite the above .

reviews.title: Beautiful beach..
reviews.text: Beautiful place to rest and  exercise   safe and clean beach.Absolutely gorgeous.. most beautiful beach ever been.....

reviews.title: Expensive sunbeds
reviews.text: We twice walked a long way along the beach  but as we were staying at one end, this meant little change of scenery although the colouring or the cliffs is spectacular. The sea was quite rough for most of our stay (more suited to surfing) and so we only stayed on the beach one day - especially as a set of sunbeds cost 15 euros a day. TIPS: buy an umbrella (about 12 euros) and save a fortune; the cafes/restaurants on the beach are expensive - it was a lot cheaper for drinks to buy from the man who pulled his drinks box along the beach (4 euros a beer compared with 7 in the bars).

reviews.title: Best beach we found on the Algarve
reviews.text: Lovely for long walks. Not crowded. Beautiful cliffs with striking red stone that glow at sunset. And beautiful sunsets over the sea. Everything you need.

reviews.title: Love this beach!
reviews.text: Felt like our hotels beach even though it's open to the public.   The red cliffs are so beautiful and add a real exotic feel to the beach.  The water is freezing lol, but clear and crisp!   Feels so private.  2 Sun beds & an umbrella are €20 to rent so we bought a large umbrella for just €11.50 instead and it did the trick!   Love this beach, well worth the trip, so peaceful and idyllic 😊 the beach bar/cafe serves food all day, we had 2 burgers & a chip & 2 soft drinks, which came to just over €17, not bad for the location.  Yes a tourist trap, but not bad value for money.  Friendly service.

reviews.title: Lovely Beach
reviews.text: We’ve been here before and love the changing environment. Not the best of beaches if you don’t like the steps and parking can be an issue.  Seas can be strong at times but beach is guarded.

reviews.title: Nice and clean
reviews.text: Nice and. Lean and when we went it was pretty empty. There are no nearby restaurants or cafes so bring your own supplies

reviews.title: Amazing red and ocher cliffs
reviews.text: These red and ocher cliffs are typical of Falesia. There is a wonderful walk to discover above the cliffs leading from the city of Vilamoura to Falesia. The landscape is very wild and out of season little known from the cohort of tourists.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Beautiful beach with a few bars along the way. Can walk even at high tide, but low tide is easier. Lovely rock formations. Could walk along there every day

reviews.title: Our family holiday
reviews.text: This beach is an amazing 😉 place to go to and I would definitely recommend it to anyone who is going to Portugal 🇵🇹

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Gorgeous beach really clean to, the sea was a little rough but we think this may have been the backlash from the hurricane as it was calmer towards the end of the week. Lots of little bars and restaurants along the way. Amazing views from the top of the cliffs but be careful as they are very fragile.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach.
reviews.text: Probably one of the nicest beaches which are easily commutable too. This beach is pretty vast and has the perfect combination of sea, sand, cliffs and trail walks. It is also very local to various shops and restaurants which have some great little places to eat. I would recommend coming to this beach if you have the time!

reviews.title: Beautiful beach with lots of space
reviews.text: I love the beaches in Portugal and this is one of the best. Golden sand with a refreshing breeze. Plenty off room to avoid being too close to other people. Very relaxing

reviews.title: Nice beach, very busy
reviews.text: If you like busy beaches, thats yours. Nice wide and lots of stuff to do.. However, there are much better beaches around. This one is very central

reviews.title: sunbathing
reviews.text: beuitiful beach clean loverly sand and streaches as far as the eye can see and clear water and can walk to a loverly little marina at the other end stunning veiws and cliffs

reviews.title: Really nice beach
reviews.text: We just came back from Algarve, stayed in Olhos de Agua where you can find one of the most beautiful beach.. long sandy beach. Perfect for children. Loved it!

reviews.title: Amazing views during sunrise or sunset
reviews.text: This is the longest beach in southern Portugal (think it's ~ 7 km long), and the tide effects, combined with the sunrise or sunset lighting translate dreams to reality for any photography enthusiast.A must-see item if you're travelling in south Portugal, all-year-round.

reviews.title: Lovely beaches
reviews.text: The beaches in Albufuera are big and clean with lots of touristy bars and cafes. The prices are high for the places near the beach but it's still well worth going there. Sadly the town offers and promotes bullfighting so as you're laying on the golden sand you have to think about the poor animals bleeding into the sand of the nearby arena as they are tortured to death.

reviews.title: The longest beach We have ever seen
reviews.text: From taking the steps down from Porto bay Felesia hotel onto this beautiful beach is amazing. It stretches as far as the eye can see all the way to Villamoura. We walked the beach to Villamoura which took us around 2hours at a comfortable pace for us. We were amazed at the very chic marina with lively bars-resturants around the very up market boats . Dramatic coloured cliff faces of vibrant orange colours. It was a very enjoyable experience for us , stunning scenery.

reviews.title: lovely beach
reviews.text: lovely beach and lovely views. a lot of steps down but worth it walked to the harbour , lovely weather beautiful place

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: This is the cleanest beach I have ever been to. The sand is white, you can watch a beautiful sunset.  There are no hawkers which is brilliant, you can be left alone to soak up the sun.  Lots of restaurants on the promenade, also the Mariner Is very close.Beautiful!

reviews.title: beautiful
reviews.text: This beach is stunning the rocks are a lovely colour you can walk for miles the only negative are the ants

reviews.title: Birthday trip husbands
reviews.text: Beautiful place great location Lovely beach great swimming an views of the cliffs Will definitely visit again soon

reviews.title: What a beach
reviews.text: Wow is all I can say! The best beach ever.....we got on it down the 300 odd steps near RIU Guarana & walked & walked all the way to Vilamoura & back. The tide was out & it was beautiful. Saw a few jelly fish & weird purple things but a lovely clean beach with lots of people just walking... 5star..👍

reviews.title: Beautiful cliffs and beach
reviews.text: World class views and world class beach to stroll, explore and relax on.Lovely golden sands gentle waves.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach!
reviews.text: We went there by taxi from old town which came around 15 euros for 6 people. The beach was lovely but the water was slightly cold since it was early weeks of October.

reviews.title: Lovely beach
reviews.text: A long sandy beach with a couple of beach bars ,you can walk right along to vilamoura you have to go up a lot of steps  to go back up to the top but they are wide and gradual

reviews.title: Stunning scenary
reviews.text: Beautiful setting. A long walk down steps but well worth it for the views. Lovely clean beach. Went in October and had the small beach to ourselves.

reviews.title: Lovely beach
reviews.text: Sunbeds,  2 restaurants, Massage, steep climb to the hotel but has benches to rest on. Lovely views of the colourful cliffs.

reviews.title: World Class Beach
reviews.text: Little can be added to the title. This is a beautiful beach with a beautiful cliff face as a background. Algarve is one of the best coastlines on the planet. This beach is the jewel in the Crown.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach but lots of steps!
reviews.text: Beautiful beach but lots and lots of steps to get down to it, and only one bar across the entire strip which sits at the top of the steps so you are constantly going up and down if you want drinks/food all day so best to take supplies with you.

reviews.title: Great Beach
reviews.text: This is a great beach.... difficult to get to but well worth it.... You do need to walk down around 80 wooden decked steps and there is a bar n cafe at the top. Clean beach with great waves in the sea.

reviews.title: Lovely beach
reviews.text: Great beach for walking or just relaxing. So vast, it never feels crowded. Plenty of local facilities.

reviews.title: Beautiful beaches
reviews.text: Lovely beach not too crowded can't wait to go back today.parking is easy small cafe on hand for those extra drinks if needed perfect 😀

reviews.title: Fabulous
reviews.text: Fabulous stretch of beachDotted with sunbeds and barsWalk all the way to vilamoura in 45 mins Never to busy and safe and clean for families Beautiful

reviews.title: Falesia beach
reviews.text: Fantastic sandy but long walk down but worth it . there's a few little bars and life guard stations sun beds and parasols .

reviews.title: Gorgeous!
reviews.text: This is a lovely beach backed by red cliffs. There is parking nearby but it does get busy. However it isn't too far to walk from the car park in the village. There is a cafe and toilets at the top of the steps which take you down to the sand and there are beach beds and umbrellas available. The beach is wide and goes on for miles. As it's the Atlantic, the water was cold and quite strong so care should be taken especially with children. A beautiful setting and very clean.

reviews.title: Beach
reviews.text: Nice beach by UK standards but not the best in the area. The beach is long, so plenty of space but there are nicer beaches near by

reviews.title: Lovely beach !
reviews.text: Coyote bar/restaurant is right on the beach. It serves good beer and freshly caught sardines. It has a great view of the sea and beach

reviews.title: Nice Beach
reviews.text: Falesia Beach is nice and neat but lacks a boardwalk, bars, shops and restaurants around it.The surrounding rock formation is beautiful, the beach is not very crowded and has a lot of small sea shells.The only restaurant we saw was the one at the very top of the stairs where you can go down to the beach. On the beach itself there's nothing. To have access to other restaurants, shops, bars and coffee places you have to drive to the town close by probably 5 min. There's free parking on the curve that leads to the beach. If you have a car, I would suggest going to Praia de Rocha in Portimao (check my review on that beach), it's about an hour and a half from Albufeira.

reviews.title: Wonderful beach
reviews.text: Falesia beach is such a beautiful place, very clean and safe and with stunning scenery and views.  If you find out about the tide times you can walk for miles along the beach.  It takes a good hour and half or more to reach Vilamoura from Olhos d'Agua but it's so worth it.  The steps down to the beach (or specifically, back up) are a bit challenging but worth the effort.  There are a number of small bars with WCs along the beach - nothing fancy but perfectly adequate.  A wonderful area!

reviews.title: Great beach
reviews.text: Lovely beach that goes all the way from Olhos to Vilamoura. Will take a while, but great exercise and nice harbour bars when you get there.

reviews.title: A good beach for everyone
reviews.text: It isn’t easy to rate beaches in Portugal where all beaches are perfect. But Falésia beach is neat, there are small restaurants, good and clean WC, showers...everything you need and the most important - with a beautiful view :)

reviews.title: No facilities
reviews.text: Lovely long stretch of beach, clean sand and some sun beds.  Hotel courtesy bus dropped us off and we walked down quite a few steep steps to get to the beach only to find nothing other than the sun beds, if you needed drinks or the toilet you had to go back up they way and in 30 degree heat it was hot work, the bar and the toilet at the top was disgusting, no seat, no toilet roll or anything to wash hands with, didn't get name of the place though but I know it was not near the PineCliffs it was much further along the way to Villamoura.

reviews.title: Family holiday
reviews.text: Great Beach wave's a bit big for childrenBeach has good Sand now stone's on it me and my lovely wife have had some nice walks on it

reviews.title: A beautiful pristine beach.
reviews.text: Albufeira is justifiably famous for its innumerable beaches that are really clean and Falesia Beach is one of my favourites.I love the look of this beach and last year when we visited Albufeira we swam from this beach,the waves can get a bit choppy and makes for a fun way to pass an hour or so .With temperatures hitting the 30°+ ( in October WOW ) we couldn't resist going in,the waves were stunning,took me off my  feet a few times and pushed around a bit by the force of the waves,I had a great time as did our group ,we stayed here about an hour before drying off in the sun and going to a beach front bar. Above the beach there are some nice bars and restaurants were you can enjoy a beer or a snack and admire the beach. A great beach and one of many on this resort and well worth checking out.

reviews.title: Falesia beach
reviews.text: Great beach clean plenty of lifeguards in attendance only negative surf comes in at some rate may need to keep an eye on youngsters and oldies as we saw several people being taken of their feet by the power of the surf.

reviews.title: Stunning just stunning
reviews.text: Gorgeous beach, lovely views and ideal for a quiet trip to the beach! Restaurant conveniently placed to get coffee and ice creams from and have a meal. Definitely worth the trip down the steps

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Worth a visit, as with most of the beaches in the Algarve !  Swimming can be difficult for the young children or older people, big waves and can be steep inclines.

reviews.title: Lots of steps but worth it.
reviews.text: A good 20 minutes walk from Clube Humbria and lots of steps which don'tmake it easy for pushchairs. Restaurants on the beach and parasols/sunbeds

reviews.title: Holiday
reviews.text: Beautiful beach, we walked from portabay falesia to vilamora along the beach, which is a good 9 miles there and back, and if you do it when tides out its a lovely leisurely walk

reviews.title: beautiful area and beach
reviews.text: stayed near this beach last year and would highly recommend. there are a lot of steps down to the beach so not good for anyone with mobility issues.

reviews.title: STUNNING VIEWS
reviews.text: Beautiful beach comprising fine sand and shallow beach.  Beach is backed by high cliffs subject to erosion for which signs indicate possible danger from falling rocks etc if you stand too close. If you view the sea from the top of the cliff there a great views but access has to be gained from elsewhere.

reviews.title: Lovely beach with fabulous waves!
reviews.text: This beach has plenty of space, so there is no problem finding some space away from the crowds.  It was not noisy so peace to read and sunbathe and the water was great for swimming in, with some fantastic waves.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: This beach is beautiful. Ok its got shells on it but the views are stunning and plenty of sunbeds or just space to chill and relax.

reviews.title: Nice sandy beach
reviews.text: Beautiful sandy Algarvae beach with red cliff. Not ideal for young kids as there is an undercurrent and strong waves. Fantastic sunset. The Pinecliff hotel has an access to the beach so has Epic Sana hotel .

reviews.title: Holiday
reviews.text: Sun ... swam... scenery superb... secluded stretches.... clean water... clean beach....beach restaurant very expensive.... better try ohlos De agua for better prices... enjoy....

reviews.title: Walking on the sea beech set against giant red sand stone mountains
reviews.text: It is a lovely walk for one mile, then you come back and enjoy the beech restaurant drinks and ice cream

reviews.title: beautiful beach!
reviews.text: A small slice of heaven walking along the wonderful Falesia beach, soft sand and stunning cliffs as a back drop.  Highly recommend a visit

reviews.title: Views to die for
reviews.text: The rock face and cliffs on this beach are unreal, the colours are fantastic. Brilliant beach if a little tough to get to if you are not so good on your feet as its a climb back up from the beach to flat ground.

reviews.title: Stayed 10mins away from Falasia beach it,s stunning !
reviews.text: We stayed for a week 10mins away from Falasia beach, it,s really stunning, beautiful beach, plenty of sun beds with umbrellas but we just used our towels as there quite expensive @ 10 euro,s per day !  It,s well kept and was,nt overly busy for this time of year Don,t know about the summer months though.

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: Gorgeous beach that's really nice and quite compared with some other beaches near albuferia. Must visit in the morning when the tide is out. Will be back.

reviews.title: Lovely Beach
reviews.text: Steep steps which would preclude the less mobile from visiting. This was not mentioned in brochure and would have stopped us from booking.

reviews.title: And chillax
reviews.text: We visit this beach every day as long as we can get sun loungers & shade! Snack /drink bar on beach, prices reasonable! Only complaint I have are the loo, it is very well used But filthy, I don't think Any one cleans up or clears tissue mess all day, makes it more difficult to bear.Dont know if the staff looking after the loungers and snack bar, are responsible fog The Loo, but cold on it is 2017, we are a bit more civilised, other than that, beach is beautiful, lovely place to soak up the sun, listening to the waves and chilling out !

reviews.title: Stunning
reviews.text: Beautiful sandy beach.  Well kept and clean, plenty of room when we were there.  Need to take your own chairs/parasols but loads of space to spread out

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: We loved this beach - you could walk for miles and miles. It had loads of space and loads of sunbeds.

reviews.title: beautiful sandy beach
reviews.text: This beach by far was one of the cleaniest longest you can walk all the way to villamour marina. A good workout fabulous views of the hills

reviews.title: Super beach
reviews.text: Must be one of the best beaches on the Algarve, Limited eating , drinking and shopping areas but plenty of space with a very long expanse of sand, lot of loungers available all day. Car parking available close to beach.

reviews.title: Lovely beach!!
reviews.text: Gorgeous beach. Life guards present and beautiful cliffs...some idiots climbing them!!!Clean beach and sea.

reviews.title: Very nice beach
reviews.text: Lovely long sandy beach that's cleaned every day, lots of sun beds and places to grab a drink or a bite to eat. The only downside was the water it was absolutely freezing

reviews.title: Golden sands
reviews.text: A long gold sands beach with some cafes and toilets and occasional sun beds to hire. In early September it was never crowded

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach, shame about the super expensive restaurants on it!
reviews.text: Falesia beach is a beautiful long beach which allows for plenty of space for you to not be cramped up next to others like on some beaches close by. I recommend taking a packed lunch if you want to spend the day there as there are only two restaurants that we could see. We ate at one called Beach Club Pine Cliffs by Olivier but it was SOOO ridiculously expensive. You can get to this beach by car or by walking over some slightly rocky coves from the local beach in Olhos de Agua. We walked from the local beach which was a lovely little trek and took about 30 minutes.

reviews.title: Very long beach
reviews.text: Loved walking this beach every day. It's deceptively long. Once we walked as far as the Marina in Vilamoura- around 4K away. Really enjoyed the walkis, there's a nice breeze in September. And not overcrowded this time of year

reviews.title: Expensive sunbeds !!
reviews.text: Nice clean busy beach over the top prices for sunbeds ! Because of that wouldn't go here .. Prefer to stay by pool at hotel 15€ for sunbed !!

reviews.title: Absolutely stunning beach but very few cafes/bars
reviews.text: This beach is stunning, especially on a clear sunny day where the red cliffs contrast so beautifully with the blue sky. The sea is clean and the sand is "proper" sand, lovely and golden. It's a huge, huge beach so depending on where you choose to sit, there aren't many beach chairs, bars or cafes on the beach. The beach chairs are fairly pricey (we paid around €16 for two) so pack some sun umbrellas if you want to save money. Where any taxi will drop you off, there's a little cafe, but they didn't seem to have much in the way of food. Pack some snacks and food! If you don't mind walking 5/10 minutes there are loads of places to eat up the main road where you enter. I also heard there's an amazing restaurant at some point on the stretch of beach, but we didn't go. Don't let the lack of beach bats put you off though, as it really is an amazing place to relax away from the super crowded beaches closer to the centre.

reviews.title: Paradise
reviews.text: Lovely clean beach, with white sand and clear sea water.  Bit cold at first but then lovely to swim in and nice waves which made it fun

reviews.title: Great Beach fantastic views
reviews.text: psssst, don't tell anyone because we don't want to spoil it but this beech is fantastic.if you want hundreds of sun beds with hundreds of people sitting on them - your going to hate it.If however you want a nice beach thats not too busy this is the one - but don't tell anyone as we don't want to spoil it ;-)

reviews.title: Holiday / anniversary
reviews.text: Two weeks at the Sensimar to celebrate our wedding anniversary, a special thanks to Sandra Gabbert guest relations manager which made our day special.This was our 4th stay, as expected we had a fantastic time, the staff are amazing, very helpful, courteous and friendly.The rooms are clean, modern and well kept.There are plenty of sun beds No queues first thing in the morning like some hotels. Poolside is well managed and the gardens are lovely.Sandra Gabbert guest relations manager is excellent and goes the extra mile to ensure requests are met.Sensimar Los Gigantes maybe you should visit this hotel to see how a Sensimar should be run.Tom Yates  Warwickshire.

reviews.title: One of the better beaches!
reviews.text: Really nice wide, long beach. No horrible rocks in the swimming areas unlike some of the other beaches. Really relaxing to paddle away and look at the beautiful cliffs.Warning: if you take the sun loungers to the right they are expensive at 9.00 euros each and you don't even get a mattress! Also the old guy who collected the money was rude and hovers around quite a bit, he made me feel really uncomfortable!!!

reviews.title: Early morning walk, then great coffee & water
reviews.text: You can walk Falesia beach for quite some time. Best time is to arrive "early" morning, but you will not be alone (lots of company !!). Still worth the walk, sea around your feet, & sound of the surf. Turn around after 30 mins & walk into the sun for your return trip. Arrive @ any of the beach bars, for a deserved coffee or water. Great sunbathing (& maybe a spot of lunch). Really popular (in season) or @ weekend with locals. A great place to simply chill.

reviews.title: One of the Finest Beaches in all of Europe
reviews.text: This is a wide and long (approximately 10km) sandy beach that sits directly below beautiful white and ochre cliffs with high pine trees, and that is perfect for taking long walks (you can even take a 1hr. long walk to the next town on Vilamoura).  The water is clear and free of stones or rocks, and the beach is well serviced.  The restaurant that is operated by the adjacent Pine Cliffs Resort is a bit pricey, but the burgers, the piri piri chicken, and the sangria are all amazing, and well worth the price.  In short, this beach is both comfortable and picturesque.

reviews.title: What a fantasic beach...
reviews.text: Clean, friendly and the water beautifully warm and paddling friendly. Bugger to get off as steps numerous but break areas and lovely cafe at the top with ice cream and beer!!

reviews.title: Very good and clean
reviews.text: This beach is wonderful. We spent some time there walking clean everywhere. Never seen any litter at any time.Plenty of space for privacy.

reviews.title: Wow
reviews.text: I decided to go for a wander down there and was amazed how big and spacious it was.Water was very cold Hardly anyone in there.I ran on this beach the following morning and I got 2 miles one way and 2 miles back what a lovley run .Nice restaurant halfway too

reviews.title: Lovely
reviews.text: This is a lovely beach thats stretches for miles, there's plenty of sun beds and a couple of bars to sit at and enjoy the view. The sea is freezing cold!

reviews.title: day at beach.
reviews.text: great busy beach, many locals visit here..great beach bar on upper level and decking steps to beach on lower level..

reviews.title: Beach walk
reviews.text: Nice beach to walk along with beach cafes along the way. Sunbeds and umbrellas available by the cafes.

reviews.title: Certainly not the best beach in the area !
reviews.text: No outstanding features on this beach. Others had more to offer eg interesting rock formation, vibey restaurants etc.

reviews.title: Fabulous beach
reviews.text: We stayed at the Portobay Falesia and had great views of this wonderful beach from above the cliffs.  Access from the hotel and the areas alongside was by over 130 steps but in all honesty not arduous if take your time.  There is an access track down for vehicles and parking at the bottom by a beach restaurant or on road approach.  There are two restaurants we could see, first one is a great bar and restaurant serving great value snacks, lunches and dinner.  We visited several times, and fresh sardines were great as a treat for lunch.  Further along is another beach restaurant but this is linked to the Pine Cliffs hotel, so far more expensive and slick.  Not the place for a cheap snack.  Beach has areas of sundress and umbrellas as reports have already stated below, and also set areas for if you have brought your own seats and umbrellas, which was popular.  Sand was very nice and and sea  shelved nicely.  Surprisingly sea was not as cold as we expected, and welcoming to have a dip.  Waves are occasionally a touch bigger and great fun, but normally it excessive.  To the right there are areas of rock pools for the children, and adults like us for a bit of fun.  To the left the beach extends so far and great for long walk and guess you'd find yourself in Villamora eventually, not that we tried it.  Was t excessively crowded at all on any of our visits.Overall was great place to sunbathe, have a dip, nice walk, and visit the restaurant.  There were lifeguards on duty every time we were there.  Can't think of a better beach we found in the area.  Well worth a visit for the day.

reviews.title: Very nice
reviews.text: Recommend. You find parking places around the beach. The sunbeds are 18 euros during september and the beach is i credible nice !

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: The Falésia was beautiful, it is definitely work walking up early to see the sun rise, it's a breath taking experience.

reviews.title: Fabulous Falesia!
reviews.text: Stayed at Alfamar Villas which is 2 minutes away from this fabulous beach. On recommendation from a friend we went onto the beach out of the Alfamar and headed left towards Vilamoura. It's a long walk but the views are great all the way and there are watering holes just when you need them. There are also plenty of boardwalks if walking on the sand is too tiring. The reddish colour of cliffs, typical of the Algarve, which line the route blend beautifully with the soft golden sands of the beach and they have ever changing shapes, often looking as though they have started to melt. The cliff tops have regular clusters of conifers which add another dimension and another colour leaving only the blues of the sea and the sky to complete the palette. Bathing in the Atlantic is invigorating but beware as there are rip tides but warning notices are posted. If you are in the area and fancy a day on the beach, this is the one!

reviews.title: Fantastic and beautiful beach
reviews.text: We went as a family in April this year and this beach was a real highlight. Our children loved it and we many lovely walks along it. Not sure how busy it gets in the peak of summer but in April for Easter it was very pleasant . It's worth noting tide times as we found with two young children that high tide was not much use but the hours just before and after low tide left a wonderful safe playground for them which they happily occupied themselves for hours. We stayed at Pine cliffs and there is a restaurant on the beach which was a bonus although at busy times we had to wait some time for a table, tip is to get yourself on a waiting list an hour before you think you will want to eat.

reviews.title: Be prepared for 73 steps but worth it
reviews.text: Stunning scenery, beautiful beach and cliff top walk. Be mindful of 73 steps down to the beach. If you want the cliff top walk, lots more to contend with, then back again. Cliff top has no safety rail, sheer drop down so keep a tight hold on the little ones.

reviews.title: Lovely beach
reviews.text: Great beach miles of golden sand. Safe to swim and families . With a couple of restaurants for a cool drink.

reviews.title: Nice view
reviews.text: Beautiful coastline, the rusty colour of the rocks is amazing.Also plenty of pretty shells to collect.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: We really enjoyed visiting this beach. The water was deep enough for a swim but safe enough for kids to go in too. Restaurants located on the beach were quite nice. We didn't know how to rent sun loungers so on the second day that we went down we took our towels and a parasol which was cheap enough from the local supermarket (about 5 euros i think). Lot's of steps down to the beach so be prepared to walk! There is a lift half way up though. Overall, very nice beach and we would visit again!

reviews.title: Quiet and open
reviews.text: Clean and safe depth ideal for swimming and bath in. 2 high quality restaurants overlooking the beach.

reviews.title: Stunning
reviews.text: We went to this beach to see the famous red rocks! It didn't disappoint we walked to the cliff edge and the view took my breath away. Def worth a visit ❤️

reviews.title: Awesome Falesia
reviews.text: Long stretch of beach along the Algarve coast. Lots of water activities and snack and drink shops. Beautiful ! Easy to rent chairs and umbrellas. Beach goes on for miles ! Great for a long walk and a refreshing Atlantic swim.

reviews.title: Falesia beach
reviews.text: Amazing beach, nice for kids , and even my husband who doesn't know how to swim and doesn't like water was splashing there for hours:)

reviews.title: A Trek
reviews.text: A lovely beach once you get down there..Took the lift a part of the way down then walked the rest of the way down steps and on boardwalk..Wasnt too bad going doen but was quite an ordeal coming back up in 40 degrees..Glad I went the once but dont think i would go again...especially after having a hip replacement operation..let the youngsters do it

reviews.title: Beautiful beach!
reviews.text: We stayed at the Falesia Mar hotel so this beach was closest to where we were starting. We had so much fun here, beautiful views, the only thing I will say is we had no idea where we needed to go to hire a sun-lounger!?! Nobody was around to ask, so we simply put our towels on the sand but I would of preferred a sun-lounger!

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach walk to get away from the crowds
reviews.text: Most people set down around the entrance to the beach and beach huts with food.. Walking along the beach towards Vilamoura you can usually find a quieter spot. Although I must say Portuguese family's are perfect beach companions. Very happy and respectful :)

reviews.title: Beautiful relaxing day here
reviews.text: What can I say. There is something special about each beach you visit in algarve. But this one ticked all boxes. Amazing sandy clean beach with beautiful cliffs. Not too busy at all. Comfy shades. Must visit if you're in algarve so relaxing

reviews.title: Great sunset
reviews.text: A great evening spent with friends watching the sunset along the coast. Lots of places for food and drinks nearby too

reviews.title: Spectacular views!!
reviews.text: Definitely a must destination!!! The Beach is beautiful - soft warm sand, the view is spectacular - no words can describe it... there is one but though - please arrive earlier as parking is difficult... (not suitable for those with physical disabilities)
